Extract from the Chinese Morning Translation
of January 25, 1931.

The Death of Huang Choh Chiu and the Liquidation of the
Day and Night Bank

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following telegram from Nanking :-
With reference to the liquidation of the Day
and Night Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort
Visitors' Savings Department following the death of
Huang Choh Chiu, the Ministry of Industry of the
National Government has sent a telegram to the
Shanghai Bureau of Social Affairs instructing it to pay
special attention to the liquidation of the Bank and the
Savings Department. The telegram states that the
Day and Night Bank had not been registered with the
Ministry as a limited liability company and that it
should be liquidated as an unlimited liability company
in order to safeguard the interests of the depositors.
The Ministry of Industry further instructs that
all savings organizations which have been running without
permission from the Ministry and which are soliciting
small deposits from the people by offering high rates
of interest and prizes should be suppressed.
Banks which have not been registered as companies but are
illegally using the name "company" should be ordered
to apply for registration at once failing which they
are liable to be prosecuted.

1931年1月25日中文晨报译文摘录。

黄楚九之死与日夜银行清理案

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下来自南京的电讯：
鉴于黄楚九去世后，日夜银行及大世界游乐场游客储蓄部的清理事宜，国民政府实业部已致电上海社会局，指示其特别注意该银行及储蓄部的清理工作。电文指出，日夜银行并未向本部注册为有限责任公司，故应作为无限责任公司进行清理，以保障储户利益。实业部进一步指示，凡未经本部许可而擅自运营、并以高息和奖品招揽民众小额存款的储蓄机构，均应予以取缔。凡未注册为公司却非法使用“公司”名称的银行，应责令其立即申请注册，否则将面临起诉。

January 28, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

COL. YUAN LIANG ON RESTORATION OF POLICE RIGHTS.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
In an interview with a newspaper reporter,
Colonel Yuan Liang, Chief of the Public Safety Bureau
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, stated that
the restoration of the police rights in the Special
District is a matter which cannot be further delayed.
So long as the police rights are not settled, criminals,
after committing a crime in the Settlement, will seek
refuge in Chinese territory. For the sake of peace and
good order in Chinese territory, there is urgent necessity
for the restoration of police rights. Moreover, the
number of cases of armed abductions in Chinese territory
represents but 8% to 9% of the number of such cases in
the Settlement. The inefficiency of the Settlement
authorities to preserve peace and good order justifies
the demand for restoration of these police rights.
The condition of the Settlements is desired by the
National Government. The administrative and judicial
rights in the Special District are being gradually
taken back by Chinese. In conclusion Col. Yuan Liang
declared that the efforts of the Government to secure
the restoration of Police Rights will be supported by
all Chinese.

TWO CASES OF MENINGITIS IN NANTAO.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
During the past week, the Shanghai Hospital,
Nantao, received two patients suffering from spinal
meningitis, one of whom has since died.

THE CHINESE ESTATE OWNERS AND THE WATER RATE

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following report:-
The Chinese Estate Owners' Association yesterday
sent the following letter to the Diplomatic Research Commission
in connection with the water rate controversy:-
We beg to submit the following two points for
the consideration of the Special Committee organised by
your Commission to discuss the water rates in the
International Settlement:-
1) The collection of water rates by landlords on behalf
of the Shanghai Waterworks Company should be stopped
and the Shanghai Waterworks Company should collect
the water rates from tenants direct. The reason
is that the present system causes landlords to
suffer loss when tenants fall into arrears with their
rents or when they abscond without paying rents. The
landlords have to pay the water rates sometimes with
interest.
2) The water rate should be collected according to
actual rent. At the present time the water charge
is included in the rent. If the rent is $100. a
month, the landlord actually receives about $94.34,
the water charge being $5.66. According to the
agreement between the S.M.C. and the Shanghai Waterworks

杂项。

袁良上校谈收回警权。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：
大上海市公安局局长袁良上校在接受报社记者采访时 stated that 收回特别区警权之事刻不容缓。只要警权问题未决，罪犯在租界作案后便会逃入华界寻求庇护。为了华界的治安与秩序，迫切有必要收回警权。此外，华界发生的武装绑架案件数量仅占租界此类案件数量的8%至9%。租界当局在维持治安方面的无能，证明了要求收回这些警权的正当性。国民政府期望改善租界的状况。特别区的行政和司法权正逐渐由中国人收回。最后，袁良上校宣称，中国政府为收回警权所作的努力将获得全体中国人的支持。

南市两起脑膜炎病例。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：
在过去的一周里，南市上海医院接收了两名患有脊髓脑膜炎的病人，其中一人随后死亡。

中国业主与水费

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：
中国业主协会昨日就水费争议致函外交研究委员会，信件内容如下：
谨提交以下两点，供贵委员会组织的讨论国际公共租界水费的特别委员会考虑：
1) 应停止房东代上海自来水公司收取水费的做法，上海自来水公司应向租户直接收取水费。原因是现行制度导致当租户拖欠租金或欠租潜逃时，房东遭受损失。房东有时不得不连带利息支付水费。
2) 水费应按实际租金收取。目前水费包含在租金内。如果月租金为$100.00，房东实际收到约$94.34，水费为$5.66。根据工部局与上海自来水公司之间的协议

which have not been received, it is impossible to find

or shops concerned will incur suspicion of being in
illegal possession. If creditors know of any such
cases, they are expected to report to this office.

pages.en:
THE LIQUIDATION OF THE DAY AND NIGHT BANK

The following advertisement was published
in the Shun Pao and the Sin Wan Pao on February 1, 1931,
by Tan Yien Koong, a Chinese lawyer, on behalf of
Huang Shien Yao(        )and Huang Shien Tsoong(        ),
sons of the late Huang Cho Chiu:-
Messrs. Huang Shien Yao and Huang Shien
Tsoong have retained me to publish the following
announcement:-
As our father was the general manager of the Day
and Night Bank and of the Great World Amusement
Resort Visitors' Savings Department, both of which
had been established by him, he naturally used
the funds for business purposes in order to ensure
the interests of the depositors. During the
past years, he was engaged in real estate and other
business enterprises to promote public welfare,
but unfortunately he was not very successful in all
his business undertakings. Last Summer when
he was sick, the Day and Night Bank was in a critical
situation because of rumours. Our father, who
was mindful of his responsibilities, maintained
the Bank despite his sickness. At the beginning
of January, when he returned from Hangchow, his
sickness became serious. Several days prior to
his death, he asked a number of his intimate friends
to organize a Van Tsung Syndicate and produced
all his title deeds and other documents as security.
In a few days, the Syndicate advanced more than
$310,000.00. to the Day and Night Bank. He also
borrowed more than $50,000.00. from relatives and
friends, and advanced this sum to the Day and Night
Bank. In this connection, there are accounts
that can be referred to.
After his death, we, in accordance with his will,
requested Messrs. Yu Yah Ching, Wang Shao Lai, Wong
Yien Soong, Yuan Lee Tung, Yih Shan Dau, and Zau Jing
Poo to organize a Liquidation Committee. The
Day and Night Bank and the Great World Amusement
Resort Visitors' Savings Department then suspended
business to go into liquidation, but the other
business enterprises will be carried on as usual
for fear that if they are suspended, the depositors
will suffer more loss. The deposits are mostly
of small sums and naturally the depositors have
become excited. We regret very much that we are
unable to succeed our father in his business dealings.
However, since Mr. Yu Yah Ching and others have
very kindly organized a Liquidation Committee, the
depositors will not lose their money. As the
liquidation will take some time, we request depositors
to wait quietly.
As regards a portion of our father's liabilities
in the Company(? Koong Fah Company) as well as his
personal debts, we have handed the title deeds,
houses and land, share certificates, valuable
jewellery, clothing, curios, paintings, and
furniture, etc. which had been left by our father,
to the Liquidation Committee, through our lawyer,
to be sold in payment of debts incurred by our father.
We hereby announce that, even if we are reduced
to poverty, we shall not hold on to any property
left by our father until all obligations have been
settled. In the case of those members of the
family who cannot earn a living, we have to request
kind and fair-minded persons to render them
some relief.

日夜银行的清算

1931年2月1日，《申报》和《新闻报》刊登了由中国律师谭燕康（Tan Yien Koong）代表已故黄楚九之子黄显耀（Huang Shien Yao）和黄显宗（Huang Shien Tsoong）发布的如下广告：
黄显耀先生和黄显宗先生委托本人发布以下公告：
鉴于家父身为日夜银行及由其创立的大世界游乐场游客储蓄部的总经理，他自然将资金用于商业目的，以保障存款人的利益。在过去几年中，他从事房地产及其他商业企业以增进公共福利，但不幸的是，他的所有商业经营并非都很成功。去年夏天他患病期间，日夜银行因谣言而陷入危急境地。家父心系职责，抱病维持银行运营。一月初，他从杭州返回后，病情加重。在去世前几天，他邀请数位密友组织“万宗银团”（Van Tsung Syndicate），并拿出所有地契及其他文件作为担保。数日内，该银团向日夜银行垫款超过310,000.00元。他还向亲友借款超过50,000.00元，并将此笔款项垫付给日夜银行。对此，均有账目可查。
家父去世后，我们遵照其遗嘱，请求余雅清（Yu Yah Ching）、王少莱（Wang Shao Lai）、黄燕松（Wong Yien Soong）、袁李东（Yuan Lee Tung）、叶山道（Yih Shan Dau）及邹景甫（Zau Jing Poo）等先生组织清算委员会。随后，日夜银行及大世界游乐场游客储蓄部停业进入清算程序，但其他商业企业将继续照常经营，以免因停业导致存款人遭受更大损失。存款多为小额，存款人情绪激动乃自然之事。对于未能继承家父之商业事务，我们深表遗憾。然而，既然余雅清先生等人好意组织了清算委员会，存款人的资金将不会受损。由于清算需要一定时间，我们恳请存款人静心等待。
关于家父在公司（疑为孔发公司）中的部分债务及其个人债务，我们已通过律师将家父遗留的地契、房屋土地、股票证书、贵重珠宝、衣物、古玩、字画及家具等移交给清算委员会，以便出售偿还家父所欠债务。特此公告，即便我们陷入贫困，在所有债务清偿之前，我们也不会保留家父留下的任何财产。对于家中无法谋生的成员，我们恳请仁慈公正之士给予救济。

pages.en:
February 1, 1931.

THE AFFAIRS OF HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
At 2 p.m. yesterday (January 31), the
Committee of Creditors of the Day & Night Bank and
the Great World Visitors Savings Department held its
second meeting in the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
About 1,100 persons attended.
Chen Kai Kee, who presided, made a report
on the following five points:-
(1) The purpose of the second general meeting.
(2) Since its appointment by the first general
meeting on January 21, the Committee is now devising
ways and means to protect the interest of the creditors.
(a) The Board of Directors of the Kung Fah
Company be warned to accept full
responsibility and to refund capital
and interest at a fixed date.
(b) Negotiations be opened with the Huang
Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee requesting
it to accept the responsibility of
satisfying all obligations.
(c) Two manifestoes be issued explaining
the attitude of the creditors.
(d) Representatives be sent to negotiate
with the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation
Committee.
(3) The filing of actions by certain persons has
resulted in the resignation from the Liquidation
Committee of three members which will harm the
negotiations.
(4) The meeting to devise means to improve the
situation which has become unfavourable owing to
the resignation of the three members of the Liquidation
Committee.
(5) All creditors are requested to unite.
The following resolutions were passed:-
(1) That negotiations be opened with the Huang Cho
Chiu Liquidation Committee with a request that it accept all
responsibility and urging it to fix the dates for repayment
of capital and interest.
(2) That in case the first resolution fails to produce
result, appeal be made to the proper authorities and
merchant associations asking for support.
(3) That other local organizations and leading men
be requested to render assistance as the matter is one
which greatly affects the economic life of the common
people in Shanghai.
(4) That local newspapers be asked to render
assistance.
(5) That the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee
and the Board of Directors of the Kung Fah Company be
urged to publish a list of all the property belonging
to the Kung Fah Company and to hand the company's
important documents and account books to the safe
keeping of the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee
and representatives of creditors, and that the names
of the shareholders of the Kung Fah Company be made
public.
pages.zh:
1931年2月1日。

黄楚九事件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：
昨日下午2时（1月31日），日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部债权人委员会在上海总商会举行第二次会议。约1,100人出席。
主持会议的陈凯基（Chen Kai Kee）就以下五点作了报告：
(1) 第二次大会的目的。
(2) 自1月21日第一次大会任命以来，委员会正在制定保护债权人利益的方法与措施。
(a) 警告孔发公司（Kung Fah Company）董事会承担全部责任，并在固定日期退还本金及利息。
(b) 与黄楚九清算委员会展开谈判，要求其承担履行所有债务的责任。
(c) 发表两份宣言，阐明债权人的立场。
(d) 派遣代表与黄楚九清算委员会进行谈判。
(3) 某些人提起诉讼导致清算委员会三名成员辞职，这将损害谈判进程。
(4) 会议旨在制定措施，改善因清算委员会三名成员辞职而变得不利的局势。
(5) 呼吁所有债权人团结一致。
会议通过以下决议：
(1) 与黄楚九清算委员会展开谈判，要求其承担全部责任，并敦促其确定偿还本金及利息的日期。
(2) 若第一项决议未能产生结果，则向有关当局及商会求助，寻求支持。
(3) 鉴于此事严重影响上海普通民众的经济生活，请求其他地方组织和知名人士提供协助。
(4) 请求本地报纸提供协助。
(5) 敦促黄楚九清算委员会及孔发公司董事会公布属于孔发公司的所有财产清单，并将公司的重要文件和账簿交由黄楚九清算委员会及债权人代表妥善保管，同时公开孔发公司股东的姓名。

日夜银行的清算

中国律师谭燕强（Tan Yiem Keong，音译）代表已故黄哲求（Huang Che Chiu）之子黄宪耀（Huang Shien Yao）和黄宪忠（Huang Shien Tsoong），于1931年2月1日在《西报》（Siam Pao）和《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）上刊登了以下广告：

黄宪耀先生和黄宪忠先生委托我发布以下公告：

鉴于我们的父亲是日夜银行以及由他创办的“大世界游乐区游客储蓄部”的总经理，他自然会将资金用于商业目的，以保障储户的利益。在过去几年中，他从事房地产和其他商业企业以促进公共利益，但不幸的是，他在所有商业活动中并非都很成功。去年夏天他生病时，日夜银行因谣言而陷入危急境地。我们的父亲考虑到自己的责任，尽管抱病仍维持银行的运营。一月初，当他从杭州回来时，病情加重。在去世前几天，他请几位密友组织了一个“范宗银团”（Van Tsung Syndicate，音译），并拿出所有的地契和其他文件作为担保。几天内，该银团向日夜银行垫付了31万多美元。他还向亲友借款5万多美元，并将这笔款项垫付给日夜银行。对此，有账目可查。

在他去世后，我们遵照他的遗嘱，请求余亚清（Yu Yah Ching，音译）、王少莱（Wang Shao Lai，音译）、黄燕松（Wong Yien Soong，音译）、袁李东（Yuan Lee Tung，音译）、易山丹（Yih Shan Dan，音译）和邹景普（Zau Jing Poo，音译）等先生组织一个清算委员会。随后，日夜银行和大世界游乐区游客储蓄部暂停营业进行清算，但其他商业企业将继续照常经营，以免因停业而使储户遭受更大损失。存款多为小额，储户自然情绪激动。对于未能继承父亲的事业，我们深感遗憾。然而，既然余亚清先生等人好意组织了清算委员会，储户的资金将不会受损。由于清算需要一些时间，我们恳请储户耐心等待。

关于我们父亲在公司（？香雅公司 Heong Yah Company）的部分债务以及他的个人债务，我们已通过律师将父亲留下的地契、房屋和土地、股票证书、贵重珠宝、衣物、古玩、字画和家具等移交给清算委员会，以便出售以偿还父亲所欠债务。

我们特此声明，即使我们陷入贫困，在所有债务清偿之前，我们也不会保留父亲留下的任何财产。对于家中无法谋生的成员，我们不得不请求仁慈公正的人士给予救济。

阅后请退回，顺致敬意。

pages.en:
February 3, 1931.

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The case brought up by the lawyers of about
2,200 depositors of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
and the Great World Visitors' Savings Department was
again heard on February 2 at the Mixed Court in the
French Concession.
The lawyers made the following requests:-
1) That the two sons of the late Huang Cho Chiu
be summoned to the Court to repay all debts.
2) That an order be issued that the shareholders
of the Kung Fah Kung Ss undertake full responsibility
for the repayment of the debts.
3) That all the property belonging to the Kung
Fah Kung Ss such as the Wen Zien Bath House, the Poh
Chong Cigarette Company, the Great China Dispensary,
etc., be detained.
4) That all shops such as the Huang Chiu Tse Tang,
Huang Loong Tai, Chiu Foh Tang, etc., which had been
established by Huang Cho Chiu, be detained.
5) That the representatives of depositors be
authorized to act as members of the Kung Fah Kung Ss
Liquidation Committee and to take charge of the management
of all shops belonging to the concern.
6) That the plaintiff reserve the right of
claiming compensation of loss.
7) That the defendants pay the costs.
Magistrate Kyang has granted the request to
detain the property belonging to the Kung Fah Kung Ss
and also to issue an order prohibiting the transfer of
the estate belonging to the late Huang Cho Chiu.
The Magistrate also ordered the two Court Auditors
to submit a report as soon as they have inspected the
accounts of the Kung Fah Kung Ss.

January 31, 1931.

Leh Zau Tseng, a lawyer, publishes an advertisement
in the Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers announcing
that there is no truth that his client Yeh San Tao
is a member of the Board of Directors of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank and that although Huang Cho Chiu
had invited him to act as advisor to the Kung Fah Kung Ss,
he had declined the offer.
pages.zh:
1931年2月3日。

已故黄哲求（Huang Cho Chiu）事件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了以下报道：

上海日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部约2,200名储户的律师提起的案件，于2月2日在法租界混合法庭再次开庭审理。

律师们提出了以下请求：

1) 传唤已故黄哲求的两个儿子到庭偿还所有债务。
2) 下令公发康社（Kung Fah Kung Ss，音译）的股东承担偿还债务的全部责任。
3) 扣押属于公发康社的所有财产，如文仙浴室（Wen Zien Bath House，音译）、宝昌香烟公司（Poh Chong Cigarette Company，音译）、大中华药房（Great China Dispensary，音译）等。
4) 扣押由黄哲求创办的所有商店，如黄秋泽堂（Huang Chiu Tse Tang，音译）、黄龙泰（Huang Loong Tai，音译）、秋福堂（Chiu Foh Tang，音译）等。
5) 授权储户代表担任公发康社清算委员会成员，并负责管理该机构所属的所有商店。
6) 原告保留索赔损失的权利。
7) 被告支付诉讼费用。

蒋法官（Magistrate Kyang，音译）已批准扣押属于公发康社的财产，并发布命令禁止转让已故黄哲求的遗产。法官还命令两名法庭审计员在检查完公发康社的账目后立即提交报告。

1931年1月31日。

律师楼兆曾（Leh Zau Tseng，音译）在《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登广告，声明其客户叶三道（Yeh San Tao，音译）并非上海日夜银行董事会成员一事纯属子虚乌有；虽然黄哲求曾邀请他担任公发康社的顾问，但他已拒绝了这一提议。

pages.en:
February 4, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Armed with an order issued by the Mixed
Court in the French Concession, Wu Tseng and Pen Zau Paung,
two auditors, yesterday went to the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort to take charge
of all the property belonging to these two concerns.

The Sin Wan Pao publishes the following
telegram from Nanking:-
Upon receipt of a petition from the
provisional committee of creditors of the Great World
Amusement Resort Visitors' Savings Department and the
Shanghai Day and Night Bank asking for protection, the
Ministry of Industry issued the following order on
February 3:-
"In connection with this case we recently
issued an order directing the Social Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai to liquidate these
concerns carefully and immediately and that these concerns
are not to be treated as limited liability enterprises.
The Social Bureau is now again ordered to carry out the
liquidation as soon as possible and to make the concerned
accept full responsibility so as to save the depositers
from loss."

The following advertisements appear in the
Sin Wan Pao, the Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-
1) The Great Eastern Dispensary Ltd. was
registered on May 8, 1929 and is in possession of
registration certificate No. 46 issued by the Ministry
of Industry and Commerce. The Shun Pao and other local
newspapers reported on February 3 that when the depositers
of the Day and Night Bank requested the French Concession
Mixed Court to detain the property of the Hung Dah Hung Sz,
they made a mistake by including this dispensary in the
list of property. We, therefore, publish this advertisement
for the information of the public.
2) The Kiu Fah Hung Sz, Ltd. was registered
in 1928 and possesses registration certificate No. 205
issued on September 28, 1928 by the National Registration
Bureau. The Shun Pao and other local newspapers reported
on February 3 that when the depositers of the Day and
Night Bank requested the French Concession Mixed Court
to detain the property of the Kung Fah Hung Sz, they made
a mistake by including this concern in the list of property.
We, therefore, publish this advertisement for the information
of the public.
pages.zh:
1931年2月4日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄哲求（Huang Cho Chu，原文拼写有误，应为Chiu）事件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了以下报道：

吴曾（Wu Tseng，音译）和潘兆邦（Pen Zau Paung，音译）两名审计员持法租界混合法庭发布的命令，于昨日前往上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场，接管属于这两家机构的所有财产。

《新闻报》刊登了来自南京的以下电报：

收到大世界游乐区游客储蓄部和上海日夜银行债权人临时委员会请求保护的请愿书后，实业部于2月3日发布如下命令：

“关于此案，我们最近发布命令，指示上海特别市社会局仔细并立即清算这些机构，且这些机构不得被视为有限责任企业。现再次命令社会局尽快执行清算，并使相关方承担全部责任，以挽救储户免受损失。”

以下广告刊登在《新闻报》、《申报》（Shun Pao）及其他本地报纸上：

1) 大东方药房有限公司（The Great Eastern Dispensary Ltd.）于1929年5月8日注册，持有工商部颁发的第46号注册证书。《申报》及其他本地报纸于2月3日报道称，日夜银行储户请求法租界混合法庭扣押宏达洪社（Hung Dah Hung Sz，音译）的财产时，误将该药房列入财产清单。因此，我们刊登此广告以告知公众。

2) 久发洪社有限公司（The Kiu Fah Hung Sz, Ltd.，音译）于1928年注册，持有全国注册局于1928年9月28日颁发的第205号注册证书。《申报》及其他本地报纸于2月3日报道称，日夜银行储户请求法租界混合法庭扣押公发洪社（Kung Fah Hung Sz，音译）的财产时，误将该机构列入财产清单。因此，我们刊登此广告以告知公众。

pages.en:
February 5, 1931. Afternoon Translation,

MISCELLANEOUS

The two Court Auditors have sent a letter to the Ningpo Commercial and Savings Bank and the China Industrial Bank stating that they have discovered that the Day & Night Bank had borrowed $700,000 from the Ningpo Commercial and Savings Bank and $800,000 from the China Industrial Bank on the security of title deeds given by Huang Cho Chiu to the Van Chun Financial Syndicate. The auditors therefore warn them that the transfer of these title deeds is prohibited.

The two Court Auditors yesterday wrote to Hsu Yoong Che, an auditor engaged by the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee, urging him to submit a list containing the names of the shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung Sz.

According to enquiries made by the creditors, certain persons named Yuan, Yieh, Waung, Zung and Zau are shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung Sz.

The Great Eastern Dispensary was established by Huang Cho Chiu prior to the establishment of the Kung Fah Kung Sz. It is said that the value of Huang Cho Chiu's shares in this dispensary is about $200,000.

The China Times publishes the following report:-

A reporter of the China Times called upon General Chang Chun, Mayor of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, yesterday afternoon who made the following statement:-

"I am sorry for the depositers of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, the majority of whom are poor labourers. It may cause some of them to commit suicide and this affect the peace of this locality. There is no reason why the Municipality of Greater Shanghai should not pay attention to this affair. At a tiffin party on February 4 in the Municipal Club I discussed this matter with certain persons. It is expected that within two or three days the work of adjusting the property (? of the concern) will be completed. The Day and Night Bank is an enterprise belonging to the Kung Fah Kung Sz. The property of the Kung Fah Kung Sz is scattered at various places in the French Concession, International Settlement and elsewhere. According to judicial procedure, the Mixed Court can deal only with the property in the French Concession only. If creditors withdraw their case, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai will deal with it as an administrative authority and will collect the views of various parties to bring about a satisfactory arrangement. It is reported that over 10,000 creditors have registered. As soon as the property of the concern has been completed, all the cash money will be distributed among the creditors. The business of the various enterprises belonging to the Kung Fah Kung Sz will be maintained, otherwise it will cause more difficulty when repayment is being made."

Wu Tsung and Pan San Peng, the two Court auditors, have made an investigation into the real estate belonging to the late Huang Chi Chiu and have found that most of the buildings owned by him were built on land leased to him.

1931年2月5日。下午译件。

杂项

两名法庭审计员致函宁波商业储蓄银行和中国工业银行，称他们发现日夜银行以黄哲求提供给“范春金融银团”（Van Chun Financial Syndicate，音译）的地契作为担保，向宁波商业储蓄银行借款70万美元，向中国工业银行借款80万美元。因此，审计员警告他们，禁止转让这些地契。

两名法庭审计员昨日致函黄哲求清算委员会聘用的审计员徐永che（Hsu Yoong Che，音译），敦促他提交一份包含公发康社（Kung Fah Kung Sz，音译）股东名单的清单。

据债权人查询，姓袁（Yuan）、叶（Yieh）、王（Waung）、钟（Zung）和邹（Zau）的某些人是公发康社的股东。

大东方药房是由黄哲求在公发康社成立之前创办的。据说黄哲求在该药房的股份价值约为20万美元。

《时报》（China Times）刊登了以下报道：

《时报》记者于昨日下午拜访了上海特别市市长张群将军（General Chang Chun），张市长发表了如下声明：

“我对上海日夜银行的储户表示同情，其中大多数是贫困劳工。这可能导致一些人自杀，从而影响本地区的安宁。上海特别市政府没有理由不关注此事。在2月4日于市政俱乐部举行的午餐聚会上，我与某些人讨论了此事。预计在两三天内，调整该机构财产的工作将完成。日夜银行是隶属于公发康社的企业。公发康社的财产分散在法租界、公共租界及其他各地。根据司法程序，混合法庭只能处理法租界内的财产。如果债权人撤诉，上海特别市政府将以行政当局的身份处理此事，并征求各方意见以达成令人满意的安排。据报道，已有超过10,000名债权人登记。一旦该机构的财产清理完毕，所有现金将分配给债权人。公发康社所属各企业的业务将予以维持，否则将在还款时造成更多困难。”

pages.en:
February 5, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Shen Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The affairs of the Shanghai Day & Night
Bank are in a very chaotic state. The most important
question at present is (1) to find out the number of
shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung Sz who should be made
to accept unlimited liability and (2) to find out the
amount of property belonging to the late Huang Cho Chiu.
The Kung Fah Kung Sz is the owner of the
Great World Amusement Resort, the Shanghai Day & Night Bank,
the Great China Dispensary, the Wen Zien Bath House and
the Foh Chong Cigarette Company.
The Tsi Tien Theatre belongs to the
Great World Amusement Resort, while the Kiu Sin, Foh
Sin and Wuchang cinema theatres are the property of
the Foh Chong Cigarette Company.
The capital of the Kung Fah Kung Sz is
$700,000 of which $120,000 has been invested in the
Great World Amusement Resort, $325,000 in the Shanghai
Day & Night Bank, $140,000 in the Great China Dispensary,
$50,000 in the Wen Zien Bath House and $60,000 in the
Foh Chong Cigarette Company.
The head office of the Great China
Dispensary is at the corner of Foochow and Shantung
Roads. It has established branches on Chekiang Road
and North Szechuen Road as well as at Hangchow and
Hankow. The business of the head office and two
branches in Shanghai is good but the business in
Hangchow and Hankow is bad. The assets and liabilities
can balance. It has a deposit of $90,000 in the Day
and Night Bank.
The business of the Great World Amusement
Resort can be maintained.
The machinery of the Foh Chong Cigarette
Company was recently mortgaged to the Wei Tsong Financial
Syndicate for a loan of $75,000. According to the loan
agreement, the loan is to be paid in instalments. The
first instalment of $6,000 has been paid. The second
instalment is due to-day. The Syndicate desires to
remove the machinery if payment be not forthcoming.
Yesterday the manager of the Foh Chong
Cigarette Company discussed the matter with the two Court
Auditors. It was resolved that the second instalment
be paid to-day according to agreement.
Yesterday the hands continued work in
the factory but the doors of the factory were closed.
The two Court Auditors will notify the
Wei Tsong Financial Syndicate that the business of the
company be carried on as usual.
The business of the Wen Zien Bath House
is small but a profit is made yearly. Its property at
present is valued at $40,000 but its capital is $50,000.
Deposits by its employees amount to $9,000. The bath
house has a deposit of $7,000 in the Day & Night Bank.
The two Court Auditors have issued a
notice announcing that with the exception of depositors
who have registered in a lawyer's offices, all other
depositors must produce their pass books or receipts
to the Office of the two Court Auditors for registration as
Kau Yeeng Che, the auditor of the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation
Committee has not handed over the list of registered
depositors.
pages.zh:
1931年2月5日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九之事。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行的事务处于非常混乱的状态。目前最重要的问题是（1）查明公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）中应承担无限责任的股东人数，以及（2）查明已故黄楚九的财产数额。
公发公司拥有大世界游乐场、上海日夜银行、大中华药房、文仙浴室和福昌烟草公司。
齐天大戏院属于大世界游乐场，而久新、福新和武昌电影院则是福昌烟草公司的财产。
公发公司的资本为70万元，其中12万元投资于大世界游乐场，32.5万元投资于上海日夜银行，14万元投资于大中华药房，5万元投资于文仙浴室，6万元投资于福昌烟草公司。
大中华药房总行位于福州路与山东路转角。它在浙江路、北四川路以及杭州和汉口设有分行。上海总行及两家分行的业务良好，但杭州和汉口的业务不佳。其资产与负债可以相抵。它在日夜银行有9万元的存款。
大世界游乐场的业务可以维持。
福昌烟草公司的机器最近抵押给伟宗银团（Wei Tsong Financial Syndicate），贷款7.5万元。根据贷款协议，贷款需分期偿还。第一期6,000元已支付。第二期应于今日到期。若无法付款，该银团希望搬走机器。
昨日，福昌烟草公司经理与两位法院审计员讨论了此事。决议按照协议于今日支付第二期款项。
昨日工厂工人继续工作，但工厂大门关闭。
两位法院审计员将通知伟宗银团，公司业务照常进行。
文仙浴室的业务规模虽小，但每年均有盈利。其现有财产估值为4万元，但资本为5万元。员工存款总额为9,000元。该浴室在日夜银行有7,000元存款。
两位法院审计员已发布公告，宣布除已在律师办公室登记的储户外，所有其他储户必须向两位法院审计员办公室出示存折或收据以进行登记，因为黄楚九清算委员会的审计员高英池（Kau Yeeng Che，音译）尚未移交已登记储户的名单。

pages.en:
February 6, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times publishes the following
report:-
Last night a reporter of this paper called
upon Tan Nyl Kung (a lawyer engaged by the family of
the late Huang Cho Chiu) who made the following
statement:-
The estate of the late Huang Cho Chiu is
very large. An inventory by experts of his curio,
porcelain, pictures, etc. will require a long time.
It is hoped that the work will be completed within
one week. The land and houses owned by Mr. Huang are
valued at about $1,000,000 and his moveable property
at about $500,000 to $600,000.
Investigations made by me show that Mr.
Huang owed the China Industrial Bank $400,000, the
Ningpo Commercial and Savings Bank $390,000 and the
Van Chun Financial Syndicate $500,000, all secured on
title deeds. He also owed the Day and Night Bank
$1,050,000 and the Great World Amusement Resort
$110,000. However, the value of the property covered
by the title deeds is according to the inventory,
Tls. 1,300,000. This sum with Mr. Huang's other property
will be sufficient to repay Mr. Huang's debts.
The Kung Fah Kung Sz is a partnership; it
has over 200 shareholders and nine directors. Mr. Huang
was one of the shareholders. Nobody knows the number
of shares held by Mr. Huang and this point can only be
cleared up by the investigation which is being made by
the two Court auditors.
A number of creditors thinking that Mr. Huang
was the proprietor of the Kung Fah Kung Sz, have applied
to the French Mixed of the French Concession for an
injunction. However this will not only give no benefit
to the creditors but cause them to suffer more loss.
For instance, if a shop were put up for auction,
$1 worth of goods can be sold for 50 cents only.
I hope that the Social Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai will lose no time
in holding a meeting with the directors of the Kung
Fah Kung Sz with a view to bringing about the resumption
of business by the Day and Night Bank and to maintaining
the business of the Feh Cheng Kung Sz, the Great China
Dispensary, etc.

The "Crystal", a mosquito paper, publishes
the following report:-
Owing to the death of Huang Cho Chiu, the
Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings
Department of the Kung Fah Kung S have gone into
liquidation. The creditors have filed a number of
actions and the court has ordered auditors to attend
to the liquidation. Creditors desire the shareholders
of the Kung Fah Kung S to accept unlimited liability as
the concern is not registered.
According to information received, Huang was
known as the advertising magnate. Besides Huang
himself, other shareholders of this concern were the
late Tau Ping Dueng, Yuan, Yih, Waung, Wang, Chow, Chao
and Chen, with Tai and Hu as supervisors. They might

杂项：

已故黄楚九之事。

《字林西报》刊登如下报道：
昨晚，本报记者拜访了谭倪公（Tan Nyl Kung，音译，已故黄楚九家属聘请的律师），他发表了如下声明：
已故黄楚九的遗产非常庞大。对其古玩、瓷器、字画等进行专家清点需要很长时间。希望这项工作能在一周内完成。黄先生拥有的土地和房屋估值约为100万元，其动产估值约为50万至60万元。
经我调查，黄先生欠中国实业银行40万元，欠宁波商业储蓄银行39万元，欠万春银团（Van Chun Financial Syndicate）50万元，均以地契作为担保。他还欠日夜银行105万元，欠大世界游乐场11万元。然而，根据地契清单，地契所覆盖的财产价值为规平银130万两。这笔款项加上黄先生的其他财产，足以偿还黄先生的债务。
公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）是一家合伙企业；它有200多名股东和九名董事。黄先生是股东之一。无人知晓黄先生持有的股份数量，这一点只能由两位法院审计员正在进行的调查来澄清。
许多债权人认为黄先生是公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）的所有者，已向法租界会审公廨申请禁令。然而，这不仅不会给债权人带来任何好处，反而会使他们遭受更多损失。例如，如果一家商店被拍卖，价值1元的货物只能卖到5角。
我希望上海特别市社会局尽快与公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）的董事举行会议，以期促使日夜银行恢复营业，并维持法成公司（Feh Cheng Kung Sz）、大中华药房等的业务。

小报《晶报》刊登如下报道：
由于黄楚九去世，公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S.）旗下的日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部已进入清算程序。债权人已提起多起诉讼，法院已命令审计员处理清算事宜。债权人要求公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S.）的股东承担无限责任，因为该企业未注册。
据收到的消息，黄氏被称为广告大亨。除了黄氏本人外，该企业的其他股东包括已故陶秉登（Tau Ping Dueng，音译）、袁（Yuan）、伊（Yih）、黄（Waung，音译）、王（Wang）、周（Chow）、赵（Chao）和陈（Chen），戴（Tai）和胡（Hu）为监事。他们可能

February 7, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Yesterday a reporter of the Woo Zung Zoen
News Agency called on Pen Kung Tsia, Chief of the
Social Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai,
with whom he had the following conversation:-
Reporter: Is it true that the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai will undertake the liquidation of
the Shanghai Day and Night Bank and the Great World
Amusement Resort Visitors' Savings Department?
Answer: In all there are 13,000 depositors,
most of whom are poor people. The amount of their
deposits is over $3,000,000. The Municipality of
Greater Shanghai is paying close attention to this
affair. However, a number of depositors have brought
an action in the Mixed Court of the French Concession
which has appointed two auditors and issued injunctions,
while another body of depositors have filed a petition
with the Shanghai Special District Court. Such acts
will simply make the case become more complicated.
Q: May the creditors request the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai to liquidate the Kung Fah Kung Sz?
A: If they do so, the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai will grant the request; otherwise it will not
in a position to interfere with the case as it is now
being dealt with by a Court.
Q: If the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
undertake the work of liquidation, will it endeavour
to find out the names of all the directors of the Kung
Fah Kung Sz?
A: The names of the directors have already
been ascertained and enquiries are being made regarding
the names of the shareholders. If the liquidation be
made under the supervision of the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai, it will not allow the depositors of small
amounts to suffer less. The following points will be
attended to by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai:-
1) The liquidation will be completed as
early as possible.
2) If the business of the enterprises
belonging to the Kung Fah Kung Sz can be maintained, they will
be supported.
3) All the property of the late Huang Cho Chiu
be used for the repayment of his debts.
Q: Will the assets be sufficient to cover
the liabilities?
A: This is hard to say. As soon as the
auditors have compiled a statement of accounts, the
directors and shareholders will be held responsible for
any deficit. The property of the Kung Fah Kung Sz is
valued at about $2,000,000. According to Tan Nyi Kung,
a lawyer representing the Huang Cho Chiu family, the
houses, lands, curios, porcelain, pictures, etc. belonging
to the late Mr. Huang are valued at over $1,000,000.
The directors will not be called upon to pay much.
Besides, the late Mr. Huang was on friendly terms with
many local prominent merchants who consequently should
render assistance.
pages.zh:
1931年2月7日。上午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九之事。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
昨日，《吴淞日报》通讯社记者拜访了上海特别市社会局局长潘公展（Pen Kung Tsia，音译），并与他进行了如下对话：
记者：上海特别市接管上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场游客储蓄部的清算工作，此事属实吗？
答：共有13,000名储户，其中大多数是穷人。他们的存款总额超过300万元。上海特别市正密切关注此事。然而，一部分储户已在法租界会审公廨提起诉讼，该法庭已任命两名审计员并发布禁令，而另一部分储户已向上海特区法院提交诉状。此类行为只会使案件变得更加复杂。
问：债权人是否可以请求上海特别市清算公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）？
答：如果他们提出请求，上海特别市将予以批准；否则，鉴于该案目前正由法院处理，市局无权干涉。
问：如果上海特别市承担清算工作，是否会努力查明公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）所有董事的姓名？
答：董事的姓名已经查明，目前正在查询股东的姓名。如果清算在上海特别市的监督下进行，市局不会让小额储户遭受较少损失（注：此处原文逻辑似有误，结合上下文应意为“不会让小额储户吃亏”或类似含义，但直译为“suffer less”即遭受较少损失，语境上可能指公平对待或确保其利益）。上海特别市将关注以下几点：
1) 尽快完成清算。
2) 如果属于公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）的企业业务能够维持，将予以支持。
3) 已故黄楚九的所有财产均用于偿还其债务。
问：资产是否足以抵偿负债？
答：这很难说。一旦审计员编制出资产负债表，董事和股东将对任何赤字承担责任。公发公司（Kung Fah Kung Sz）的财产估值约为200万元。据代表黄楚九家属的律师谭倪公（Tan Nyi Kung，音译）称，已故黄先生拥有的房屋、土地、古玩、瓷器、字画等估值超过100万元。董事们无需支付太多款项。此外，已故黄先生与许多本地著名商人关系友好，因此他们应提供援助。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
应债权人聘请的律师严鹿倩（Yen Loo Chien，音译）的请求，上海特区法院对以下处所发布了查封令：
上海日夜银行北四川路分行、浙江路分行；派克路的久福公司（Kiu Foh Company）、宗发（Tsong Fah，音译）和大中华药房、王禄泰茶楼、王九芝堂中药店、森泉浴室以及已故黄氏的住所。
据某些来源收到的消息，公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S.）董事名单如下：
黄楚九（ ）、袁丽登（Yuan Li Teng，音译）、伊三斗（Yih San Dau，音译）、赵敬波（Chao Ching Po，音译）、王香甫（Wang Shiang Fu，音译）、陈信吾（Chen Shin Wu，音译）、袁汉荣（Yuan Han Yoong，音译）、戴济才（Tai Chi Tsai，音译）、
监事：周宗庆（Chow Tsung Ching，音译）、邹秉臣（Zau Ping Chen，音译）和张惠增（Chang Hui Tseng，音译）。

律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）在接受记者采访时称，古玩、衣物、卷轴和家具等动产的登记工作已接近尾声。据他估计，这些物品估值超过10万元。
不动产的登记也已开始，估值为100万元。这笔钱足以偿还黄楚九的个人债务。
关于日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部的负债，黄氏家族及其他董事将承担无限责任。

pages.en:
February 10, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
Court Proceedings
At 4.30 p.m. yesterday, the case of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department came before the French Mixed Court.
Yen Loo Ching, the lawyer retained by the creditors, stated that the Shanghai Special District Court had placed a sealing order on the two branches of the Day & Night Bank in the International Settlement.
Pun Shao Fong, chartered accountant, submitted a report on the affairs of the liquidation.
Tee Yien Kee, a lawyer, stated that the divergence of opinions would prove detrimental to creditors.
Loh Fang Ting, a lawyer, asked the Court that during the period of the liquidation of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department, the Great China Dispensary, Poh Chong Cigarette Co., and Yen Tien Bath House be placed in safe keeping because of the approach of the lunar new year which might entail a bigger loss to the creditors.
Judge Chun said that the opinions of the creditors were not uniform, some filing action before the French Mixed Court, some before the Shanghai Special District Court and other appealing to administrative authorities for support. It was also learned that the Municipality of Greater Shanghai was planning to look after the case but it was not known whether this was true or not. Since the creditors have filed their action in that Court they should not have filed another action in the Shanghai Special District Court. Such a state of affairs should be immediately remedied. It should be understood that the Court will deal with the case with justice and that the Court can extend its authority even into the International Settlement and Chinese territory. He hoped that the views of the creditors would be harmonized so that full repayment might be secured.
Lawyer Loh stated that he agreed with the opinion of the procurator, but the Kung Fah Aung S had not registered and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai would not be in a position to render any assistance; moreover the time for such action had passed. The case was now being tried by the Court and if it were to be transferred to the administrative authorities to be dealt with, it would be unlawful, and furthermore there were no such stipulations in the proceedings. If such action be initiated, much trouble would arise in the future and the Court would lose its control over the case. The only thing left to be done at present was to decide the case quickly so that the creditors might obtain some money to pass the lunar new year which was approaching. If it could be settled a day earlier, it would mean a day's less loss, and the poor people would much appreciate the kindness of the Judge.
Teng Yue, a lawyer, asked the Court to devise an appropriate arrangement at an early date to avoid delay and to lighten the burden of the creditors.
Vee Shih Tsung said that the liquidation was similar to a patient taking medicine and that there was hope of future recovery.
pages.zh:
1931年2月10日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
法庭诉讼程序
昨日下午四时三十分，日夜银行与大世界游客储蓄部一案在法公堂审理。
债权人委托律师严鹿颈（音译）陈述，上海特区法院已对位于公共租界内的日夜银行两家分行下达查封令。
注册会计师潘少峰（音译）提交了关于清算事务的报告。
律师丁延基（音译）表示，意见分歧将证明对债权人不利。
律师罗芳庭（音译）请求法庭，在日夜银行与大世界游客储蓄部清算期间，将大中华大药房、宝昌香烟公司及宴天浴室交由保管，因为农历新年临近，这可能会给债权人带来更大的损失。
春法官（音译）表示，债权人的意见并不统一，有的向法公堂提起诉讼，有的向上海特区法院提起诉讼，还有的向行政当局寻求支持。另获悉，大上海市政府正计划处理此案，但不知是否属实。既然债权人已向该法庭提起诉讼，就不应再向上海特区法院提起另一项诉讼。这种状况应立即纠正。应当明白，法庭将公正处理此案，且法庭的管辖权甚至可以延伸至公共租界及中国领土。他希望债权人的观点能够协调一致，以便获得全额偿还。
罗律师表示，他同意检察官的意见，但“公发行”（Kung Fah Aung S，原文如此）未注册，大上海市政府无法提供任何协助；此外，采取此类行动的时机已过。目前案件正由法庭审理，若移交行政当局处理，则属违法，且诉讼程序中并无此类规定。若采取此类行动，将来会引起诸多麻烦，法庭也将失去对案件的控制。目前唯一可做的是迅速裁决此案，使债权人能获得一些资金以度过即将到来的农历新年。若能提前一天解决，就意味着减少一天的损失，贫苦百姓将非常感激法官的恩德。
律师邓岳（音译）请求法庭尽早制定适当安排，以避免延误并减轻债权人的负担。
魏世宗（音译）表示，清算如同病人服药，未来有康复的希望。

pages.en:
February 10, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Chen Tsi Ao said that the divergence of opinions among the creditors was due to the failure of the opposing party to devise appropriate arrangements and to accept the liabilities. Immediate liquidation would calm the public mind.

Yao Cheo I, lawyer retained by the defendant, said that the procedure of bankruptcy in China was very complete. According to custom, business bodies may operate in the liquidation of banks or shops. The decisions rendered by the first and second court to safeguard the books and properties were correct and proper. He opposed the petition of the creditors' lawyer for liquidation, because at present the opinions were not uniform and everything was not being done properly. It was doubtful whether the creditors would be able to bear the heavy expenses of the advertisements in the daily papers and it would give no benefit. He had advised them but they refused to listen to him and it seemed that there must some other reason for it.

Tan Kee Sung, a lawyer, next reported on his investigation into Hung's property.
Lawyer stated that Hung's debts were estimated at more than $1,000,000, but whether there were any false entries in the books was not known. This point should be immediately examined.

Lawyer Yon then asked the Court to order lawyer Yao to produce the books and documents of all shareholders of the Hung Fah Kung S within three days because these might be falsified if delayed.

Yao stated that these documents had been in the possession of Zee Yoong Tso, auditor, after Hoang's death. He would produce them if they were with him.

Judge Chin accepted the petition of the creditors and ordered Fan and Y to proceed with the liquidation of the accounts of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department.

The Subsidiaries of the Hung Fah Kung S.

The following is a list of the branches of the Hung Fah Kung S:-
The Hung Fah Kung S established the Shanghai Day & Night Bank, Great World Amusement Resort, Great China Dispensary, Poh Chong Kung S and Yen Tien Bath House.

The Shanghai Day & Night Bank established branches on North Chekiang and North Szechuen Roads.

The Great World Amusement Resort established the Visitors Savings Department and the Amusement Resort.

The Amusement Resort established the Zee Tien Wu Kai Theatre.

The Great China Dispensary established four branch offices at the following places: Hankow, Hangchow, Small East Gate, Shanghai, and North Szechuen Road, Shanghai.

The Poh Chong Kung S established the following cinemas: Poh Chong, Kiu Sing and Suchang.

February 10, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

The Kung Fah Kung S has a capital of $700,000
and this capital has been used as follows:-
Shanghai Day & Night Bank $120,000, Great World
Amusement Resort $325,000, Great China Dispensary $140,000,
Foh Chong Kung S $60,000 and Yen Tien Bath House $50,000.
This distribution of the capital of the Kung
Fah Kung S is based on the account books of the company.
(The account books require investigation).
According to the account books of the Shanghai
Day & Night bank its capital is $500,000. There is a false
account of $375,000 arranged like this: paid the Great World
$325,000 and to the Yen Tien $50,000 on mortgage account.
But in fact these sums had not been paid at all. This is
why the capital of the Shanghai Day & Night Bank is given
as $500,000, and in fact the capital is only $125,000.
The $325,000 is the capital of the Great World Amusement
Resort and the $50,000 is the capital of the Yen Tien Bath
House. This can be found out in the list of investments
of the Kung Fah Kung S. Though these 2 concerns are under
the control of the Kung Fah Kung S, the capital of each was
transferred to the Shanghai Day & Night Bank's account. So
the Kung Fah Kung S did not pay anything to the Great World
Amusement Resort or to the Yen Tien Bath House. The
Shanghai Day & Night Bank is under the control of the
Kung Fah Kung S. Therefore, the responsible person is
the Kung Fah Kung S.
The following measures should be adopted to
deal with the liquidation:-
1) The scope of the liquidation.
For the benefit of creditors, the liquidation
should deal with the Shanghai Day & Night Bank and the
Great World Visitors Savings Department as the responsible
persons.
2) Notice of liquidation.
Liquidation will take place as soon as
possible. Creditors will suffer if the liquidation
is delayed.
3) Steps for the liquidation.
The duties of the liquidation are: to
register creditors, to adjust the accounts, to demand
payment of debts due to the company, to distribute the
property, to fix the responsibilities of the shareholders
and to repay liabilities. The registration of creditors
and the scrutiny of books are now in progress, while for
the other duties there must be a rule to carry out the
liquidation:-
(a) Rule of settling the obligations.
The depositors of the Day & Night Bank and
the Great World Visitors Savings Department are all men
of middle and poor classes and therefore their interests
should be protected. The measures for repayment will be
by (1) savings deposit, (2) current deposit, (3) interest
on savings deposit and (4) interest on current deposit.
(b) Rule to demand payment of debts due.
In order that the creditors may not be made
to suffer any loss, it is necessary to demand payment of
debts owing to the company by Hung Cho Chiu, Great World
Amusement Resort, Foh Chong Kung S, Great China Dispensary,
Kiu Feh Kung S, Tseng Fah Dispensary, Can Hsin Real Estate
Co., etc. The family of Hung Cho Chiu must present all
their property to clear up the debts owed by Hung and
others must do likewise. In this way the liabilities
of the Kung Fah Kung S will be reduced.

杂项

“公发行”（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）资本为70万美元，该资本使用情况如下：-
上海日夜银行12万美元，大世界游乐场32.5万美元，大中华大药房14万美元，佛昌公司（Foh Chong Kung S，音译）6万美元，宴天浴室5万美元。
“公发行”的这种资本分配是基于公司的账簿。（账簿需要调查）。
根据上海日夜银行的账簿，其资本为50万美元。其中有37.5万美元的虚假账目，安排如下：以抵押账户名义支付给大世界32.5万美元，支付给宴天5万美元。但实际上这些款项根本未支付。这就是为什么上海日夜银行的资本列为50万美元，而实际资本仅为12.5万美元。这32.5万美元是大世界游乐场的资本，5万美元是宴天浴室的资本。这在“公发行”的投资清单中可以查到。虽然这两家企业受“公发行”控制，但各自的资本都转入了上海日夜银行的账户。因此，“公发行”并未向大世界游乐场或宴天浴室支付任何款项。上海日夜银行受“公发行”控制。因此，责任人是“公发行”。
应采取以下措施处理清算：-
1) 清算范围。
为了债权人的利益，清算应以责任人的身份处理上海日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部。
2) 清算通知。
清算将尽快进行。若清算延误，债权人将遭受损失。
3) 清算步骤。
清算的职责包括：登记债权人、调整账目、催收欠公司的到期债务、分配财产、确定股东责任以及偿还债务。目前正在进行债权人登记和账册审查，而对于其他职责，必须有一套规则来执行清算：-
(a) 清偿债务的规则。
日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部的储户均为中下层民众，因此应保护他们的利益。还款措施将按以下方式分类：(1) 储蓄存款，(2) 活期存款，(3) 储蓄存款利息，(4) 活期存款利息。
(b) 催收到期债务的规则。
为了使债权人不受任何损失，有必要向黄楚九、大世界游乐场、佛昌公司（Foh Chong Kung S，音译）、大中华大药房、久飞公司（Kiu Feh Kung S，音译）、曾发药房（Tseng Fah Dispensary，音译）、灿新地产公司（Can Hsin Real Estate Co.，音译）等催收欠公司的债务。黄楚九的家属必须交出其全部财产以清偿黄所欠债务，其他人也必须照此办理。通过这种方式，“公发行”的负债将减少。

Great World Visitors Savings Department as the responsible

possible. Creditors will suffer if the liquidation

should be protected. The measures for repayment will be

(b) Rule to demand payment of debts due.

Amusement Resort, Foh Chong Sung S, Great China Dispensary,

杂项

方筏松号（Fang Fah Sung S）资本为70万元，该资本使用情况如下：上海日夜银行12万元，大世界游乐场32.6万元，大中华药房14万元，福昌松号（Foh Chong Sung）4万元，孙海地产公司8万元。
上述方筏松号资本分配情况系依据该公司陈述。（账册正在清算中）。
据上海日夜银行第二套账册显示，其资本为50万元。其中存在一笔37.6万元的虚假账目，安排方式如下：大世界32.6万元列于第XX号账户，属抵押账户。但实际上这些款项根本未予支付。这就是为何该公司申报资本为50万元，而实际资本仅为12万元的原因。
这32.6万元是大世界游乐场的资本，8万元是孙海浴室的资本。这一点可从方筏松号的投资清单中看出。由于这些账目受方筏松号控制，各方的资本均被转入上海日夜银行账户。因此，方筏松号并未向大世界游乐场或孙海浴室支付任何款项。上海日夜银行受方筏松号控制。因此，所显示的实际资本归属方筏松号。
为处理清算事宜，应采取以下措施：
1) 清算范围。
为保障债权人利益，清算应以上海日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的相关责任人为对象。
2) 清算公告。
清算将尽快进行。若清算延误，债权人将遭受损失。
3) 清算步骤。
清算人的职责包括登记债权人、调整账目、追收公司到期债权、分配财产、确定股东责任以及偿还债务。目前正在进行债权人登记及账册审查工作，而对于其他职责，必须制定规则以执行清算：
(a) 债务清偿规则。
日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的储户均为中下层民众，故应保护其利益。还款措施将按以下顺序进行：(1) 储蓄存款，(2) 活期存款，(3) 储蓄存款利息，以及 (4) 活期存款利息。
(b) 追收到期债务规则。
为使债权人免受损失，有必要向黄卓秋（Huang Cho Chiu）、大世界游乐场、福昌松号（Foh Chong Sung S）、大中华药房、久筏松号（Kiu Fah Sung S）、广华药房（Kwong Hua Dispensary）、孙海地产公司等追收欠付公司的债务。黄卓秋家属必须交出其全部财产以清偿黄氏等人所欠债务，其他各方亦须照此办理。以此方式，方筏松号的负债得以减少。

HIGH COURT

Chen Tsi Wei said that the divergence of opinions among the creditors was due to the failure of the opposing party to devise appropriate arrangements and to accept the liabilities. An estate liquidation would calm the public mind.

Tso Chao I, lawyer retained by the defendant, said that the procedure of bankruptcy in China was very complete. According to custom, business bodies may mediate in the liquidation of banks or shops. The decisions rendered by the first and second court to safeguard the books and properties were correct and proper. He opposed the petition of the creditors' lawyer for liquidation, because at present the opinions were not uniform and everything was not being done properly. It was doubtful whether the creditors would be able to bear the heavy expenses of the advertisements in the daily papers and it would give no benefit. He had advised them but they refused to listen to him and it seemed that there must some other reason for it.

Tan Hse Wang, a lawyer, next reporter on his investigation into Yang's property.

Lawyer Tan said that Yang's assets were estimated at more than $1,000,000, but whether there were any false entries in the books was not known. This point needed to be locally examined.

Lawyer Tan then asked the Court to order Lawyer Yao to produce the books and documents of all shareholders of the Tung Yan Sung within three days because these might be falsified if delayed.

Yao stated that these documents had been in the possession of Lee Young Soo, auditor, after Huang's death. He would produce them if they were with him.

Judge Chen accepted the petition of the creditors and ordered Tan and Yao to proceed with the liquidation of the accounts of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department.

The Subsidiaries of the Tung Fah Sung Co.

The following is a list of the branches of the Tung Fah Sung Co:-

The Tung Fah Sung Co established the Shanghai Day & Night Bank, Great World Amusement Resort, Great China Dispensary, Poh Chang Sung Co and Yen Lien Bath House.

The Shanghai Day & Night Bank established branches on North Chekiang and North Szechwan Roads.

The Great World Amusement Resort established the Visitors Savings Department and the Amusement Resort.

The Amusement Resort established the Tien Fu Tai Theatre.

The Great China Dispensary established four branch offices at the following places: Hankow, Hangchow, Small East Gate, Shanghai, and North Szechwan Road, Shanghai.

The Poh Chang Sung Co established the following cinemas: Poh Chung, Hiu Sing and Yuchang.

高等法院

陈子威（Chen Tsi Wei）称，债权人之间意见分歧的原因在于对方未能制定适当的安排并承担债务责任。进行资产清算可平息公众情绪。

被告聘请的律师曹兆彝（Tso Chao I）表示，中国的破产程序非常完备。依照惯例，商业团体可在银行或商号的清算中进行调解。初审和二审法院为保全账册及财产所作的裁决正确且适当。他反对债权人律师提出的清算申请，因为目前意见不一，且各项事务处理不当。债权人能否承担在日报上刊登广告的高昂费用尚存疑问，且此举并无益处。他曾向他们提出建议，但他们拒不接受，看来其中必有其他原因。

随后，律师谭熙旺（Tan Hse Wang）汇报了他对杨氏财产的调查结果。

谭律师称，杨氏资产估计超过100万元，但账册中是否存在虚假条目尚不清楚。此点需在当地进行核查。

谭律师随即请求法院命令姚律师在三日内提交通衍松号（Tung Yan Sung）所有股东的账册及文件，因为若予拖延，这些文件可能会被篡改。

姚氏表示，自黄氏去世后，这些文件一直由审计员李永寿（Lee Young Soo）保管。若文件在他处，他将予以提交。

陈法官接受了债权人的申请，并命令谭氏和姚氏着手进行日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的账目清算工作。

通筏松公司（Tung Fah Sung Co.）的附属机构

以下为通筏松公司分支机构列表：

通筏松公司设立了上海日夜银行、大世界游乐场、大中华药房、波昌松号（Poh Chang Sung Co.）及燕莲浴室（Yen Lien Bath House）。

上海日夜银行在浙江北路及四川北路设立了分行。

February 10, 1931.
Afternoon Translation.
SPECIAL CABLES

THE SHANGHAI TIMES AND OTHER LOCAL NEWSPAPERS.

The China Times and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
Court Proceedings
At 4.30 p.m. yesterday, the case of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department came before the Special District Court.
Lam Soo Ching, the lawyer retained by the creditors, stated that the Shanghai Special District Court had placed a sealing order on the two branches of the Day & Night Bank in the International Settlement.
Chen Hao Ming, chartered accountant, submitted a report on the affairs of the liquidation.
So Lien Teo, a lawyer, stated that a divergence of opinions would prove detrimental to creditors.
Oh Tang Sing, a lawyer, asked the Court that during the course of the liquidation of the Day & Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department, the Great China Dispensary, and Chung Hwa Cigarette Co., and others might also be placed in safe keeping because of the approach of the lunar new year which might entail a bigger loss to the creditors.
Judge Yuen said that the opinions of the creditors were not uniform, some filing action before the French Mixed Court, some before the Shanghai Special District Court and others appealing to administrative authorities for support. It was also learned that the Municipality of Greater Shanghai was planning to look after the case but it was not known whether this was true or not. Since the creditors have filed their action in that Court they should not have filed another action in the Shanghai Special District Court. Such a state of affairs should be immediately remedied. It should be understood that the Court will deal with the case with justice and that the Court can extend its authority even into the International Settlement and Chinese territory. He hoped that the views of the creditors would be harmonized so that full repayment might be secured.
Lawyer Lam stated that he agreed with the opinion of the procurator, but the Kung Puh Sung S had not registered and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai would not be in a position to render any assistance; moreover the time for such action had passed. The case was now being tried by the Court and if it were to be transferred to the administrative authorities to be dealt with, it would be unlawful, and furthermore there were no such stipulations in the proceedings. If such action be initiated, much trouble would arise in the future and the Court would lose its control over the case. The only thing left to be done at present was to decide the case quickly so that the creditors might obtain some money to pass the lunar new year which was approaching. If it could be settled a day earlier, it would mean a day's less loss, and the poor people would much appreciate the kindness of the Judge.
Teng Yue, a lawyer, asked the Court to devise an appropriate arrangement at an early date to avoid delay and to lighten the burden of the creditors.
Vee Shih Young said that the liquidation was similar to a patient taking medicine and that there was hope of future recovery.

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
法庭诉讼程序
昨日下午四时三十分，日夜银行与大世界游客储蓄部一案在特区法院开庭审理。
债权人委托律师林守清（Lam Soo Ching）陈述称，上海特区法院已对日夜银行位于公共租界内的两家分行下达查封令。
注册会计师陈浩明（Chen Hao Ming）提交了关于清算事务的报告。
律师卓连德（So Lien Teo）陈述称，意见分歧将对债权人不利。
律师欧唐生（Oh Tang Sing）请求法院，在日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部清算期间，鉴于农历新年临近，恐致债权人遭受更大损失，亦应将大中华药房、中华烟草公司等置于保全监管之下。
袁法官表示，债权人意见不一，有的向法公堂提起诉讼，有的向上海特区法院提起诉讼，还有的向行政当局寻求支持。另获悉，大上海市政府正计划介入此案，但不知此消息是否属实。既然债权人已向该法院提起诉讼，便不应再向上海特区法院提起另一诉讼。此种状况应立即予以纠正。须明确的是，法院将公正处理此案，且法院的管辖权可延伸至公共租界及中国地界。他希望债权人的观点能够趋于一致，以便确保获得全额偿付。
林律师表示，他同意检察官的意见，但工部局尚未注册，大上海市政府无法提供任何协助；此外，采取此类行动的时机已过。目前该案正由法院审理，若移交行政当局处理，则属违法，且诉讼程序中并无此类规定。若启动此类行动，将来必生诸多麻烦，法院将失去对该案的控制。眼下唯一可行之举是迅速审结此案，使债权人能获得些许款项以度过即将到来的农历新年。若能提前一日解决，便意味着减少一日的损失，贫苦百姓将十分感激法官的恩德。
律师邓悦（Teng Yue）请求法院尽早制定适当安排，以避免延误并减轻债权人的负担。
魏士英（Vee Shih Young）表示，清算如同病人服药，未来有康复之希望。

LIQUIDATION OF BANKS

French Mixed Court—Action: Sequel to
Death of Mr. Wong Chu-chiu

As a sequel to the death of the late Mr. Wong Chu-chiu, the well-known native medical practitioner, merchant and philanthropist, who, during his lifetime, owned a chain of no fewer than 95 banks, pharmacies, private hospitals, amusement resorts, etc., including the Shanghai Day & Night Savings Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort Savings Department, action was taken in the French Mixed Court before Magistrate Kung to restrain any or all persons from transferring any of the property belonging to the banks and to the deceased's estate pending further orders from the Court.

The action was taken on behalf of some 2,015 depositors of the two banks referred to against the officials of the banks, the total indebtedness of which, according to plaintiffs, amounted to more than $3,700,000.

Counsel appearing in the case were Messrs. Fei Hai-chin, Pian Chia-loo, Tung Yu, Hsu Yen-ning, Tung Tsz, Chen Tse-kao and Yen Li-ching, for plaintiffs, and Mr. Yao Tsao-dee for the manager of the Day & Night Saving Banks.

High Interest

According to plaintiffs, the Day and Night Savings Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort Savings Department were subsidiaries to the Kung Fah Co., of which the late Mr. Wong Chu-chiu was founder and chief shareholder. By means of extensive advertising and promises of high rates of interest, it was alleged, these two institutions were successful in attracting thousands of Chinese, most of whom were women and persons engaged in small trades,

Counsel Threatened

Mr. Yao, for the manager of the Day and Night Savings Bank, said that he did not represent the owners of the late Mr. Wong, or even people thought. He mentioned the revenue some of the shareholders, most of whom were women, had threatened to take him to court because they were told by someone that he was responsible for all the deposits in Mr. Wong's banks. Magistrate Kung issued an order for the detention of all property belonging to the Kung Fah Co. and forbidding the transfer of any of the late Mr. Wong's property pending liquidation of the two banks.

The two court auditors yesterday sent a letter to Mr. Ho, a director of the said bank, requesting him to send at once information containing the names of the shareholders of the said bank.

According to enquiries made by the creditors, certain persons named Kwan, Yieh, Leung, and Lo are shareholders of the Kwong Sun Bank.

The Great Eastern Dispensary was established by Kwang Sze Min prior to the establishment of the Day and Night Bank. It is said that the value of Kwang Sze Min's shares in this dispensary is about $20,000.

The following is a report:-

A reporter of the China Times called upon General Chang Chun, Mayor of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, yesterday afternoon who made the following statement:-

"I am sorry for the depositors of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, the majority of whom are poor labourers. It may cause some of them to commit suicide and thus affect the peace of this locality. There is no reason why the Municipality of Greater Shanghai should not pay attention to this affair. At a tiffin party on February 4 in the Municipal Council I discussed this matter with certain persons. It is expected that within two or three days the work of adjusting the property (of the concern) will be completed. The Day and Night Bank is an enterprise belonging to the Kwong Sun Bank Co. The property of the Kwong Sun Bank Co is scattered at various places in the French Concession, International Settlement and elsewhere. According to judicial procedure, the Mixed Court can deal only with the property in the French Concession only. If creditors withdraw their case, the Municipality of Greater Shanghai will deal with it as an administrative authority and will collect the views of various parties to bring about a satisfactory arrangement. It is reported that over 10,000 creditors have registered. As soon as the property of the concern has been completed, all the cash money will be distributed among the creditors. The business of the various enterprises belonging to the Kwong Sun Bank Co will be maintained, otherwise it will cause more difficulty when repayment is being made."

Su Tsung and Pan Sau Fung, the two court auditors, have made an investigation into the real estate belonging to the late Kwang Chi Chiu and have found that most of the buildings owned by him were built on land leased to him.

February 11, 1931.
Afternoon Translation.

The Shun Pao and Min Kuo Pao publish the following report:-
Yesterday a reporter of the Shun Pao called on Mr. Tseng, the Court Auditor, and was given the following information:-
Creditors will suffer no loss if the property is arranged in a proper manner and repayment will be only a question of time. Now the first thing to do is to sell the buildings of the Bengal Agency & Bank branches on Nanking Road and North Szechuen Road. The negotiations for the sale of the Szechuen Road house are proceeding.
Beginning from yesterday, letters for calling payment of debts owing to the company have been sent out. All payments received will be deposited in a reliable bank and will be used to repay the savings of unfixed deposits in the near year.
The second step is to realize the fixed deposits and current accounts. The third step is to repay the interest.
Mr. Tseng, a Court Auditor, said in an interview with the Shun Pao, that he has retained by the Tseng's family, to assume the duties of the private property of the late Wang Yu Ju. List of this property will be made public two weeks after registration. Creditors will be repaid by instalments. Eight members of the old staff will be retained at the head office of the Bengal Agency & Bank, while three men will be retained in the branch offices with a similar number at the Great World Visitors Savings Department.
The reporter of the Min Kuo Pao then called on Mr. Tseng who stated that he is dissatisfied with the attitude of the creditors. He further stated that the property of the late Wang Yu Ju is enough to cover his debts. Creditors will be safe after the completion of the registration.
At 7 p.m. yesterday the Creditors Committee held its 14th meeting and the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the Committee devise means to deal with the case till the Municipality of Greater Shanghai deals with the liquidation.
2) To submit a report to the Municipality on the registered creditors.
3) To engage several managers from the Banking Committee to assist in the work.

February 12, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and Shun Pao Publish the following report:-
At 4 p.m. yesterday, General Chang Chun, the Mayor of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, called a meeting to discuss the affairs of the affairs of the late Huang Cho Chiu. Yu Yah Ching( ), Wang Shiao Lai( ), Wang Yen Seeng( ), the former members of the Liquidation Committee, and Pan Kung Chai, the Chief of the Bureau of Social Affairs, were present.
General Chang Chun and Yu Yah Ching suggested that repayment of the debts of the late Huang Cho Chiu be made according to the extent of his present property. If it be not sufficient then arrangements be made to raise money so that the people may not be made to suffer any loss.
It is reported that General Chang Chun had a conference on February 3 with Yang Zau Yuin ( ), the president of the Shanghai Special District Court, Chium Siang ( ), the Magistrate of the French Mixed Court, and Mr. Yue Yah Ching ( ). A further conference will be held upon the return of Yue Yah Ching from Nanking.
The Creditors Committee, 231 Lloyd Road, has received an order from the Bureau of Social Affairs stating that their petition has been referred to the Municipality.
A representative of the Committee has requested Mr. Yue Yah Ching to hasten the conference to be held by the Municipality so that small depositors might expect repayment before the lunar new year.
Mr. Yue Yah Ching has promised to make public the result of his conference with the authorities.
The Great World Visitors Savings Department belongs to the Shanghai Day & Night Bank and not to the Great World. The See Tien Wu Dah Theatre, the Hsing Semfectionery and Ling Loong Koh Barber Shop are also under the control of the Great World.
On February 11, Messrs. Woo Tsung and Pan Zau Paung, chartered accountants, appointed by the French Mixed Court, sent a letter to the Kung Fah Company requesting it to produce the partnership agreement with the late Huang Cho Chiu and the list of shareholders of the company.
In reply, the Kung Fah Company states that no partnership agreement exists and that a list of shareholders is not available. The reason given is as follows:-
About 10 years ago, Huang Cho Chiu established a Night Exchange in the Great World Amusement Resort. After the winding up of the exchange due to business depression, Huang Cho Chiu, who desired to recoup the loss suffered by the shareholders of the Exchange, organized the Kung Fah Company with which the Great World, the Day & Night Bank, the Chun Sian Dispensary, the Fah Cheng Tobacco Company, and the Wen Zien Bath House were amalgamated. The shares of the Exchange were made the shares of the Kung Fah Company at 50% discount. As Chairman of the Board of Directors and General Manager, Huang Cho Chiu controlled the company

杂项：

已故黄楚九之事。

《字林西报》和《申报》刊登如下报道：
昨日下午4时，大上海市政府市长张群将军召开会议，讨论已故黄楚九之事。出席者包括清算委员会前成员余亚青（音译）、王晓籁（音译）、王延松（音译）以及社会局局长潘公展。
张群将军和余亚青（音译）建议，应根据已故黄楚九现有财产的范围来偿还其债务。如果不足，则应安排筹款，以免民众遭受任何损失。
据报道，张群将军于2月3日与上海特区地方法院院长杨兆鋆（音译）、法租界会审公廨审判员邱翔（音译）以及余亚青（音译）先生举行了会议。待余亚青（音译）从南京返回后，将举行进一步会议。
位于劳合路231号的债权人委员会已收到社会局的命令，称其请愿书已转呈市政府。
委员会代表请求余亚青（音译）先生加快市政府即将举行的会议，以便小储户有望在农历新年前获得还款。
余亚青（音译）先生承诺将公布其与当局会议的结果。
大世界游客储蓄部隶属于上海日夜银行，而不属于大世界。见天舞台（音译）、亨生食品店和灵龙阁理发店也受大世界控制。
2月11日，法租界会审公廨委任的特许会计师吴宗（音译）和潘兆邦（音译）先生致函公发公司，要求其出具与已故黄楚九的合伙协议及公司股东名单。
公发公司在回复中称，不存在合伙协议，且无法提供股东名单。所给理由如下：
约10年前，黄楚九在大世界游乐场设立了一家夜间交易所。后因业务萧条，该交易所停业清理，黄楚九为了弥补交易所股东的损失，组织了公发公司，并将大世界、日夜银行、春仙药房、法成烟草公司和文天浴室合并。交易所的股份以五折折算为公发公司的股份。作为董事长兼总经理，黄楚九控制了该公司

on Woo Tseng, an auditor, with whom he had the following
conversation:-
Question: What about the liquidation?
Have you submitted a report to the Mixed Court of the
French Concession?
Answer: As the case is exceedingly
complicated, it is very difficult to check all the
accounts; therefore no report has been sent to the
Mixed Court.
Q.: Is it true that the Great China Dispensary
and the Wen Zien Bath House are to be sold?
A.: Yes, but no decision has so far been
reached although discussion is proceeding. As the
business of these enterprises is good, they will not
be sold at a cheap price.
Q.: Is it true that the small creditors
will be paid before the Lunar New Year?
A.: I am afraid that this cannot be done.
Q.: Will the case be tried again by the
Mixed Court before the Lunar New Year Eve?
A.: No.

The reporter of this paper also called on
Pang Chi, a lawyer engaged by the Van Chun Financial
Syndicate, to enquire about the loan of $500,000 to
Huang Cho Chiu and was informed that the sum was loaned
January 12 on the security of houses built on the leased
land, etc. The amount of the loan was $260,000.
According to the agreements drawn up by the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank with the China Industrial Bank and
the Ningpo Commercial and Savings Bank, the Day and Night
Bank was to have provided $1,800,000 in notes from the two
banks but the amount actually loaned was only $680,000.
In addition, Yu Yah Ching acted as guarantor. For this
reason, the Syndicate may ask the guarantor to pay the
debt.
pages.zh:
1931年2月13日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九之事。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
国闻通讯社记者昨日采访了余亚青（音译），他发表了如下声明：
“关于上海日夜银行问题，大上海市政府市长张群将军等人已举行多次会议， devising 适当的措施来处理清算事宜。所有出席会议的人都愿意提供协助。然而，我希望（1）上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场游客储蓄部的所有债权人能够团结起来，而不是分成派系；（2）债权人应避免打折出售其储蓄存单。”

《字林西报》刊登如下报道：
本报记者昨日拜访了审计员吴增（音译），并与他进行了如下对话：
问：清算情况如何？你们是否已向法租界会审公廨提交报告？
答：由于案情极其复杂，核对所有账目非常困难；因此尚未向会审公廨发送报告。
问：大华药房和文天浴室是否真的要出售？
答：是的，虽然讨论正在进行，但迄今尚未做出决定。由于这些企业的业务良好，它们不会以低价出售。
问：小债权人真的会在农历新年前得到偿付吗？
答：恐怕做不到。
问：此案会在除夕前由会审公廨再次审理吗？
答：不会。

本报记者还拜访了万春银团聘请的律师庞奇（音译），询问向黄楚九提供的50万美元贷款一事，获悉该笔款项于1月12日借出，抵押品为建在租界土地上的房屋等。贷款金额为26万美元。
根据上海日夜银行与中国工业银行及宁波商业储蓄银行签订的协议，日夜银行本应从这两家银行获得180万元的票据，但实际贷款金额仅为68万元。此外，余亚青（音译）担任担保人。因此，银团可能会要求担保人偿还债务。

pages.en:
February 14, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUNG CHO CHIU

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
Ching Shih Zung, Tsoo Sung Bing, Leh Ping Yen, Tsai Veng Ping, Yuan Lee Lai and Zu Yuien Zeng, representatives of the Creditors Committee, yesterday visited the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and later called on Yu Yan Ching and Yuan Lee Tung.
Yu Yah Ching stated that he would continue the discussions with the Municipality and Wang Shao Lai. General Chang Chun, the Mayor of the Municipality, has engaged Dr. John Wu, Zeng Ping Hsu and Zien Lien Kwei as lawyers (without fee) to handle the cases in the French Mixed Court. They will save creditors from loss.
Mr. Yu Yah Ching added that the following liquidations will take place:-
1) The liquidation of the five subsidiaries of the Kung Fah Kung S/
2) The liquidation of the property of the late Huang Che Chiu's property/
The directors of the Kung Fah Kung S are to be made responsible for the liabilities and it is hoped that the Municipality would render assistance.
Funds are expected from the following sources:-
I) The Great China Dispensary whose value is estimated at $200,000.
2) The Wen Zien Bath House; value $50,000.
3) The Foh Chang Tobacco Co. ; value $1,800,000 but only $300,000 may be advanced.
4) Huang's property; about $400,000.
Yu Yah Ching further stated that he would hold himself responsible and requested creditors not to worry.
The representatives then called at the Municipality and were received by an official who accepted their petition. The result will be announced later.
Yuan Li Tung was next interviewed and he declared that he would follow Yu Yah Ching's views.
The registration of creditors at Pei Kya Lo's place has been transferred to the office of Pan Zau Paung, the Court auditor. There are in all 2095 creditors with a total deposit of $15,215.89 and $25,480.112.
The creditors registered with Yen Loo Ching were transferred to Pei Kya Lo's office. In all there are 370 creditors with deposits amounting to $77,869.75 and $381.47.
The advertisement for the sale of the Wen Zien Bath House is published from to-day by Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Paung, the Court auditors.
Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Paung, the Court auditors, have decided to call a meeting with the shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S on February 18.
A letter was sent by Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Paung to the Tseng Fah Dispensary demanding payment of $10,000 and $4,018.21 due to the Shanghai Day and Night Bank branches. It was found from the account books of the head office of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank that they had been advanced $208,798.309 from the Tseng Fah Dispensary of which $86,280.288 had been repaid. The procedure of receiving and paying will be decided.
pages.zh:
1931年2月14日。上午译文。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：—
债权人委员会代表郑世宗、朱松炳、乐平炎、蔡文炳、袁礼来及朱友仁曾，昨日前往上海特别市政府拜访，随后又拜会了虞洽庆和袁履登。
虞洽庆表示，他将继续与市政府及王绍莱进行商讨。市长张群将军已聘请吴经熊博士、徐平恕及钱联桂为律师（无偿），以在法公堂处理相关案件。他们将使债权人免受损失。
虞洽庆先生补充说，将进行以下清算：—
1) 公发公司五家子公司的清算/
2) 已故黄楚九财产的清算/
公发公司的董事须对债务承担责任，希望市政府能提供协助。
预计资金将来自以下来源：—
I) 大中华大药房，估值20万美元。
2) 温泉水浴室；价值5万美元。
3) 福昌烟草公司；价值180万美元，但仅可预支30万美元。
4) 黄氏财产；约40万美元。
虞洽庆进一步表示，他将自行承担责任，并请债权人不必担忧。
随后，代表们前往市政府，由一名官员接待并接受了他们的请愿书。结果将稍后公布。
接着采访了袁履登，他表示将遵循虞洽庆的意见。
在北嘉路处的债权人登记已移交至法院审计员潘祖邦的办公室。共有债权人2095名，存款总额为15,215.89美元及25,480.112美元。
在颜鲁清处登记的债权人已移交至北嘉路办公室。共有债权人370名，存款金额为77,869.75美元及381.47美元。
法院审计员吴宗及潘祖邦自今日起刊登出售温泉水浴室的广告。
法院审计员吴宗及潘祖邦决定于2月18日召集公发公司股东开会。
吴宗及潘祖邦致函增华大药房，要求支付欠上海日夜银行分行的10,000美元及4,018.21美元。经查上海日夜银行总行账簿，发现该行已从增华大药房预支208,798.309美元，其中已偿还86,280.288美元。收支程序待定。

pages.en:
The following advertisement for the sale of
the Wen Zien Bath House appears in the Sin Wan Pao:-
    We, the auditors, have been ordered by the French
Mixed Court to liquidate the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
and the Great World Visitors Savings Department. This
has already been published in the papers.    The Wen
Zien Bath House is mortgaged to the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and we have been given authority by the French
Mixed Court to sell the Wen Zien Bath House first. Those
who are interested may open negotiations with us.
                    Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Peng, Court auditors.
                Office of the auditors: 14, Hunan Road.

    我等审计员奉法公堂命令，清算上海日夜银行
及大世界游客储蓄部。此事已在报端公布。    温
泉水浴室已抵押给上海日夜银行，且我等已获法公
堂授权，优先出售温泉水浴室。有意者可与

                审计员办公室：湖南路14号。

pages.en:
THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
A reporter of the Woo Zung Zeen News Agency
yesterday called on Pan Kung Tsia, Chief of the Social
Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to
enquire about the liquidation of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank.
He was informed that the object of the
Municipality was to protect the interests of the
depositors most of whom are poor people but as the
case was being dealt with by a Court, the Municipality
was not in a position to at once take up the matter.
However the Social Bureau has been instructed to supervise
the liquidation and that Dr. John Wu Ching Yung,
Chen Ding Say, Zing Lien Kuan and Kiang In Ping
(four noted lawyers) have promised to act as lawyers
for the depositors free of charge. The depositors
should call at the offices of these lawyers to give
particulars of their claims. In case there is a deficit,
the directors and shareholders of the bank will be
responsible. Searches are being made secretly for the
list of shareholders.
pages.zh:
已故黄楚九事宜。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：—
伍宗信通讯社记者昨日拜访上海特别市政府社会局局长潘公展，询问上海日夜银行的清算情况。
据悉，市政府旨在保护储户利益，其中大多数为贫民，但由于该案正由法庭处理，市政府无法立即介入此事。
然而，社会局已受命监督清算工作，且吴经庸博士、陈定谟、金联观及江应平（四位著名律师）已承诺无偿担任储户的法律代理人。储户应前往这些律师的办公室提供索赔详情。若出现亏空，银行董事及股东将承担责任。目前正在秘密搜寻股东名单。

pages.en:
February 16, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times publishes the following
report:-
The following letter was sent to Wu Tsung
and Pan Zau Paung, the Court auditors, by Ban Chi, the
lawyer retained by the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate:-
I have transmitted your letter to the Van
Tsung Financial Syndicate (萬春銀團). In reply
the Syndicate states that the misunderstanding contained
in your letter is due to the wrong process adopted by
you in checking accounts.
The Shanghai Day and Night Bank would have
been closed before the death of Huang Cho Chiu if it
had not been supported by the Van Tsung Syndicate which
had been established by the Loong Chong (隆昌) and
Nee Shing (義興) native banks. Yu Yah Ching is a
witness to this. It was decided to secure a loan of
$300,000 from the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate and
another sum of $100,000 from Huang's family to support
the Shanghai Day and Night Bank but it has now been
ascertained that Huang's family had advanced only
$52,000 while the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate had
advanced $293,561.81. This can be verified by the
receipt books.
In the statement of accounts of the
Shanghai Day and Night Bank drawn up by Hsiu Yoon
Tso, the auditor, it was shown that Huang Cho Chiu's
account of $293,561.81 was advanced to the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank by the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate.
I cannot understand why you did not enter
this account when checking the accounts of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank.
Please make an examination into the account
books of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank because from
this you can check the amount of money advanced by the
Van Tsung Financial Syndicate and its expenditure. If
you are still not clear please refer the matter to Hsiu
Yoon Tso for further explanation.
pages.zh:
1931年2月16日。下午译文。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》刊登如下报道：—
万春银团聘请的律师班池致函法院审计员吴宗及潘祖邦，信件内容如下：—
我已将贵函转交万春银团（萬春銀團）。银团回复称，贵函中的误解是由于贵方在核对账目时采用了错误的程序所致。
若非得到由隆昌（隆昌）和义兴（義興）钱庄成立的万春银团的支持，上海日夜银行早在黄楚九去世前就已关闭。虞洽庆可为此作证。原决定向万春银团贷款30万美元，并向黄氏家族借款10万美元，以支持上海日夜银行，但现已查明，黄氏家族仅预支了52,000美元，而万春银团预支了293,561.81美元。此点可由收据簿核实。
在审计员徐云佐编制的上海日夜银行资产负债表中显示，黄楚九账户下的293,561.81美元是由万春银团预支给上海日夜银行的。
我不明白为何贵方在核对上海日夜银行账目时未将此笔款项入账。
请检查上海日夜银行的账簿，因为从中可以核查万春银团预支的金额及其支出情况。若仍有不清楚之处，请咨询徐云佐以作进一步解释。

pages.en:
February 19, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times published the following
report:-
The following letter has been sent to Wu Tsung
and Pan Zen Bang, the Court auditors, by Tang Kee Kung the
lawyer retained by the Huang's family:-
I have transmitted your letter to the Huang's
family. In reply, Huang's family states that the late
Huang Cho Chiu owes the Shanghai Day and Night Bank only
$1,060,000 and not $1,350,000 as you have stated in your
letter. The misunderstanding arose through an omission
on your part to enter into the account an extra deposit
of $211,500.
I have stated in the French Mixed Court that
the late Huang Cho Chiu's property is sufficient to cover
his personal liabilities to the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank. It is not known how much he owes to other people;
therefore it is an open question whether his property will
be sufficient to cover his debts. The late Huang Cho Chiu's
movable and immovable property is based on an estimate made
by a firm of auctioneers but it is to be feared that the
proceeds for the property will be reduced at the main time
of sale.
Most of the late Huang Cho Chiu's property is
immovable. The following two points should be given
consideration:-
(1) The late Huang Cho Chiu's immovable
property and jewelery had been mortgaged. It is not
easy to secure the huge sum necessary to redeem his
property.
(2) That late Huang Cho Chiu's property has
been placed under seal by the French Mixed Court and
cannot be handed over immediately.
pages.zh:
1931年2月19日。下午译文。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》刊登如下报道：—
黄氏家族聘请的律师唐纪功致函法院审计员吴宗及潘振邦，信件内容如下：—
我已将贵函转交黄氏家族。黄氏家族回复称，已故黄楚九仅欠上海日夜银行1,060,000美元，而非贵方信函中所述的1,350,000美元。误解的产生是由于贵方漏记了一笔211,500美元的额外存款。
我已在法公堂声明，已故黄楚九的财产足以抵偿其对上海日夜银行的个人债务。不知其欠他人多少债务；因此，其财产是否足以抵偿债务尚属未知之数。已故黄楚九的动产和不动产基于一拍卖行的估价，但恐怕在主要销售时段，财产所得款项会减少。
已故黄楚九的大部分财产为不动产。应考虑以下两点：—
(1) 已故黄楚九的不动产及珠宝已抵押。筹集赎回其财产所需的巨额资金并非易事。
(2) 已故黄楚九的财产已被法公堂查封，无法立即移交。
