February 21, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHU CHIU.

The China Times publishes the following
report:-
Wu Tseng and Fan Tau Faung, the Court
auditors, have drawn up the following programme of
liquidation:-
1) Up to yesterday more than 9,000 creditors have been
registered and a list of registered
creditors is being drawn up.
2) Payments of accounts due to the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and its branches will be demanded.
3) With regard to the liabilities of the subsidiaries
of the Kung Fah Kung S such as the Great China
Dispensary and Foh Chong Tobacco Company, it is planned
to sell the Great World Amusement Resort to
meet the payments.
The Foh Chong Tobacco Company has been
sealed by the Shanghai Special District Court. A
conference with the creditors of the Foh Chong Tobacco
Company will be held.
There are two ways to deal with the
Great China Dispensary: one is to sell it and the other
is to sell it at the face value of its shares.
When Hsu Yoong Tsoo was undertaking
the liquidation he took charge of all cash money from
the Great China Dispensary and its branches. A letter
has been sent to Hsu Yoong Tsoo to demand the transfer
of the cash.
The most suitable measures for the
liquidation will be fixed by the French Mixed Court.
Dr. John Wu who has been retained
by the Chun Fah Dispensary has sent the following letter
to Wu Tseng and Fan Tau Faung, auditors, in reply to their
enquiry (published in this paper of February 14):-
On behalf of the Chun Fah Dispensary,
I acknowledge receipt of your letter enquiring into some
of the items in the account books of the head office of
the Day and Night Bank and demanding settlement of same
with interest.
In reply, I have to state that the
Dispensary has a debit balance due to the Hongkew and
the Chekiang Road branches of the Day and Night Bank,
but the amount is slightly different from that mentioned
in your letter. The head office of the Day and Night
Bank owes this Dispensary a sum of $12,000. If there
be any deficit, we shall repay the amount with interest.
With regard to the amount of more
than $200,000 which the head office of the Day and Night
Bank received from this Dispensary on January 19, this
sum was made up of cheques which this Dispensary received
from various business houses. Subsequently this
Dispensary drew $20,000 to pay the accounts due to
branch offices. Though the sum is slightly different
from that mentioned in your letter, you can check the
accounts of these offices; furthermore this Dispensary
hold cheques and bank receipt books as proof.
pages.zh:
1931年2月21日。晨间译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》刊登如下报道：-
法院审计员吴曾（Wu Tseng）与范陶方（Fan Tau Faung）制定了如下清算方案：-
1) 截至昨日，已有9,000多名债权人登记，正在编制登记债权人名单。
2) 将要求偿还欠上海日夜银行及其分行的账款。
3) 关于孔发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）下属子公司如大中华药房和福昌烟草公司的债务，计划出售“大世界”游乐场以偿付欠款。
福昌烟草公司已被上海特区地方法院查封。将与福昌烟草公司的债权人举行会议。
处理大中华药房有两种方式：一是将其出售，二是按其股票面值出售。
徐永祚（Hsu Yoong Tsoo）在进行清算时，接管了大中华药房及其分行的所有现金。已致函徐永祚，要求移交该笔现金。
最合适的清算措施将由法国会审公廨确定。
受春发药房聘用的吴约翰博士（Dr. John Wu）已致函审计员吴曾与范陶方，回复他们的查询（发表于本月14日本报）：-
我代表春发药房，确认收到贵方来函，查询日夜银行总行账簿中的某些项目，并要求连本带利结清这些款项。
兹回复如下：本药房对日夜银行虹口分行及浙江路分行负有借方余额，但金额与贵方信函中所述略有不同。日夜银行总行欠本药房12,000元。如有赤字，我们将连本带利偿还。
关于日夜银行总行于1月19日从本药房收到的20余万元款项，该笔款项由本药房从各商号收到的支票组成。随后，本药房提取20,000元用于支付欠分行的账款。虽然金额与贵方信函中所述略有不同，但贵方可核查这些分行的账目；此外，本药房持有支票和银行收据簿作为凭证。

pages.en:
February 22, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The Foh Chong Tobacco Company was placed
under a sealing order by the Shanghai Special District
Court as a result of an action filed by the Mei Hwa, the
You Nee, the Mei Foong and the Lien Mei Tobacco Companies
for monies due to them and for dishonoured cheques. They
have requested that Huang Hsi Chun and Huang Hsi Yau, sons
of the late Huang Cho Chiu, and Yau Chi Shien, manager of
the Foh Chong Tobacco Company, be ordered to pay the debts.
The case was brought before the Court
yesterday morning. The Wei Chun Company (American
concern) and the New World Hotel (both being represented)
were interested. The former claimed that the property
of the Foh Chong Tobacco Company had been mortgaged,
while the latter demanded the payment of rent due. They
were ordered by the judge to file separate actions.
Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained by Huang
Hsi Chun and Huang Hsi Yau, stated that the defendants
were not very clear about the liabilities of the Foh
Chong Tobacco Company. As this company was one of the
enterprises of the Kung Fah Kung S, it was a subsidiary
to the Kung Fah Kung S, therefore the shareholders of the
Foh Chong Tobacco Company were also shareholders of the
Kung Fah Kung S. Although the late Huang Cho Chiu was
general manager of the Foh Chong Tobacco Company, the
general manager was only responsible for the liquidation.
The death of Huang Cho Chiu has removed his duty to
liquidate. The Kung Fah Kung S was under liquidation
and the extent of the liability of each shareholder was
not known.
Wu Ts Ping, the representative of Yau Chi
Shien, manager of the Foh Chong Tobacco Company, stated
that Yau Chi Shien was only the assistant manager of the
Foh Chong Tobacco Company of which the late Huang Cho Chiu
was general manager. The Foh Chong Tobacco Company was a
subsidiary to the Kung Fah Kung S. The company secured
supplies of tobacco leaf from the plaintiffs who, at the
end of the lunar year, stopped the supply and the company
was compelled to suspend work. The assets of the company
were: property $300,000; sundry debtors $350,000; three
cinemas $100,000; shares $50,000 or $60,000. The
liabilities were: Day & Night Bank $800,000; sundry
creditors $400,000; mortgage to Wei Chun Company $100,000.
There was a deficit balance from $400,000 to
$500,000, which was the loss sustained during the past
few years. The late Huang Cho Chiu was the largest
shareholder of the Kung Fah Kung S as also of the Foh
Chong Tobacco Company. He had discussed with the plaintiffs
the following four steps: (1) the plaintiffs to continue the
supply of tobacco leaf, so that cigarettes could be
manufactured; the proceeds of the sale would be used to
meet the debts; (2) to sell the building and property of
the company; (3) to let the property, and (4) to manufacture
cigarettes for other companies. The plaintiffs could not
agree with the first step; as for the second step there
could not be found an immediate buyer. He requested the
Court not to place sealing orders on the machinery cross-
wise but partially, so that the labourers could resume the
work. The creditors could send men to watch.
The case was adjourned till February 28 when
judgement will be given.
pages.zh:
1931年2月22日。晨间译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
福昌烟草公司因梅花、友尼、美丰及联美烟草公司就欠款及空头支票提起诉讼，被上海特区地方法院下达查封令。原告方请求法院命令已故黄楚九之子黄希俊（Huang Hsi Chun）和黄希尤（Huang Hsi Yau），以及福昌烟草公司经理姚芝仙（Yau Chi Shien）偿还债务。
该案于昨日上午开庭审理。伟均公司（美资企业）和新世界酒店（均有代表出庭）与此案有利害关系。前者声称福昌烟草公司的财产已抵押，后者则要求支付欠租。法官命令他们分别提起诉讼。
黄希俊和黄希尤聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung）表示，被告方对福昌烟草公司的债务情况不是很清楚。由于该公司是孔发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的企业之一，属于孔发公司的子公司，因此福昌烟草公司的股东也是孔发公司的股东。虽然已故黄楚九是福昌烟草公司的总经理，但总经理仅负责清算。黄楚九的去世免除了他的清算职责。孔发公司正处于清算之中，每位股东的责任范围尚不清楚。
福昌烟草公司经理姚芝仙的代表吴子平（Wu Ts Ping）表示，姚芝仙仅是福昌烟草公司的副经理，已故黄楚九任总经理。福昌烟草公司是孔发公司的子公司。该公司从原告处获得烟叶供应，原告在农历年底停止供应，迫使公司停工。公司资产包括：不动产300,000元；各类债务人欠款350,000元；三家电影院100,000元；股票50,000或60,000元。负债包括：日夜银行800,000元；各类债权人400,000元；抵押给伟均公司100,000元。赤字余额在400,000至500,000元之间，这是过去几年遭受的损失。已故黄楚九既是孔发公司也是福昌烟草公司的最大股东。他曾与原告商讨以下四个步骤：(1) 原告继续供应烟叶，以便生产香烟；销售所得用于偿还债务；(2) 出售公司的建筑及财产；(3) 出租财产；以及 (4) 为其他公司代工生产香烟。原告不同意第一步；至于第二步，找不到即时买家。他请求法院不要全面查封机器，而是部分查封，以便工人恢复工作。债权人可以派人监视。
案件延期至2月28日宣判。

pages.en:
February 23, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

February 24, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Pi Chia Loh, lawyer retained by creditors,
then asked the Court to summon Yuan Lee Tung, the
director, in order to clear up the case.
Yen Loo Ching, lawyer on behalf of creditors,
requested the Court to order the manager of the Day and
Night Bank to produce the list of names of shareholders
of the Kung Fah Kung S which list was suspected to be
kept by him.
Yau Shao Dee, representing Chen Ts Chuen,
manager of the Day and Night Bank, stated that lawyer
Yen could not ask the Court to order his client to
produce the list of names of shareholders of the Kung
Fah Kung S on mere presumptions and that the shareholders
Committee was the proper body to be approached to produce
the list.
Magistrate Chuam handed down the following
verdict:-
That the Kung Fah Kung S be liquidated, that the
Huang family be ordered to submit a list of their
property in three days and that the directors and
shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S be also ordered
to produce the list of names of shareholders in
three days.
pages.zh:
1931年2月24日。午后译件。

杂项

债权人聘请的律师毕家洛（Pi Chia Loh）随即请求法院传唤董事袁李东（Yuan Lee Tung），以澄清案情。
代表债权人的律师严鲁清（Yen Loo Ching）请求法院命令日夜银行经理提交孔发公司股东名单，据信该名单由其保管。
代表日夜银行经理陈子全（Chen Ts Chuen）的姚少迪（Yau Shao Dee）表示，严律师不能仅凭推测就请求法院命令其当事人提交孔发公司股东名单，股东委员会才是索取该名单的适当机构。
庄法官作出如下判决：-
命令孔发公司进行清算，命令黄氏家族在三天内提交其财产清单，并命令孔发公司的董事及股东在三天内提交股东名单。

pages.en:
February 24, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
At 3 p.m. yesterday the case of the
liquidation of the Day and Night Bank and the Great
World Visitors Savings Department was tried by
Magistrate Chuan Shiang of the French Mixed Court.
Wu Tseng and Pan Zau Paung, Court auditors,
first stated, "Since the undertaking of the liquidation
of the Day and Night Bank and the Great World Visitors
Savings Department, the registration of creditors and
the checking of accounts are under progress and we have
so far demanded the repayment of debts amounting to
$2,000 due to these concerns. We have also discovered
that properties of the Great China Dispensary, the Feh
Chong Tobacco Company, the Great World Amusement
Resort and the Wen Zien Bath House are insufficient to
meet liabilities. According to Chow Paung Tseng,
manager of the Great China Dispensary, this pharmacy
can be sold for $240,000. Soo Sing Yuan, manager of
the Wen Zien Bath House, states that this house can be
sold for $80,000, but the employees deposit of $9,150
must be refunded. Yan Chi Sien, manager of the Feh
Chong Tobacco Company, states that this company can be
reorganized. As these enterprises are subsidiaries of
the Kung Fah Kung S, the shareholders of the Kung Fah
Kung S should be responsible for their debts in case
assets cannot meet liabilities. On February 14 we
advertised to hold a meeting of shareholders of the
Kung Fah Kung S on February 16, but nobody attended,
and so a liquidation of the Kung Fah Kung S is deemed
necessary".
Lawyer Wu Ts Ping, representing the Great
China Dispensary and the Foh Cheng Tobacco Company,
stated that there were three steps for the Feh Chong
Tobacco Company, (1) to sell the property of the company
which was being undertaken, (2) to let the property or
to manufacture cigarettes for others, in this way a
monthly net profit from $8,000 to $9,000 could be made,
which profit would relinguish the obligations in a few
years, and (3) to sell the company by auction, the
proceeds to repay the debts due to the Day and Night
Bank. As regards the proceeds from the sale of the
Kiu Sing and Foh Sing Cinemas, the money would be paid
to the Wei Chun Financial Syndicate. In consequence
of a liquidation of the Great China Dispensary, its
assets were $470,000 and its liabilities $480,000.
About $240,000 could be secured from the sale of the
pharmacy by auction, and out of this amount, $100,000
would be used to repay debts due to the Day and Night
Bank and the remaining $140,000 would be returned to
the Kung Fah Kung S.
Zee Yee Nien, lawyer retained by creditors,
then requested the Court (1) that the Kung Fah Kung S
be ordered to liquidate, (2) that the Huang family be
ordered to submit a list of their property and (3) that
the shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S be ordered to be
responsible for their obligations and that a list of their
names be immediately submitted to the Court.
Chew Siam An, lawyer retained by creditors,
further requested the Court to order Han Yeung Cho,
auditor, of the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee
to produce the list of shareholders of the Kung Fah
Kung S within three days.
pages.zh:
1931年2月24日。午后译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
昨日下午3时，法国会审公廨庄祥（Chuan Shiang）推事审理了日夜银行及“大世界”游客储蓄部清算案。
法院审计员吴曾与潘祖邦（Pan Zau Paung）首先陈述：“自从承担日夜银行及‘大世界’游客储蓄部的清算工作以来，债权人登记及账目核对工作正在进行中，截至目前，我们已要求偿还欠上述机构的债务共计2,000元。我们还发现，大中华药房、福昌烟草公司（原文拼写为Feh Chong）、‘大世界’游乐场及文珍浴室的财产不足以抵偿债务。据大中华药房经理周邦增（Chow Paung Tseng）称，该药房可售价240,000元。文珍浴室经理苏星元（Soo Sing Yuan）表示，该浴室可售价80,000元，但必须退还员工押金9,150元。福昌烟草公司（原文拼写为Feh Chong）经理严芝仙（Yan Chi Sien，即前文Yau Chi Shien）表示，该公司可以重组。由于这些企业是孔发公司的子公司，若资产不足以抵偿债务，孔发公司的股东应对债务负责。我们于2月14日刊登广告，定于2月16日召开孔发公司股东会议，但无人出席，因此认为有必要对孔发公司进行清算”。
代表大中华药房及福昌烟草公司的律师吴子平表示，福昌烟草公司（原文拼写为Feh Chong）有三个步骤，(1) 出售公司财产，此事正在进行中，(2) 出租财产或为他人代工生产香烟，以此每月可获得8,000至9,000元的净利润，该利润可在几年内清偿债务，以及 (3) 拍卖公司，所得款项用于偿还欠日夜银行的债务。至于出售久兴和福兴电影院的所得款项，将支付给伟均银团。由于大中华药房进行清算，其资产为470,000元，负债为480,000元。通过拍卖药房可获得约240,000元，其中100,000元将用于偿还欠日夜银行的债务，剩余140,000元将归还孔发公司。
债权人聘请的律师谢义年（Zee Yee Nien）随即请求法院 (1) 命令孔发公司进行清算，(2) 命令黄氏家族提交其财产清单，以及 (3) 命令孔发公司股东对其债务负责，并立即向法院提交股东名单。
债权人聘请的律师周西安（Chew Siam An）进一步请求法院命令黄楚九清算委员会审计员韩仰卓（Han Yeung Cho）在三天内提交孔发公司股东名单。

pages.en:
February 25, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times publishes the following
report:-
The Creditors Committee of the Day and
Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings
Department yesterday sent a telegram to the Administrative
Council and the Ministry of Industry of the National
Government with a request that the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai and members of the Shanghai Chinese
Chamber of Commerce be instructed to handle the
liquidation of the Kung Fah Kung S and its subsidiaries
with a view to their relinquishing their obligations
within a short period.
The following is a list of the internal
affairs of the Foh Chong Tobacco Company which concern
is indebted to the Day and Night Bank next only to the
late Huang Cho Chiu:-
Capital.................................$ 60,000.
Factory site............................$300,000.
(Mortgaged to the Wei Chun
Financial Syndicate for
$75,000 to be paid by 12
instalments. First instalment
of $6,250 has been paid and a
nett debt of $68,750 is still
due).
Sundry debtors..........................$350,000.
(These are loans made by
managers. Of this amount
there is the cash deposit
of $60,000 and in fact only
$290,000 are owed the company).
Kiu Sing, Wuchang and Foh Sing Cinemas..$110,000.
Sundry Creditors........................$400,000.
Debts owed to the Day and Night Bank....$800,000.
pages.zh:
1931年2月25日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》刊登如下报道：——
日夜银行债权人委员会及大世界游客储蓄部昨日向国民政府行政院及实业部发出电报，请求指令大上海市政府及上海总商会成员处理公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）及其子公司的清算事宜，以期在短期内解除其债务责任。
以下是福昌烟草公司内部事务清单，该公司欠日夜银行的债务仅次于已故黄楚九：——
资本.................................60,000美元。
厂址.................................300,000美元。
（已抵押给伟春银团，
分12期偿还75,000美元。
首期6,250美元已付，
尚欠净债务68,750美元）。
其他债务人..........................350,000美元。
（这些是经理们放出的贷款。
其中包含现金存款60,000美元，
实际上公司仅被欠款290,000美元）。
久星、武昌及福星电影院........110,000美元。
其他债权人..........................400,000美元。
欠日夜银行债务....................800,000美元。

pages.en:
February 26, 1931. Afternoon translation

MISCELLANEOUS

THE LIQUIDATION OF THE DAY & NIGHT BANK

The China Times and other local
newspapers publish the following report:-
By order of the French Mixed Court,
Messrs. Pan and Woo, Chartered Accountants, are
undertaking the liquidation of the Koong Fah Company.
They have begun to examine the accounts of the
Foh Chong Tobacco Company, the Great China Dispensary
and other business undertakings belonging to the
Koong Fah Company.
The staff of the Savings Department
of the Great World Amusement Resort will be
discharged at the end of this month and the staff
of the Day and Night Bank and of the Branches of
the Bank on Chekiang Road and in Hongkew District
will also be discharged.
The Procurator of the French Mixed
Court yesterday ordered the Koong Fah Company to
submit within three days a list of names of its
Directors, Supervisors, and Shareholders. Lawyer
Tan Yien Koong has also been ordered by the Court
to submit a statement of Huang Cho Chin's
property and a report on the registration of
creditors.
pages.zh:
1931年2月26日。下午译件

杂项

日夜银行之清算

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
奉法国会审公廨命令，潘氏与吴氏特许会计师正在负责公发公司（Koong Fah Company）的清算工作。他们已开始审查属于公发公司的福昌烟草公司、大中华大药房及其他商业企业的账目。
大世界游乐场的储蓄部职员将于本月底解雇，日夜银行及其浙江路分行和虹口区分行的职员也将被解雇。
法国会审公廨检察官昨日命令公发公司在三天内提交其董事、监事及股东名单。法院亦命令谭延恭律师提交黄楚钦（Huang Cho Chin）的财产清单及债权人登记报告。

pages.en:
February 27, 1931. Afternoon translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE SUPPRESSION OF SAVINGS DEPARTMENTS OF SHOPS
AND COMPANIES

The Min Kuo Pao, Sin Wan Pao, and other
local newspapers publish the following report:-
Acting in accordance with an order
from the Ministry of Finance, the Bureau of Social
Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai,
yesterday notified the various shops and companies
to close their savings departments within one week.
The China Underwear Company stopped
the receipt of savings from yesterday. It will
repay the deposits from March 25. Current savings
will be repaid in 10 instalments and fixed deposits
will either be refunded or turned into shares of the
company.
The Great China and Great Eastern
Dispensaries have not yet decided upon any definite
plans to deal with the deposits.
The Dong Chong Cycle and Motors Company
continues to meet current deposits when drawn upon,
but is not repaying fixed deposits because the
matter is still under consideration.
The Sincere and Wing On Companies
are carrying on their savings business as usual
pending instructions from their head offices at
Hongkong.
The Sun Sun Company has stopped
the receipt of savings but continues to pay out
deposits.
The World Book Company, Foochow Road,
will convert its savings department into a bank.
As a license has been secured from the Ministry of
Finance, the Bank will be inaugurated soon under the
name of "The World Bank".

BUREAU OF FINANCE TO ENTERTAIN REPORTERS

The Min Kuo Pao, Sin Wan Pao and other
local newspapers publish the following report:-
Baung Hai Kong, Chief of the Bureau
of Finance of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai,
will entertain newspaper reporters at the Koong Yui
Club in the Municipality Building, Peeng Ling Jao,
at 6 p.m. March 3, when he will make a report on
the important work done by the Bureau.
pages.zh:
1931年2月27日。下午译件。

杂项

取缔商店及公司储蓄部

《民国日报》、《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
大上海市政府社会局遵照财政部命令，于昨日通知各商号及公司在一周内关闭其储蓄部。
中国内衣公司自昨日起停止接收储蓄存款。该公司将从3月25日起偿还存款。活期储蓄将分10期偿还，定期存款要么退还，要么转为公司股份。
大中华大药房和大东方大药房尚未就如何处理存款制定任何确切计划。
东昌自行车汽车公司继续兑付提取的活期存款，但因该事项仍在考虑中，故不偿还定期存款。
先施公司和永安公司正等待其香港总行的指示，在此期间照常经营储蓄业务。
新新公司已停止接收储蓄存款，但继续支付存款。
福州路的世界书局将其储蓄部改为银行。由于已获得财政部的执照，该银行不久将以“世界银行”之名开业。

财政局将招待记者

《民国日报》、《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
大上海市政府财政局局长鲍海康将于3月3日下午6时在蓬莱路市政府大楼内的公余俱乐部招待报社记者，届时他将报告财政局所做的重要工作。

pages.en:
March 2, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report on March 1:-
Yesterday the Shanghai Special District
Court handed down the following verdict in favour of
Tsao Ts Ching of the Mei Hwa Tobacco Company and
others who had filed an action against the Foh Cheng
Tobacco Company for repayment of money due:-
"The Foh Cheng Tobacco Company is to
repay to Tsao Ts Ching and others a sum of $172,131.45
being value of goods due to them. Yau Chi Sien is to
be held responsible for the liquidation of the Foh
Chong Tobacco Company and Huang Shien Yau and Huang
Shien Tsong are to make good the balance."
Min Tsai Chuang, manager of the Great
World Amusement Resort, was interviewed by a newspaper
reporter yesterday and made the following statement:-
"The site of the Great World Amusement
Resort, the Tien Tien Wu Tai Theatre and the Day and
Night Bank can be leased out at $3,350 a month or
$40,000 a year. If anybody desires to rent the site,
he must first pay a rent deposit of $100,000. This
money can be used to repay a portion of the debts
owing by the Great World Amusement Resort. In ten
years $1,000,000 can be obtained for the repayment of
the debts. In twenty years $2,000,000 can be obtained
and the money can be used to repay three-fourths of the
liabilities of the Kung Fah Kung S. The property of
the Great China Dispensary, Wen Tien Bath House and
the Huang's family will be sufficient to meet the
liabilities. I have submitted to the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, the Social Bureau and Pan Tau
Paung and Wu Tseng, Court auditors, for consideration
the following measures to repay the debts by instalments
within 30 years. The repayment of debts by instalments
within 30 years can be effected by letting the property
of the Great World Amusement Resort, the Foh Cheng
Tobacco Company, the Wen Tien Bath House and Foochow
Road estate. The Great World Amusement Resort can
give a return of $100,000 annually (or $3,300,000 in
30 years); the Wen Tien Bath House $50,000; Foochow
Road estate $300,000 and the Foh Cheng Tobacco Company
$500,000 or $600,000."
The Creditors Committee will send a petition
to General Chang Chun, Mayor of Shanghai, to-day.
The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report to-day:-
In connection with the liquidation of the
Kung Fah Kung S, lawyer Loh Shao Tsung and lawyer Tsu S
Dee, on behalf of Chang Ching Pah, have sent a letter to
Pan Tau Paung and Wu Tseng, Court auditors, claiming
preferential treatment in the repayment of a sum of
$200,000 secured on a mortgage of the premises of the
Kung Fah Kung S and also demanding immediate payment of
$5,000 being interest for the first instalment due.
pages.zh:
1931年3月2日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸于3月1日刊登如下报道：——
昨日，上海特区地方法院就梅花烟草公司曹子敬等人起诉福成烟草公司要求偿还欠款一案，作出如下有利于原告的判决：——
“福成烟草公司须向曹子敬等人偿还价值172,131.45美元的货物款项。姚芝仙负责福昌烟草公司的清算，黄显耀和黄显宗须补足余额。”
大世界游乐场经理闵载庄昨日接受报记者采访，并发表如下声明：——
“大世界游乐场、天天舞台及日夜银行的场地可按每月3,350美元或每年40,000美元的价格出租。若有人希望租赁该场地，必须先支付100,000美元的租金押金。这笔钱可用于偿还大世界游乐场的部分债务。十年内可筹集1,000,000美元用于还债。二十年内可筹集2,000,000美元，这笔钱可用于偿还公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）四分之三的债务。大中华大药房、文天浴室及黄家的财产足以偿付债务。我已向大上海市政府、社会局以及法院审计员潘陶邦和吴曾提交以下措施供审议，即在30年内分期偿还债务。通过出租大世界游乐场、福成烟草公司、文天浴室及福州路地产的财产，可在30年内实现分期还债。大世界游乐场每年可收益100,000美元（30年共计3,300,000美元）；文天浴室50,000美元；福州路地产300,000美元；福成烟草公司500,000或600,000美元。”
债权人委员会今日将向上海市市长张群将军递交请愿书。
《时报》及其他本地报纸今日刊登如下报道：——
关于公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的清算事宜，律师罗绍宗和律师朱士迪代表张景柏致函法院审计员潘陶邦和吴曾，主张对以公发公司房产抵押担保的200,000美元款项享有优先受偿权，并要求立即支付5,000美元，此为第一期到期利息。

pages.en:
March 3, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Yesterday Hsu Ycong Chao and Ching Shi Zung,
representatives of the Creditors Committee of the Day and
Night Bank,called at the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
They were received by Yu Hong Chun, Chief Secretary, who
made the following statement:-
"The Municipality will render every
assistance to protect the interests of the common people,
but the differences in opinion among the creditors are
rendering it difficult for the Municipality to handle
the affair. If the Municipality is called upon to
take charge of affairs, there are still many things in
which judicial steps must first be taken. At present
the Municipality has engaged four lawyers, free of
charge, to undertake legal proceedings to protect the
interests of creditors. The Municipality has to await
the decision of the Court. If the creditors suffer
any loss by the decision of the Court, then the
Municipality will devise other relief measures. For
the time being the Municipality is really unable to
give a helping hand."
Mr. Yu was then asked by the two
representatives whether the list of Directors of
the Kung Fah Kung S was being kept by the Municipality
as stated by Yu Yah Ching.
He replied that the Municipality and the
Mayor had not received the list.
The following letter has been received
from Min Tsai Chuang, manager of the Great World
Amusement Resort:-
"With reference to a report published
in your paper of March 1 regarding my conversation
about the liquidation of the Kung Fah Kung S, there
is some misunderstanding. I made the suggestion of
repaying the debt with the money secured from the
lease of the Great World Amusement Resort. I am
not fully cognisant with the internal affairs of the
Kung Fah Kung S and of its subsidiaries. As regards
the Wen Tien Bath House ($50,000) and the Great China
Dispensary($300,000), it may take several years for
those amounts to be realized. Please make a
correction."
Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained by
the Huang family, has published a report on the
liquidation of Huang's property.
pages.zh:
1931年3月3日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
昨日，日夜银行债权人委员会代表徐永兆和盛世宗拜访了大上海市政府。他们受到秘书长俞鸿钧的接见，俞发表了如下声明：——
“市政府将提供一切协助以保护民众利益，但债权人之间的意见分歧使得市政府难以处理此事。如果要求市政府接管事务，仍有许多事情必须首先采取司法步骤。目前，市政府已聘请四位律师免费进行法律诉讼，以保护债权人利益。市政府必须等待法院的判决。如果债权人因法院判决而遭受任何损失，那么市政府将 devise 其他救济措施。暂时而言，市政府确实无法伸出援手。”
随后，两位代表询问俞先生，正如俞亚清所言，公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的董事名单是否由市政府保管。
他回答说，市政府和市长均未收到该名单。
收到来自大世界游乐场经理闵载庄的如下信件：——
“关于贵报3月1日刊登的涉及我谈论公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）清算事宜的报道，存在一些误解。我提出的建议是利用出租大世界游乐场所得资金来偿还债务。我对公发公司及其子公司的内部事务并不完全了解。至于文天浴室（50,000美元）和大中华大药房（300,000美元），这些金额可能需要数年才能实现变现。请予更正。”
黄家聘请的律师谭尼恭已发布一份关于黄氏财产清算的报告。

pages.en:
March 4, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
By order of the French Mixed Court Wu Tseng
and Pan Zau Paung, Court auditors, are now undertaking
the liquidation of the Kung Fah Kung S.
The following important work is being
undertaken:-
(1) To institute legal proceedings at the French
Mixed Court against debtors to the Day and
Night Bank for non-payment of accounts.
(2) To investigate into the lease of the site
of the Wen Tien Bath House for which there
are many bidders.
(3) To check the liabilities of the Great China
Dispensary.
(4) To check the accounts of the Kiu Sing Cinema.
(5) To request Foh Chong Tobacco Company to repay
the money owing to the Day and Night Bank.
(6) There are more than 10,000 creditors who have
registered with the auditors, and the number
of creditors who are registering themselves
at the Day and Night Bank Head Office is
becoming less.
(7) A sum of $4,300 in cash belonging to the
Great World Amusement Resort was deposited
at the Farmers and Labourers Bank yesterday.
The expenses of the resort have also been cut
down. The pay of employees earning less
than $50 has been reduced by 10%, while the
pay of those earning more than $50 has been
cut by 20%.
Yesterday the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai endorsed the petition submitted by the
Creditors Committee of the Day and Night Bank
drawing attention to the possibility of share-
holders making away with valuable property of
the Kung Fah Kung S. The endorsement states
that the Municipality has noted the petition and
has instructed the Social Bureau to take the
precautionary steps.
Yen Loo Ching, the lawyer retained
by the creditors, told a reporter of this paper
that he has agreed to the request of Wu Tseng
and Pan Zau Paung, Court auditors, to apply to
the Shanghai Special District Court for the
removal of sealing orders placed on the Hongkew
and the Chekiang Road Branches of the Day and
Night Bank, the Great China Dispensary and the
Wen Tien Bath House which enterprises, as stated
by the Court auditors, would be let out.
pages.zh:
1931年3月4日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：——
奉法国会审公廨命令，法院审计员吴曾和潘祖邦目前正在负责公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的清算工作。
正在进行以下重要工作：——
(1) 在法国会审公廨对拖欠日夜银行账款的债务人提起法律诉讼。
(2) 调查文天浴室场地的租赁情况，目前有许多竞标者。
(3) 核查大中华大药房的负债情况。
(4) 核对久星电影院的账目。
(5) 要求福昌烟草公司偿还欠日夜银行的款项。
(6) 已有超过10,000名债权人在审计员处登记，而在日夜银行总行自行登记的债权人数量正在减少。
(7) 昨日，属于大世界游乐场的一笔4,300美元现金存入农民劳工银行。该游乐场的开支也已削减。月薪低于50美元的雇员薪金减少10%，而月薪高于50美元的雇员薪金削减20%。
昨日，大上海市政府批注了日夜银行债权人委员会提交的请愿书，提请注意股东可能转移公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）贵重财产的可能性。批注指出，市政府已注意到该请愿书，并指令社会局采取预防措施。
债权人聘请的律师严鲁青告诉本报记者，他已同意法院审计员吴曾和潘祖邦的请求，向上海特区地方法院申请解除对日夜银行虹口分行和浙江路分行、大中华大药房及文天浴室的查封令，据法院审计员称，这些企业将被出租。

pages.en:
March 4, 1931.. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local
newspapers publish the following reports:-

The late Huang Cho Chiu is the greatest
debtor to the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, and his
properties are registered for sale. Tan Kee Kung,
the lawyer retained by Huang's family, has completed
the registration of Huang's properties. The Movable
property was handed to the Court auditors yesterday
and has been deposited with the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank for sale.
pages.zh:
1931年3月4日。上午译文。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

已故黄楚九是上海日夜银行的最大债务人，其财产已登记待售。黄家聘请的律师谭寄公（Tan Kee Kung，音译）已完成黄氏财产的登记手续。动产已于昨日移交法院审计员，并存入上海日夜银行以待出售。

pages.en:
THE SHANGHAI TIMES, WEDNESDAY, MARCH 4, 1931.

CIGARETTE COMPANY
LOSES LAWSUIT
Tls. 172,131 Judgment
Given In Favour Of
Five Concerns

Judgment for Tls. 172,131.43 has been delivered by Judge Hyui in the Shanghai Special District Court for the Kentucky and Virginia Leaf Tobacco Company Inc., the Tobacco Trading Company, the Mei Hwa Tobacco Company and Union Tobacco Company against the Foh Chong Cigarette Manufacturing Company, an establishment owned by the Kung Fah Company.

The claims were in respect of tobacco purchased by the defendant company for manufacturing cigarettes. Like the failure of the Day and Night Saving Bank, the actions followed the death of Mr. Wong Tso-chiu, a director of the Kung Fah Company. It was stated that the plaintiff companies refused to supply further tobacco to the defendant concern until they had received payment in full for the former purchases.

It was stated that every step was taken to collect the money without resort to law, but that the actions were precipitated by the repeated failure of the defendant company to settle.

It was further stated that the assets of the defendants company, including its plant, were in the neighbourhood of Tls. 300,000.

Mr. N. E. Lurton, of Messrs. Schul and Lurton, intervened for the China Finance Corporation, who, he said, had mortgaged the property of the tobacco factory for $100,000 and, consequently, had a preferential claim on the property of the defendant company. Counsel was advised to take his case to the court of execution.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》，1931年3月4日，星期三。

卷烟公司
败诉
判赔银172,131两
判决有利于
五家商号

上海特区地方法院惠伊（Hyui，音译）法官就肯塔基与弗吉尼亚烟叶有限公司（Kentucky and Virginia Leaf Tobacco Company Inc.）、烟草贸易公司（Tobacco Trading Company）、梅花烟草公司（Mei Hwa Tobacco Company）及联合烟草公司（Union Tobacco Company）诉孔发公司（Kung Fah Company）所属福昌卷烟制造厂（Foh Chong Cigarette Manufacturing Company）一案，作出判决，判令被告支付银172,131.43两。

诉讼请求涉及被告公司为制造卷烟而购买的烟草。如同日夜储蓄银行的倒闭一样，这些诉讼是在孔发公司董事黄佐秋（Wong Tso-chiu，音译，即黄楚九）去世后提起的。据称，原告公司拒绝向被告商号进一步供应烟草，直到它们收到之前采购的全额付款为止。

据称，各方已采取一切措施在不诉诸法律的情况下追讨欠款，但由于被告公司屡次未能结清款项，遂导致提起诉讼。

另据称，被告公司的资产，包括其厂房，价值约为银30万两。

舒尔与勒顿律师事务所（Messrs. Schul and Lurton）的N. E. 勒顿（N. E. Lurton）先生代表中国金融公司（China Finance Corporation）介入诉讼。他表示，该公司已以该烟厂的财产为抵押贷出10万美元，因此对被告公司的财产享有优先索赔权。建议 counsel（法律顾问/律师）将其案件提交执行法庭处理。

pages.en:
March 5, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Zung Ts Zien, the Manager and Chief Accountant
of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, and his son (Zung
Yu Ching) who is an accountant of the bank, were
arrested yesterday afternoon on a warrant issued by
the Mixed Court in the French Concession.
Endeavours are being made by the French Police
to affect the arrest of Zung Hsin Ching (a nephew of
Zung Ts Zien) who is also an accountant of the bank,
and for whose arrest a warrant has also been issued
by the Mixed Court.
According to a petition submitted to the
Court by the two auditors who were appointed to liquidate
the Kung Fah Kung S, Zung Ts Zien, together with his
son and nephew, has concealed the genuine account books
and replaced them with a set of new books. These new
books do not give the names of the shareholders of the
concern. According to the accounts of the bank,
on January 19, the day on which Huang Che Chiu died,
the bank paid out five cheques presented by Huang Cho Chiu.
The total amount of these cheques was $1,100,000.
However, the signatures and the chops of Huang Che Chiu
on these cheques are different from the specimens recorded.
pages.zh:
1931年3月5日。下午译文。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行经理兼总会计师钟子坚（Zung Ts Zien，音译）及其子、该行会计师钟玉清（Zung Yu Ching，音译），昨日下午持法租界会审公廨签发的逮捕令被捕。
法国警方正努力逮捕同样身为该行会计师的钟信清（Zung Hsin Ching，音译，钟子坚之侄），会审公廨也已签发对其的逮捕令。
根据受命清算孔发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的两名审计员向法院提交的请愿书，钟子坚与其子及侄儿隐匿了真实账簿，并替换为一套新账簿。这套新账簿未列明该公司的股东姓名。根据银行账目，1月19日即黄楚九去世当日，银行兑付了黄楚九提示的五张支票。这些支票总金额为110万元。然而，这些支票上黄楚九的签名和印章与留存的样本不符。

pages.en:
March 6, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers publish
the following report:-

As the result of the arrest of Zung Ts Zien,
the Manager and Chief Accountant of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank, and his son Zung Yu Ching who is
accountant of the bank, on a charge of misappropriation,
Wu Tseng and Pan Zau Paung, Court auditors, are making
an investigation into the Aung Fah Kung S and its
subsidiaries to ascertain other acts of corruption.
The offenders will be dealt with severely.
pages.zh:
1931年3月6日。下午译文。

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

由于上海日夜银行经理兼总会计师钟子坚及其子、该行会计师钟玉清因涉嫌挪用公款被捕，法院审计员吴增（Wu Tseng，音译）和潘兆邦（Pan Zau Paung，音译）正在对孔发公司（Aung Fah Kung S，原文如此，应为Kung Fah）及其子公司进行调查，以查明其他腐败行为。罪犯将受到严厉惩处。

pages.en:
March 7, 1931.
Second
Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
There are two bodies of creditors of the
Shanghai Day and Night Bank: one party has taken legal
action against the Shanghai Day and Night Bank in the
French Mixed Court; the other party is the creditors
committee in Lloyd Road which is now preparing with
the assistance of the four lawyers retained by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai to submit a petition
to the Shanghai Special District Court.
It has now been ascertained that outside
agents owe the Foh Chong Tobacco Company more than
$300,000. Yesterday Wu Tseng and Pan Zau Paung,
Court auditors, held a meeting with outport managers.
The following measures were passed:-
2 (1) That the accounts be checked.
(2) That the work of the Foh Chong Tobacco Company
be continued and the outport managers be
responsible for payment of accounts due to the
Foh Chong Tobacco Company.
(3) That these managers be responsible for all
payments after the continuation of the Foh
Chong Tobacco Company.
Yesterday the reporter of the China
Times interviewed Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained
by Huang's family, and the following information was
secured:-
The Huang family is preparing to repay
the personal debts of the late Huang Cho Chiu owing to
the Shanghai Day and Night Bank. They are not paying
the debts because late Huang Cho Chiu was the director
of a shareholder of the Kung Fah Kung S. With regard
to the debts of the Kung Fah Kung S, Huang Cho Chiu
was certainly responsible for them as he was a shareholder
but Huang Cho Chiu was not the only shareholder of the
Kung Fah Kung S.
The Chekiang Road branch of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank is now being sued by its landlord for
two months rent ($800).

MEMORIAL SERVICE FOR MARTYRS OF EXPEDITION

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
A memorial service in honour of the martyrs
in the Anti-Rebellion Expedition will be held in Nanking
and other places on March 10.
The Headquarters of the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner is making preparations for the
holding of the service in Shanghai.
The programme will be as follows:-
1) General meeting at the Public Recreation Ground, West
Gate, on the morning of March 10.
2) A salute of 35 guns.
3) Three bows to the photographs of the martyrs.
4) The reading of Dr. Sun Yatsen's will.
5) Silence for three minutes.
6) Offering of flowers.
7) Speeches.
8) Shouting of slogans.
9) Music.
pages.zh:
1931年3月7日。
第二次
上午译文

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行有两批债权人：一方已在法租界会审公廨对上海日夜银行提起诉讼；另一方是位于劳合路（Lloyd Road）的债权人委员会，目前正在大上海市府聘请的四位律师协助下，准备向上海特区地方法院提交请愿书。
现已查明，外部代理商欠福昌烟草公司超过30万美元。昨日，法院审计员吴增和潘兆邦与外埠经理举行会议。通过以下措施：
(1) 核对账目。
(2) 福昌烟草公司的业务继续运营，外埠经理负责支付欠福昌烟草公司的账款。
(3) 这些经理负责福昌烟草公司继续运营后的所有付款。
昨日，《时报》记者采访了黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译），获得如下信息：
黄家正准备偿还已故黄楚九欠上海日夜银行的个人债务。他们偿还债务并非因为已故黄楚九是孔发公司股东的董事。关于孔发公司的债务，黄楚九作为股东当然负有责任，但黄楚九并非孔发公司的唯一股东。
上海日夜银行浙江路分行现正被房东起诉，要求支付两个月租金（800美元）。

远征烈士追悼会

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
3月10日将在南京等地举行反叛乱远征烈士追悼会。
淞沪警备司令部正在上海筹备举行该仪式。
程序如下：
1) 3月10日上午在西门外公共体育场召开大会。
2) 鸣礼炮35响。
3) 向烈士遗像三鞠躬。
4) 宣读孙中山博士遗嘱。
5) 静默三分钟。
6) 献花。
7) 演讲。
8) 呼口号。
9) 奏乐。

pages.en:
March 10, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE KUNG PAH KUNG & CO. LTD.

The China Press and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
With reference to the suggestion made by Liu Tsai Huang, Manager of the Great World Amusement Resort, to let the buildings, the Social Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has received letters of opposition to this measure from certain creditors who requested that the property of the Kung Pah Kung & Co. be immediately disposed of to meet its obligations and that the sons of the late Huang Cho Chiu and the shareholders of the Kung Pah Kung & Co. be ordered to bear unlimited responsibility for the balance so that creditors may be saved from further loss.
Since the arrest on March 4 of Chen Ts Chuen, manager of the Day & Night Bank, and his son on a charge of misappropriation, the Procurator of the French Mixed Court has been conducting an investigation into the names of the directors and shareholders of the Kung Pah Kung & Co. and into its accounts. The Court will hear this case on the conclusion of the Procurator's investigation.
A lease contract has been concluded for the Tien Tien Wu Dai Theatre and the Sin Jing Cinema. The Tien Tien Wu Dai Theatre will be leased out for $8,000 a month and the Sin Jing Cinema for $600 a month for a period of two months.
The case in which the Nanking Road Branch of the Day and Night Bank is being sued by an Englishman for failure to pay $200 being two months rent due will be heard at the Shanghai Special District Court at 9 a.m. to-day.

OBSERVANCE OF ARBOR DAY.

The China Press and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai will observe Arbor Day at the San Min Wu Chuin Road on March 12.
For the convenience of those intending to participate in the ceremony, the Preparatory Committee has arranged with the Chinese Bus Company to provide transportation facilities.

EXECUTION OF ARMED ABDUCTORS AND ROBBERS.

The Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
At 2 p.m. yesterday four armed abductors and robbers were executed outside Soochow by order of the Kiangsu Provincial Government.
pages.zh:
1931年3月10日。下午译文。

杂项

孔发股份有限公司事宜。

《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
针对大世界游乐场经理刘载煌（Liu Tsai Huang，音译）提出的出租建筑物的建议，大上海市社会局收到部分债权人的反对信，他们要求立即处置孔发股份有限公司的财产以履行其债务，并命令已故黄楚九之子及孔发股份有限公司股东对剩余债务承担无限责任，以免债权人遭受进一步损失。
自3月4日夜夜银行经理陈子全（Chen Ts Chuen，音译）及其子因涉嫌挪用公款被捕以来，法租界会审公廨检察官一直在调查孔发股份有限公司的董事和股东名单及其账目。待检察官调查结束后，法庭将审理此案。
天天舞台和新京电影院已签订租赁合同。天天舞台将以每月8,000美元的价格出租，新京电影院将以每月600美元的价格出租，租期两个月。
日夜银行南京路分行因拖欠两个月租金共计200美元而被一名英国人起诉的案件，将于今日上午9时在上海特区地方法院开庭审理。

植树节纪念活动。

《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
大上海市府将于3月12日在三民五村路（San Min Wu Chuin Road，音译）举行植树节纪念活动。
为方便有意参加仪式的人士，筹备委员会已与中国巴士公司安排提供交通设施。

处决武装绑匪和劫匪。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
昨日下午2时，奉江苏省政府命令，四名武装绑匪和劫匪在苏州城外被执行枪决。

pages.en:
March 11, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times publishes the following
report:-
The liquidation of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort is
being undertaken by Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Pang, the
Court auditors.
The following information has been secured:-
(1) The suggestion made by Min Tsai Chong,
the manager of the Great World Amusement,
to lease out the place is now under consideration by the Court auditors.
(2) Those who owe money to the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank will be called upon
to repay.
(3) The accounts of the Great China Dispensary
in 1930 are being closed.
(4) The auditor, Pan Zau Pang, intends to
pay a section of the creditors with
the money received.
(5) The Yen Dah Sung Chinese Drug Store on
Rue Bayle, French Concession will be
advertised for sale by the Court auditors.
(6) The Wuchang Cinema on Wuchang Road will
be leased out.
(7) Cheng Ts Zien, the manager of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank, and his son, Cheng
Yui Cheng, an accountant of the Bank,
have arrested for misappropriation and
the case will be heard immediately after
the investigation by the Chief Procurator
of the French Mixed Court has been concluded.
pages.zh:
1931年3月11日。下午译文。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时事新报》刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场的清算工作正由法院审计员吴宗（Wu Tsung，音译，前文作Wu Tseng）和潘兆邦（Pan Zau Pang）进行。
获得如下信息：
(1) 大世界游乐场经理闵载忠（Min Tsai Chong，音译）提出的出租场所的建议，现正由法院审计员审议。
(2) 将催讨欠上海日夜银行款项者还款。
(3) 正在结算1930年中华大药房（Great China Dispensary）的账目。
(4) 审计员潘兆邦打算用收到的款项支付部分债权人。
(5) 法租界贝勒路（Rue Bayle）的延达松中药店（Yen Dah Sung Chinese Drug Store，音译）将由法院审计员登报出售。
(6) 武昌路的武昌电影院（Wuchang Cinema）将对外出租。
(7) 上海日夜银行经理郑子坚（Cheng Ts Zien，音译，前文作Zung Ts Zien）及其子、该行会计师郑玉成（Cheng Yui Cheng，音译，前文作Zung Yu Ching）已因挪用公款被捕，待法租界会审公廨首席检察官调查结束后，将立即开庭审理此案。

March 13, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

(9) That the French Mixed Court be requested to make
an investigation into the names of the directors
of the Kung Fah Kung S.
(10) The Kung Fah Kung S is now under liquidation and
likewise its subsidiaries; the Great China Dispensary,
the Wen Zien Bath House, the Foh Sing Cinema, etc.,
in the International Settlement. Is the action now

(11) That an investigation be made into the case of

1931年3月13日。下午译文。

杂项

(9) 请求法租界会审公廨调查孔发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）董事名单。
(10) 孔发公司及其子公司，包括国际公共租界内的中华大药房、文仙浴室（Wen Zien Bath House，音译）、福星电影院（Foh Sing Cinema）等，现正处于清算阶段。上海特区地方法院中 ██████ 部分债权人目前采取的行动是否合法？
