pages.en:
March 13, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
It is learned that Wu Ching Yoong, Chen Ding
Zai, Dzeng Liem Kwei and Kiang Yih Ping, the lawyers
retained by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, have
taken charge of the affairs of all registered creditors
and of those who had been handed over to them by the
Creditors Committee on Lloyd Road.
The day before yesterday they filed in the
Shanghai Special District Court a formal action on behalf
of 3386 creditors for claims amounting to $85,813,839 and
$1,103,119/147 against shareholders and directors of the
Kung Fah Kung S and Huang Shiem Tseng and Huang Shiem Yao,
the sons of the late Huang Cho Chiu with a request that
they be made to bear unlimited responsibility and that
they refund the money due at an early date.
The China Times publishes the following
letter from Mei Sing and others:-
Nearly two months have elapsed since the
liquidation of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank and the
Great World Visitors Savings Department was begun, and
no result has yet been obtained. Most of the creditors
are common people and labourers who depend on their
deposits in time of need. It is not known whether
the auditors, the Liquidation Committee and the
Magistrate of the French Mixed Court will be able to
settle the case soon.
The following are the views of some of
the creditors:-
(1) To oppose the removal of the seals from the property
of the Kung Fah Kung S and the residence of the late
Huang Cho Chiu.
(2) That a certain sum in cash be deposited in Court for
the payment of creditors in case the seals are
removed from the Kung Fah Kung S.
(3) That the properties of the Kung Fah Kung S and of
Huang Cho Chiu be sold by auction and the proceeds
be used to repay the creditors. Suitable prices
must be obtained for these properties.
(4) To oppose the long period of payment by instalments
through letting out the Great World Amusement Resort.
It will be better to auction the institution so the
creditors may not be made to suffer greater loss.
(5) That the liquidators observe the wishes of the
creditors and that accounts be published from time
to time.
(6) That either the French Mixed Court or the liquidators
make an investigation into houses of Huang Cho Chiu
built on leased land and that the rents be paid
directly into Court or to the liquidators. The
money received will be used to repay the creditors
and is not to be handed to Huang's family.
(7) That the creditors hasten the liquidation and that
the property of the Kung Fah Kung S be dealt with
by legal procedure. The creditors want their
deposits to be refunded quickly.
(8) That the first step must be taken to deal with the
property of the Kung Fah Kung S and of Huang Cho
Chiu; if there be a deficit then the shareholders
and the directors of the Kung Fah Kung S be made
responsible for the deficit.
pages.zh:
1931年3月13日。下午译本。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
据悉，受大上海市政府聘用的律师吴敬庸、陈定哉、曾廉桂及江一平，已接管所有登记债权人以及由劳合路（Lloyd Road）债权人委员会移交之债权人的事务。
前日，他们代表3386名债权人向上海特区地方法院正式提起诉讼，索赔金额共计85,813,839元及1,103,119又147分之若干元，被告为公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S）的股东及董事，以及已故黄楚九之子黄世增（Huang Shiem Tseng）和黄世尧（Huang Shiem Yao），诉请判令其承担无限责任，并尽早退还欠款。

《时事新报》刊登梅星（Mei Sing）等人来信如下：
上海日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的清算工作已开始近两个月，但至今未见结果。大多数债权人为平民及劳工阶层，他们在急需时依赖这些存款维生。不知审计员、清算委员会及法租界会审公廨推事能否尽快结案。
以下是部分债权人的意见：
(1) 反对解除对公发公司及已故黄楚九住宅财产的查封。
(2) 若解除对公发公司的查封，须向法院存入一定数额现金，以备支付债权人。
(3) 拍卖公发公司及黄楚九的财产，所得款项用于偿还债权人。必须为这些财产争取合适的价格。
(4) 反对通过出租大世界游乐场来长期分期付款。最好将该机构拍卖，以免债权人遭受更大损失。
(5) 清算人应尊重债权人的意愿，并定期公布账目。
(6) 由法租界会审公廨或清算人对黄楚九建在租赁土地上的房屋进行调查，租金直接缴入法院或交给清算人。所收款项用于偿还债权人，不得交给黄氏家属。
(7) 债权人催促加快清算进程，并通过法律程序处理公发公司的财产。债权人希望迅速收回存款。
(8) 必须首先着手处理公发公司及黄楚九的财产；若有亏空，则由公发公司的股东及董事对亏空负责。

pages.en:
March 14, 1931.
Second Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The charge of misappropriation against Chen
Ts Zien the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bankand
his son, Zung Yui Ching, the accountant of the Bank, will
be heard at the French Mixed Court on March 19.
The deposits of creditors of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank are now being examined by Wu Tsung and
Pan Zau Pang, the Court auditors, and interest will be
calculated. The accountants of the Great China Dispensary
are still under examination and a report will be published
later.
With regard to the private property of the late
Huang Cho Chiu, the Court auditors are making an investigation.
At request of creditors, Yem Loo Ching, the lawyer
retained by these creditors, has asked the Court auditors to
hasten the liquidation.
At the request of Yem Loo Ching the Shanghai Special
District Court has sanctioned the removal of the seals from
the Chekiang Road and Hongkew Road Branches of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank.
pages.zh:
1931年3月14日。
第二译本。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
针对上海日夜银行经理陈子坚（Chen Ts Zien）及其子、银行会计师钟玉清（Zung Yui Ching）的挪用公款指控，将于3月19日在法租界会审公廨审理。
上海日夜银行债权人的存款目前正由法院审计员吴宗（Wu Tsung）和潘兆邦（Pan Zau Pang）进行核查，并将计算利息。大中华药房（Great China Dispensary）的会计师仍在接受审查，报告稍后公布。
关于已故黄楚九的私人财产，法院审计员正在进行调查。
应债权人要求，受这些债权人聘用的律师严鲁清（Yem Loo Ching）已请求法院审计员加快清算进度。
应严鲁清请求，上海特区地方法院已批准解除对上海日夜银行浙江路分行和虹口路分行的查封。

pages.en:
March 18, 1931a Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following reports:-
Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Pang, the Court auditors,
have located 10 persons who owe money to the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank and have petitioned the French Mixed
Court to instruct them to refund the money.
The investigation into the list of the directors
of the Kung Fah Kung S made by Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Pang,
the Court auditors has had no result. The Shanghai Day and
Night Bank is one of the subsidiaries of the Kung Fah Kung
S. Though Kung Fah Kung S is known as a limited company
it had not been registered according to law and it can only
be recognized as a corporation and has to bear unlimited
responsibility.
The property of the Kung Fah Kung S is estimated
to cover only 80% of its liability and the deficit has to
be shared by the directors and the shareholders of the Kung
Fah Kung S so that the compilation of a list of directors is
the most important measure to-day.
It is reported that a list of the directors and
creditors of the Kung Fah Kung S was transmitted to Hsui
Yoon Tseo, the auditor, by the Liquidation Committee and
it was again handed to Yui Yah Ching upon the suspension
of the Committee. It is learned that Yui Yah Ching has
deposited the list with the Bureau of Social Affairs.
The case of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
will be heard at the French Mixed Court on March 19.
pages.zh:
1931年3月18日a 下午译本。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
法院审计员吴宗和潘兆邦已查明欠上海日夜银行款项的10人，并已 petition 法租界会审公廨指令其退款。
法院审计员吴宗和潘兆邦对公发公司董事名单的调查尚无结果。上海日夜银行是公发公司的子公司之一。虽然公发公司名义上是有限公司，但未依法注册，只能被认定为合伙组织，并须承担无限责任。
据估计，公发公司的财产仅能覆盖其债务的80%，亏空部分须由公发公司的董事和股东分担，因此编制董事名单是当今最重要的措施。
据报道，公发公司的董事及债权人名单已由清算委员会移交给审计员徐允措（Hsui Yoon Tseo），在该委员会停摆后，该名单又转交给余亚清（Yui Yah Ching）。据悉，余亚清已将名单存于社会局。
上海日夜银行一案将于3月19日在法租界会审公廨审理。

pages.en:
March 18, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following reports:-
The Shanghai Day and Night Bank and the Great
World Amusement Resort are subsidiaries of the Hung Puh
Kung S. The directors and shareholders of the Hung Puh
Kung S have been ordered by the Court to bear unlimited
responsibility. At present the compilation of a list
of directors and creditors of the Hung Puh Kung S has
been handed to the four lawyers retained by the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai for reference.
pages.zh:
1931年3月18日。下午译本。

杂项：

黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行及大世界游乐场是宏福公司（Hung Puh Kung S）的子公司。法院已命令宏福公司的董事和股东承担无限责任。目前，宏福公司的董事及债权人名单已移交给受大上海市政府聘用的四位律师供参考。

pages.en:
March 19, 1951. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following reports:-
The charge of misappropriation against Chen
Ts Zien, the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
and his son, an accountant of the Bank had been arranged
to be heard to-day but it has been decided to postpone
the hearing to March 23 owing to the illness of the
Magistrate.
The Wang Kiu Ts Dong Chinese Drug Store
is the personal property of the late Huang Cho Chiu.
More than 50 workers of the Store recently petitioned
Tan Hee King, the lawyer retained by Huang's family,
in regard to the following demands:-
(1) That the business be carried on as usual.
(2) That the staff be not changed .
(3) That the repatriation allowance be issued
in case of the store suspends business.
The late Huang Cho Chiu was the greatest
debitor to the Shanghai Day and Night Bank. A sum of
more than $1,000,000 is owing by him. It
is reported that certain articles belong to the late
Huang Cho Chiu will be on view at his residence in the
near future. Admission tickets will be issued on a
small charge and the gate receipts will be used for
advertising expenses.
pages.zh:
1951年3月19日。下午译本。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
针对上海日夜银行经理陈子坚及其子、银行会计师的挪用公款指控，原定于今日审理，但因推事患病，决定延期至3月23日审理。
王九记中药店（Wang Kiu Ts Dong Chinese Drug Store）是已故黄楚九的个人财产。该店50多名工人近日向受黄氏家属聘用的律师谭希京（Tan Hee King）提出请愿，要求如下：
(1) 业务照常经营。
(2) 不更换职员。
(3) 若店铺停业，须发放遣散费。
已故黄楚九是上海日夜银行最大的债务人，欠款超过100万元。据报道，属于已故黄楚九的某些物品近期将在其寓所展出。入场券将收取少量费用，门票收入将用于广告支出。

pages.en:
March 20, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times publishes the following
letter from Yih Han Zang:-
The Shanghai Day and Night Bank has ceased
payment for two months. Many depositors depend upon
their deposits for a living. I am a native of Fokien.
My home having been destroyed by bandits, I came to
Shanghai after selling my property. I have no money
to pay for my tuition so I am unable to join a school.
The food caterer has ceased to supply me with food
because I am owing money to the caterer. The
liquidation was started long ago but no definite
measures has been drawn up. I am not the only one
waiting for repayment of the deposits but I do hope
that the persons in charge of affairs will hasten
their work. I hereby suggest the following methods:-
(1) That the property of the late Huang Cho Chiu be quickly
sold for cash money.
(2) That the receipts of the Great World and the Kung
 Dah Kung S for the previous two months be distributed
among the creditors.
The suggestion made by Min Tsai Chuang, the
manager of the Great World Amusement Resort, is ridiculous.
Nobody would care to wait so long as thirty years for the
repayment of their deposits.
pages.zh:
1931年3月20日。下午译本。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时事新报》刊登易汉藏（Yih Han Zang）来信如下：
上海日夜银行已停止付款两个月。许多储户依靠存款维持生计。我是福建人。家乡遭匪徒毁坏，我变卖财产后来到了上海。我无钱支付学费，因此无法入学。由于我欠餐费，伙食供应商已停止向我供应食物。清算工作早已开始，但尚未制定明确措施。等待退还存款的并非我一人，但我希望负责人能加快工作进度。兹建议如下方法：
(1) 迅速变卖已故黄楚九的财产以换取现金。
(2) 将大世界及公达公司（Kung Dah Kung S）过去两个月的收入分配给债权人。
大世界游乐场经理闵才庄（Min Tsai Chuang）提出的建议荒谬可笑。无人愿意等待长达三十年之久以收回存款。

pages.en:
March 24, 1931.
Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

Representatives of the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate have
been ordered to be present.
pages.zh:
1931年3月24日。
下午译本。

杂项

万通金融辛迪加（Van Tsung Financial Syndicate）的代表已被命令出庭。

pages.en:
March 24, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
At 4 p.m. yesterday, the case of the Shanghai Day
and Night Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort was
heard at the French Mixed Court.
The Court auditors in their report stated that
a sum of more than $40,000 has been received and is now
on deposit in the Shanghai Commercial Bank and the
Agricultural and Industrial Bank of China. The
registration of creditors has been completed and the
repayment of creditors will follow the sale of the
properties of the Kung Fah Kung S and of its subsidiaries.
Negotiations for the sale of the Great China Dispensary
and the Wen Zien Bath House are now under way. The
Great World Amusement Resort is worth at least $800,000
but no one is willing to buy it at one time; people would
like to lease it. The Foh Chong Tobacco Company owes a
large sum of money and is now under an injunction order.
The late Huang Cho Chiu and the Kiu Foh Kung S are the
greatest debtors to the Shanghai Day and Night Bank,
excepting, of course, the Kung Fah Kung S and its subsidiaries.
The list of the late Huang Cho Chiu's property has been
published. The Court auditors have requested the Court
to take action against Huang Cho Chiu's property. The
Kiu Foh Kung S will be sold and the proceeds will be
distributed among the creditors.
Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained by Huang's family
has made the following report:-
Immovable property belonging to
the late Huang Cho Chiu.
(1) Furniture................................$ 110,000.
(2) Curios, porcelain and brass ware       $  28,200.
(3) Books and drawings                     $  32,600.
(4) Clothes and jewelery                   $ 157,500.
(5) Stocks and debenture bonds             $ 835,000.
The above prices were fixed by experts. The
list of the immovable property will be completed soon. It
shows property worth approximately $1,800,000. Most of
the leased lands have been built with houses; and these
houses have been mortgaged so it is rather difficult to
make a full investigation. They are sufficient to cover
the liabilities of the late Huang Cho Chiu. Tan Nee Kung
has promised to make full lists of the movable and immovable
properties.
Cheng Ding Sin, the lawyer retained by the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, has submitted the
following list of the directors of the Kung Fah Kung S:-
Huang Cho Chiu, Chairman of the Board of Directors.
Tat Qing Pe, Tuen Zeong Ching, Standing Directors.
San Sh Lee, Yuan Li Tung, Tai Tsoong Tsao, Tang
Sun Wu and Kao Ching Den, Directors.
The following are the directors of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank:-
Lau Ping Sung, Wang Shiang P, Yuang Li Tung,
Yih San Den and Tai Tsai Tsai.
The French Mixed Court has ordered the Court
auditors to take action against the properties of the
Kung Fah Kung S. Huang Shien Tseong and Huang Shien
Tsau the sons of the late Huang Cho Chiu, were ordered
to transfer their movable properties to the liquidators
for sale.
The case will be heard after seven days. The
directors and shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S and
pages.zh:
1931年3月24日。下午译本。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
昨日下午4时，法租界会审公廨审理了上海日夜银行及大世界游乐场一案。
法院审计员在报告中指出，已收到4万余元，现存入上海商业储蓄银行及中国农工银行。债权人登记工作已完成，债权人的偿还将紧随公发公司及其子公司财产的出售之后进行。
目前正就出售大中华药房及文仙浴室（Wen Zien Bath House）进行谈判。大世界游乐场价值至少80万元，但无人愿意一次性购买；人们倾向于租赁。福昌烟草公司（Foh Chong Tobacco Company）拖欠巨额款项，目前已收到禁令令状。
除公发公司及其子公司外，已故黄楚九及久福公司（Kiu Foh Kung S）是上海日夜银行最大的债务人。
已故黄楚九的财产清单已公布。法院审计员已请求法院对黄楚九的财产采取行动。久福公司将被出售，所得款项将分配给债权人。
受黄氏家属聘用的律师谭尼恭（Tan Nee Kung）提交如下报告：
已故黄楚九的不动产及动产：
(1) 家具................................$ 110,000.
(2) 古玩、瓷器和铜器       $  28,200.
(3) 书籍和字画                     $  32,600.
(4) 衣物和珠宝                   $ 157,500.
(5) 股票和债券             $ 835,000.
上述价格由专家确定。不动产清单即将完成。显示财产价值约180万元。大部分租赁土地上已建有房屋；这些房屋已抵押，因此很难进行全面调查。这些资产足以抵偿已故黄楚九的债务。谭尼恭承诺将提供完整的动产和不动产清单。
受大上海市政府聘用的律师陈定信（Cheng Ding Sin）提交了如下公发公司董事名单：
黄楚九，董事长。
达庆培（Tat Qing Pe）、段宗庆（Tuen Zeong Ching），常务董事。
李三士（San Sh Lee）、袁丽通（Yuan Li Tung）、戴宗曹（Tai Tsoong Tsao）、唐孙武（Tang Sun Wu）及高景德（Kao Ching Den），董事。
以下是上海日夜银行的董事：
刘平松（Lau Ping Sung）、王香P（Wang Shiang P）、袁丽通（Yuang Li Tung）、叶三登（Yih San Den）及戴才才（Tai Tsai Tsai）。
法租界会审公廨已命令法院审计员对公发公司的财产采取行动。已故黄楚九之子黄世忠（Huang Shien Tseong）和黄世祖（Huang Shien Tsau）被命令将其动产移交给清算人出售。
本案将于七天后审理。公发公司的董事和股东及

pages.en:
March 26, 1951. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local
newspapers publish the following letter from Tan Nee
Kung, the lawyer retained by Huang's family.
With reference to the notice of the
workers of the Wong Kiu Ts Dong Chinese Drug Store, which
was published in your paper on March 20, it is not true
that Yui Kya F, the Manager of the Wong Kiu Ts Dong Chinese
Drug Store, had been instructed by Huang's family to negotiate
with the workers of the Wong Kiu Ts Dong Chinese Drug Store.
The workers sent me a letter containing
three demands and I was instructed by the Huang's family to
state that the store will not suspend business. I advised
the workers to continue at their work. The Manager of the
store is responsible for the trouble for he had acted
without the authority of Huang's family.
pages.zh:
1951年3月26日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）的如下来信。
关于贵报3月20日刊登的宏济堂中药店工人的通告，宏济堂中药店经理余嘉福（Yui Kya F，音译）受黄家指示与宏济堂中药店工人进行谈判一事，并非事实。
工人们给我发来一封信，提出三项要求，黄家指示我声明该店不会停业。我建议工人们继续工作。该店经理应对此次纠纷负责，因为他是在未经黄家授权的情况下行事的。

pages.en:
March 27, 1931.
Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times publishes the following
letter from Hsia Pang Teh Ts.
Since the closing of the Shanghai Day
and Night Bank, the creditors have sent petitions for
repayment of their deposits. I hereby submit few suggestions:-
(1) That the property of the Kung Fah Kung
S be sold and the proceeds be used to
pay the creditors.
(2) That Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained
by Huang's family be requested to sell
the property quickly.
(3) That the directors and shareholders of
the Kung Fah Kung S be responsible
for the deficit after the sale of the □□□
property.
(4) That Shen Ts Zien, the Manager of the
Shanghai Day and Night Bank and his
son, the accountant of the Bank be asked
to make good the money which they had
embezzled.
pages.zh:
1931年3月27日。
下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》刊登了夏邦德茨（Hsia Pang Teh Ts，音译）的如下来信。
自上海日夜银行停业以来，债权人纷纷呈请偿还存款。兹提出几点建议：-
(1) 出售公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的财产，所得款项用于偿付债权人。
(2) 请黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）迅速出售财产。
(3) 公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的董事和股东应对出售□□□财产后的赤字负责。
(4) 要求上海日夜银行经理沈子坚（Shen Ts Zien，音译）及其子（该行会计师）赔偿他们侵吞的款项。

pages.en:
March 28, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained by Huang's
family, has completed the registration of the movable
property of the late Huang Cho Chiu. The registration
of the immovable property, such as mortgage deeds etc,
is under way and will be completed shortly.
The Huang family has complied with the order
of the French Mixed Court and has handed over a portion of
the movable property, which will be exhibited at the
Great World Amusement Resort for one month after which
it will be auctioned.
Every day more than 100 creditors, mostly
women and labourers, call at the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank Head Office on Avenue Edward VII to enquire about
repayment.
At present the two auditors are arranging
the sale of the Great China Dispensary which will be
taken over by Chow Paung Tsung, manager of the pharmacy,
at a price of approximately $240,000.
Arrangement are also being made for the
sale of the Wen Zien Bath House for $60,000.
The proceeds from the sale of these two
enterprises together with the $40,000, cash, totalling
about $300,000, constitute only one-tenth of the
liabilities of the Day and Night Bank.
pages.zh:
1931年3月28日。上午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）已完成对已故黄楚九动产的登记。不动产（如抵押契据等）的登记正在进行中，不久即可完成。
黄家已遵做法租界会审公廨的命令，移交了一部分动产，这些动产将在“大世界”游乐场展览一个月，随后进行拍卖。
每天有一百多名债权人，大多为妇女和劳工，前往爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的上海日夜银行总行询问还款事宜。
目前，两名审计员正在安排出售“大中华大药房”，该药房将由药店经理周邦宗（Chow Paung Tsung，音译）以约24万美元的价格接管。
同时也在安排以6万美元的价格出售“文仙浴室”。
这两家企业的出售所得，加上4万美元现金，总计约30万美元，仅占日夜银行负债的十分之一。

pages.en:
March 31, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE KUANG CAO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
and the Great World Amusement Resort was heard at the French
Mixed Court by Magistrate Chuin Siang yesterday. The Court
auditor, Pan Zau Pang, reported that the case of the Great
China Dispensary will be settled within two or three days.
The other cases relating to the Fah Chong Tobacco Company, the
Wen Tien Bath House and the Great World Amusement Resort are
under negotiation. Legal actions have been started against
those owing money to the Bank. Several have paid their accounts.
Creditors will be refunded 20% of their deposits.
Yih San Dau, Zau Sin Po, Tsou Zoong Ching
and Tung Sin Wu have retained Loh Zau Tsoong to be their
lawyer. They deny that they are shareholders of the Kung
Fah Kung S and demand proof.
Yan Loo Chin, the lawyer retained by the
creditors, states that if they are not shareholders of the
Kung Fah Kung S why did not they protest against the publication
of their names in the newspapers. Moreover, the Bureau of
Social Affairs has transferred the list of names of shareholders
of the Kung Fah Kung S to Chen Bing Siu, the lawyer retained
by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, and this list can be
produced in Court for examination. Chen Bing Siu has a photo
of the list of the names of the shareholders of the Kung Fah
Kung S. He states that the shareholders (Directors) signed
their names when they drew their salaries and locomotion
allowances.
The lawyer retained by Yih San Dau and others
is demanding the original list of the names of the shareholders
of the Kung Fah Kung S.
Chen Bing Siu forwarded the list of the
shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S to the Court for examination.
The Van Tsung Financial Syndicate was
represented by San Chi, a lawyer. He states that the Syndicate
was formed by Hoo Shing and other native banks. The late
Kuang Cao Chiu left for Hangchow in December last and returned
to Shanghai owing to the serious state of affairs in regard
to the deposits in the Shanghai Day and Night Bank. The late
Kuang Cao Chiu secured a loan of $800,000 from the Van Tsung
Financial Syndicate by mortgaging his title deeds. The money
was used to repay the depositors. The deposits of the creditors
were paid in the following manner: the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank issues a native order to the creditors who cash them
at the native banks; these orders are then transferred to the
Shanghai Day and Night Bank. In all the Van Tsung Financial
Syndicate paid out $800,000 for the Bank.
The report of San Chi, the lawyer retained
by the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate, was attacked by Yan Loo
Ching, the lawyer retained by the creditors. He argued that
the Van Tsung was formed at a time when Kuang Cao Chiu was in
a dying condition and the agreement had no effect at law.
Tun Hoo Kang, the lawyer retained by Kuang's
family submitted a report on the movable and immovable properties
of the late Kuang Cao Chiu.
The Magistrate ordered the list of the
shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S to be transferred to the
Court auditors for safe keeping. The hearing was adjourned
for 14 days.
pages.zh:
1931年3月31日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。（注：原文此处拼写为KUANG CAO CHIU，与前文HUANG CHO CHIU指代同一人，即黄楚九）

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
上海日夜银行及“大世界”游乐场一案昨日由朱祥（Chuin Siang，音译）法官在法租界会审公廨审理。法庭审计员潘兆鹏（Pan Zau Pang，音译）报告称，“大中华大药房”一案将在两三天内解决。其他涉及发昌烟草公司、文天浴室（Wen Tien Bath House，音译）和“大世界”游乐场的案件正在协商中。已向欠银行款项的人提起法律诉讼。其中几人已结清账目。
债权人将获得其存款20%的退款。
叶三斗（Yih San Dau，音译）、赵新波（Zau Sin Po，音译）、邹宗庆（Tsou Zoong Ching，音译）和董辛武（Tung Sin Wu，音译）已聘请罗兆松（Loh Zau Tsoong，音译）作为他们的律师。他们否认自己是公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东，并要求提供证据。
债权人聘请的律师严鲁钦（Yan Loo Chin，音译）表示，如果他们不是公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东，为何不抗议报纸刊登他们的名字。此外，社会局已将公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东名单移交给大上海市政府聘请的律师陈炳秀（Chen Bing Siu，音译），该名单可在法庭出示以供审查。陈炳秀持有公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）股东名单的照片。他指出，股东（董事）在领取薪水和交通津贴时签了名。
叶三斗等人聘请的律师要求出示公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东原始名单。
陈炳秀已将公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东名单送交法庭审查。
万通金融银团由律师山奇（San Chi，音译）代表。他陈述称，该银团由胡兴（Hoo Shing，音译）及其他钱庄组成。已故黄楚九去年12月前往杭州，后因上海日夜银行存款事态严重而返回上海。已故黄楚九通过抵押地契，从万通金融银团获得80万美元贷款。这笔钱用于偿还储户。向债权人支付存款的方式如下：上海日夜银行向债权人签发庄票，债权人在钱庄兑现；这些庄票随后转回上海日夜银行。万通金融银团总共为该银行支付了80万美元。
万通金融银团聘请的律师山奇的报告遭到债权人聘请的律师严鲁钦（Yan Loo Ching，音译，前文为Yan Loo Chin）的反驳。他辩称，万通银团成立时黄楚九已处于垂死状态，该协议在法律上无效。
黄家聘请的律师唐浩康（Tun Hoo Kang，音译）提交了关于已故黄楚九动产和不动产的报告。
法官命令将公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东名单移交给法庭审计员保管。听证会休庭14天。

pages.en:
April 1, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The liquidation of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort is
making rapid progress. Yesterday the report of
this paper called on the Court auditors and the
following information was secured:-
Those who owe money to the Shanghai Day
and Night Bank are persons who have had business
relations with the Kung Fah Kung S and the late
Huang Cho Chiu and it is rather difficult to collect
the accounts. So far we have collected only $40,000.
The Great China Dispensary will be sold for $240,000.
The Wen Tien Bath House will be sold for $50,000 when
the rent of the house has been settled. The proceeds
from the sale of these two places with the $40,000
received from various debtors, a distribution of 10%
of deposits may be made. It is not true that creditors
will be given 20% of their deposits as reported in
newspapers yesterday.
We are ready to sell all the shops belonging
to the Kung Fah Kung S and the properties of the late
Huang Cho Chiu. Petitions will be submitted to the
French Mixed Court that the shareholders and directors
of the Kung Fah Kung S make good any deficit.

The China Times publishes the following
letters from Li Zang and Ling Dah Yoong:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
and the Great World Amusement Resort was heard at the
French Mixed Court yesterday. The directors of the
Kung Fah Kung S were represented by lawyers and they
deny being directors of the Kung Fah Kung S. They
simply want to avoid liability. The list of the
directors and shareholders of the Kung Fah Kung S
was handed to the Bureau of Social Affairs by the
Liquidation Committee and it was transferred to the
lawyers retained by the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai. Moreover, there are chits for salaries and
locomotion allowances signed by these directors. These
proofs show their responsibility.
It has been reported that someone was willing
to buy the Great World Amusement Resort for $1,800,000.
The Great World Amusement Resort will be sold for only
$800,000 and the Great China Dispensary for $240,000;
the purchase price to be paid in instalments. If the
Poh Cheng Tobacco Company be sold to the B.A.T. a sum
of more than $1,000,000 can be effected but because of
the different views of the liquidators the B.A.T. has
refused to buy the company.
We hope that the case of Chen Ts Tien, the
manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, and his son,
the accountant of the Bank, will be heard by the French
Mixed Court soon.
pages.zh:
1931年4月1日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
上海日夜银行及“大世界”游乐场的清算工作进展迅速。昨日本报记者采访了法庭审计员，获悉以下信息：-
欠上海日夜银行款项的人是那些与公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）及已故黄楚九有业务往来的人，追讨账款相当困难。截至目前，我们仅收回4万美元。“大中华大药房”将以24万美元出售。“文天浴室”在房租问题解决后将以5万美元出售。这两处地方的出售所得，加上从各债务人处收到的4万美元，可分配存款的10%。昨日报纸报道债权人将获得其存款20%的说法并不属实。
我们准备出售属于公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的所有店铺及已故黄楚九的财产。将向法租界会审公廨提交呈文，要求公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的股东和董事弥补任何赤字。

《申报》刊登了李藏（Li Zang，音译）和凌达勇（Ling Dah Yoong，音译）的如下来信：-
上海日夜银行及“大世界”游乐场一案昨日在法租界会审公廨审理。公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的董事由律师代表，他们否认自己是公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的董事。他们只是想逃避责任。公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的董事和股东名单已由清算委员会移交给社会局，并转交给大上海市政府聘请的律师。此外，还有这些董事签署的薪水和交通津贴收据。这些证据表明了他们的责任。
据报道，有人愿意以180万美元购买“大世界”游乐场。“大世界”游乐场仅售80万美元，“大中华大药房”售24万美元；购买价款分期支付。如果将宝成烟草公司（Poh Cheng Tobacco Company，音译）出售给英美烟草公司（B.A.T.），可实现100多万美元的金额，但由于清算人的意见分歧，英美烟草公司已拒绝收购该公司。
我们希望上海日夜银行经理陈子田（Chen Ts Tien，音译）及其子（该行会计师）的案件能尽快由法租界会审公廨审理。

pages.en:
April 6, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
It is reported that Tan Nee Kung, lawyer retained
by Huang's family, will complete the handing over of the
movable property to the two auditors. This property
will be exhibited at the Day and Night Bank and the
Great World Amusement Resort. Admission tickets to
these two places will be on sale but creditors will
be given complimentary ones.
The sale of the Huang Kiu Ts Dong Chinese
Drug Store and the Huang Loong Tai Tea Shop is being
arranged.
The price of the residence of the late Huang
Cho Chiu on Avenue Edward VII has been fixed at
$200,000.
The Huang family will meet on next Tuesday
and will decide on the date of the funeral. The
family will remove from the house after the funeral.
Ching Shi Zung, Doe Yeong Chise and others,
members of the Great World Visitors Savings Department
and the Day and Night Bank Creditors Committee, Lloyd
Road, will call on Yang Shae Yeong, President of the
Shanghai Special District Court next Tuesday to request
exemption of court fee which amounts to approximately
$7,000.

LABOUR

COCOON FACTORY DISPUTE.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
In connection with the agitation among the
workers of the local 35 cocoon factories who demanded
that their employers observe the agreement concluded
in October last year providing for an increase in wages,
the Bureau of Social Affairs held a mediation meeting
for the second time at 1 p.m. on April 4. Owing to
the absence of representatives of the employers, the
meeting terminated without result.
Now the Bureau of Social Affairs has instructed
Chow Bee Lien, manager of the Deo Ziang Cocoon Factory,
and Tou Ta Yeong, manager of the Tung Yih Cocoon Factory,
to detail responsible representatives in order to fix a
date for the holding of a third meeting of representatives
of the workers and of the employers.
pages.zh:
1931年4月6日。上午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
据悉，黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）将完成向两名审计员移交动产的工作。这些动产将在日夜银行和“大世界”游乐场展览。这两处地方的入场券将对外出售，但债权人将获得赠票。
正在安排出售黄九记中药店和黄隆泰茶庄。
已故黄楚九位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的住宅价格已定为20万美元。
黄家将于下周二开会，决定葬礼日期。葬礼后家属将搬离该住宅。
郑世忠（Ching Shi Zung，音译）、杜永吉（Doe Yeong Chise，音译）及其他人，作为“大世界”游客储蓄部和劳合路（Lloyd Road）日夜银行债权人委员会的成员，将于下周二拜访上海特区法院院长杨绍庸（Yang Shae Yeong，音译），请求免除约7,000美元的诉讼费。

劳工

缫丝厂纠纷。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
针对本地35家缫丝厂工人要求雇主遵守去年10月达成的增加工资协议的 agitation（骚动/抗争），社会局于4月4日下午1点第二次举行调解会议。由于雇主代表缺席，会议无果而终。
现社会局已指示德祥缫丝厂经理周必连（Chow Bee Lien，音译）和通益缫丝厂经理屠达勇（Tou Ta Yeong，音译）指派负责任的代表，以便确定举行第三次劳资代表会议的日期。

pages.en:
April 8, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

Wu Tseng and Pen Shao Paung, two auditors
appointed by the Mixed Court of the French Concession
to liquidate the Kung Fah Kung S, publish the following
advertisement in the Sin Wan Pao and other local
newspapers to-day:-
"After going through the accounts of the
Kung Dah Kung S, we have found that the capital of the
Great China Dispensary is $140,000 and that the dispensary
owes the Shanghai Day and Night Bank $100,000. Now
Tseu Paung Tsing (Manager of the Dispensary) has offered
$240,000 for the purchase of the propriety of the Great
China Dispensary, including the two branch offices in
Shanghai and one each at Hankow and Hangchow.
Permission for the transaction has been secured from
the Mixed Court and we have been authorized to receive
bargain money from the purchaser. We now publish this
advertisement in the local press for seven days and will
up an agreement for this transaction if no person offers
a higher price during these seven days (terminating
on April 14, 1931.)
pages.zh:
1931年4月8日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

吴增（Wu Tseng，音译）和彭少邦（Pen Shao Paung，音译），这两位由法租界会审公廨任命以清算公发公司（Kung Fah Kung S，音译）的审计员，今日在《新闻报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下广告：-
“经查核公大公司（Kung Dah Kung S，音译，应为公发公司之误）的账目，我们发现‘大中华大药房’的资本为14万美元，且该药房欠上海日夜银行10万美元。现药房经理周邦清（Tseu Paung Tsing，音译，前文为Chow Paung Tsung）出价24万美元购买‘大中华大药房’的产权，包括上海的两家分行以及汉口和杭州各一家分行。
交易许可已从会审公廨获得，我们已获授权接收买方的定金。现我们在本地报刊刊登此广告七天，如果在这七天内（截止至1931年4月14日）无人出更高价格，我们将就此交易签订协议。”

pages.en:
April 9, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Min Kuo Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following advertisement from Wu Tsung and
Pan Zau Paung, the Court auditors, and Tan Hee Kung,
the lawyer retained by Huang's family:-
On the orders of the French Mixed Court
on March 30, the properties of the late Huang Cho
Chiu are to be sold for the repayment of his
liabilities.
The Huang Kiu Ts Dong Chinese Drug
Store, the Huang Loong Tai Tea Shop, the Kiu Fah
Dong and its branches, the Lee Tsung Keh Tea Shop,
the Dah Zung Kiu Kee, the Dah Zung Eastern Branch
and the Sin Dah Zung are the personal property of
the late Huang Cho Chiu and have been placed under
the order of the liquidators and will be sold.
Those who are interested in the above shops may open
negotiations with the Court auditors and the lawyers
retained by Huang's family this week.
Address of the Court auditors:- Rue
du Consulate.
Address of the lawyer retained by
Huang's family:- No.35 Zung Kee Road.
pages.zh:
1931年4月9日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《民国报》及其他本地报纸刊登了法院审计员吴宗、潘兆邦以及黄家聘请的律师谭熙坤发布的如下广告：-
奉法国会审公廨3月30日之令，出售已故黄楚九之财产以偿还其债务。
黄九记中药店、黄龙泰茶庄、九发东及其分店、李总记茶庄、大中华九记、大中华东分号及新大中华均为已故黄楚九之个人财产，现已置于清算人命令之下并将予以出售。
有意购买上述店铺者，可于本周与法院审计员及黄家聘请的律师接洽。
法院审计员地址：领事馆路（Rue du Consulate）。
黄家聘请律师地址：忠记路35号。

pages.en:
April 14, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHU CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local
newspapers publish the following report:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and the Great World Savings Department
was heard yesterday at the French Mixed Court by Magistrate
Chuin Kiang.

In regard to the question of the
Directors of the Kung Fah Kung S., the lawyers defending
Yih Sa Dau, Sau Gin Pe, Tsau Seong Ching, Sung Sin Wu
and Yuang Li Tung repudiated that their clients are
Directors of the Kung Fah Kung S. The lawyers representing
the creditors insisted that they are Directors of the
Kung Fah Kung S and pointed out that had accepted the
locomotion allowances from the Kung Fah Kung S. After
arguing the Magistrate ordered the lawyers to cease
cross-examining and declared that question regarding
the Directors would be reserved for decision.

During the hearing of the case, Wu
Tsung and Pan Zau Pang, the auditors appointed by the
Court reported that some of the creditors had petitioned
the Shanghai Special District Court for an injunction
order on the Great China Dispensary and its branches
which order had been granted by the Court. The Court
auditors further requested the Magistrate to stay action
of the Shanghai Special District Court for the sale
of the Dispensary, pending negotiation. As a result
of this request, Kiang In Ding, the lawyer retained by
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai went together
with the Court auditor to Wu Ching Yoong, lawyer
retained by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to
confer regarding the injunction order on the Great
China Dispensary. The case of the Great World Savings
Department and the Shanghai Day and Night Bank will
be heard again after 14 days.

have Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Pang, the Court
auditors/instituted proceedings against those owing
money to the Kung Fah Kung S. Only few of the clients
were present yesterday and the case is postponed.
pages.zh:
1931年4月14日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
上海日夜银行与大世界储蓄部一案，昨日由法官朱江在法国会审公廨审理。

关于公发公司董事问题，为叶萨道、邵金培、曹成庆、宋信吾及杨丽通辩护的律师否认其委托人是公发公司的董事。代表债权人的律师坚持认为他们是公发公司的董事，并指出他们曾接受公发公司发放的车马费。经过辩论，法官命令律师停止交叉询问，并宣布关于董事的问题将留待裁决。

在案件审理期间，法院指派的审计员吴宗和潘兆邦报告称，部分债权人已向上海特区地方法院申请对大中华大药房及其分店发布禁令，该命令已获法院批准。法院审计员进一步请求法官暂停上海特区地方法院出售该药房的行动，以待协商。鉴于此请求，大上海市政府聘请的律师蒋英鼎会同法院审计员前往大上海市政府聘请的律师吴景雍处，就针对大中华大药房的禁令进行磋商。大世界储蓄部和上海日夜银行一案将在14天后再次审理。

吴宗和潘兆邦，法院审计员/已对欠公发公司款项的人提起诉讼。昨日仅有少数委托人出庭，案件延期。

pages.en:
April 15, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The case of misappropriation by Chen Ts Zien,
the manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, will be
heard on April 16 at the French Mixed Court.
With reference to the injunction orders against
the Great China Dispensary and the Wen Zien Bath House,
lawyers representing the creditors and the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai together with the Court auditors held
a meeting yesterday at Chhong Zu Club, Bubbling Well Road.
The following resolutions were passed:-
(1) That the creditors be requested to withdraw the
injunction order issued by the Shanghai Special
District Court against the Wen Zien Bath House.
(2) That one member of the creditors be appointed to
supervise the accounts of the Wen Zien Bath House.
(3) That the money received from the Wen Zien Bath
House be deposited with a reliable bank.
It is reported that John Wu, the lawyer
retained by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, has
promised to withdraw the injunction order against the
Great China Dispensary.
------------------

The Crystal, a mosquito paper, publishes
the following report:-
It is reported that the funeral procession
of the late Huang Cho Chiu will be held on April 24.
pages.zh:
1931年4月15日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
上海日夜银行经理陈子坚挪用公款案，将于4月16日在法国会审公廨审理。
关于针对大中华大药房和文仙浴室的禁令，代表债权人和大上海市政府的律师连同法院审计员昨日在南京路（Bubbling Well Road）崇祖俱乐部举行会议。通过以下决议：-
(1) 请债权人撤回上海特区地方法院针对文仙浴室发布的禁令。
(2) 指派一名债权人成员监督文仙浴室的账目。
(3) 从文仙浴室收取的款项须存入一家可靠的银行。
据报道，大上海市政府聘请的律师John Wu已承诺撤回针对大中华大药房的禁令。
------------------

小报《晶报》刊登了如下报道：-
据悉，已故黄楚九的出殡仪式将于4月24日举行。

pages.en:
April 16, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HWANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-
The case of misappropriation by Chen Ts
Zien, the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
was to be heard to-day. It is now postponed owing
to the request of the lawyer retained by Chen Ts Zien.

----------------------------------------

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following reports:-
Disputes have arisen since the injunction
order against the Great China Dispensary. Tseu Pong
Tsing, the Manager of the Great China Dispensary is
discouraged and he wants to withdraw from buying the
Dispensary. He has sent a letter to the Court auditors
asking for the return of the security.

----------------------------------------

The China Times publishes the following
letter from Wu Tsung and Pan Zau Pang, the auditors
appointed by the French Mixed Court:-
The news published by you in regard to
the injunction order against the Great China Dispensary
is not the fact. Wu Tsung did not attend the tiffin
party which was held at the Chong Zu Club, Bubbling well
Road. Pan Zau Pang was present but there was no meeting.
Ngah Sung, the lawyer retained by the Boys of the Wen
Zien Bath House was not there and the negotiations between
the boys and the creditors of the Wen Zien Bath House
are unknown to us.
pages.zh:
1931年4月16日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
上海日夜银行经理陈子坚挪用公款案原定于今日审理。现因陈子坚聘请的律师提出请求而延期。

----------------------------------------

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
自针对大中华大药房发布禁令以来，争议不断。大中华大药房经理周邦清感到气馁，希望退出购买该药房。他已致函法院审计员，要求退还保证金。

----------------------------------------

《时报》刊登了法国会审公廨指派的审计员吴宗和潘兆邦的如下来信：-
贵报刊登的关于针对大中华大药房禁令的消息并非事实。吴宗未出席在南京路（Bubbling well Road）崇祖俱乐部举行的午宴。潘兆邦虽在场，但并未开会。文仙浴室伙计们聘请的律师Ngah Sung不在场，我们也不了解文仙浴室伙计与债权人之间的谈判情况。

pages.en:
April 17, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local
newspapers publish the following report:-
The Great China Dispensary and the
residence of the late Huang Cho Chiu were sealed
by the Shanghai Special District Court at 5 p.m.
yesterday.
pages.zh:
1931年4月17日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登了如下报道：-
大中华大药房及已故黄楚九的住宅于昨日下午5时被上海特区地方法院查封。

pages.en:
April 18, 1931. Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times publishes the
following reports:-
The Wen Zien Bath House on Edward 7
was sealed by the Shanghai Special District Court at
10 a.m. yesterday. The settlement of the affairs of
the Shanghai Day and Night Bank are at a deadlock.
It is now a question whether the case will be heard in
the French Mixed Court or the Shanghai Special District
Court.
Owing to the sudden change of the
situation, a meeting will be held at 11 a.m. to-day
at 48, Weihaiwei Road by Chang Chuin, the Mayor of
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to discuss with
the Court auditors and the lawyers retained by the creditors.
pages.zh:
1931年4月18日。上午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》刊登了如下报道：-
爱多亚路（Edward 7）的文仙浴室于昨日上午10时被上海特区地方法院查封。上海日夜银行事务的解决陷入僵局。目前的问题是该案将在法国会审公廨还是上海特区地方法院审理。
由于局势突变，大上海市政府市长张群将于今日上午11时在威海卫路48号召开会议，与法院审计员及债权人聘请的律师进行讨论。

pages.en:
April 20, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers published the following report on April 19.

Pan Kung Tsai, Chief of the Bureau of Social Affairs called a meeting on April 18, to discuss with the lawyers of the creditors, Court auditors and the lawyers retained by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai for the settlement of the disputes of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank. The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That the Court auditors must secure the majority vote of the lawyers retained by various sides before they submit their liquidation reports to the French Mixed Court.
2) That Wu Chin Yeong and other lawyers retained by the Municipality of Greater Shanghai be requested to withdraw the injunction order against the Great China Dispensary.
3) That men be appointed by the Court auditors to supervise the accounts of the various subsidiaries of the Kung Fah Kung S.

The case of misappropriation by Chen Ts Zien, the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank was heard at the French Mixed Court on April 18. The Court auditors reported that the account books of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank are not original. The defendant is under suspicion for forgery. On the day of the death of the late Huang Cho Chiu a sum of more than $2,000,000 was paid out by the Shanghai Day and Night Bank and there were five cheques endorsed by the late Huang Cho Chiu and the signatures on the cheques were not signed by him.

Chen Ts Zien, The Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank stated that the late Huang Cho Chiu was sick and the cheques were signed by his son Hsien Tseong. Moreover the late Huang Cho Chiu was the General Manager of the Bank.

The Court auditors further reported that the late Huang Cho Chiu mortgaged 8 title deeds for the sum of $305,000 with the Shanghai Day and Night Bank, and the defendant mortgaged again with the same title deeds with the Ningpo Savings Bank and the China Industrial Bank for the sum of $680,000. As there is a difference of more than 100,000, it is the loss of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank , and the creditors. The case of the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank was remanded for seven days.

已故黄楚九事宜。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸于4月19日刊登了如下报道。

社会局局长潘公展于4月18日召开会议，与债权人律师、法院审计员及大上海市政府聘请的律师讨论解决上海日夜银行纠纷事宜。通过以下决议：-
1) 法院审计员在向法国会审公廨提交清算报告前，必须获得各方聘请律师的多数票支持。
2) 请吴钦永及其他大上海市政府聘请的律师撤回针对大中华大药房的禁令。
3) 由法院审计员指派人员监督公发公司各子公司的账目。

上海日夜银行经理陈子坚挪用公款案于4月18日在法国会审公廨审理。法院审计员报告称，上海日夜银行的账簿并非原件。被告涉嫌伪造。在已故黄楚九去世当日，上海日夜银行支出了超过200万美元的款项，其中有五张支票由已故黄楚九背书，但支票上的签名并非由其本人签署。

上海日夜银行经理陈子坚陈述称，已故黄楚九当时患病，支票由其子黄贤忠签署。此外，已故黄楚九是该银行的总经理。

法院审计员进一步报告称，已故黄楚九将8张地契抵押给上海日夜银行，借款30.5万美元，而被告又用同一批地契向宁波储蓄银行和中国实业银行再次抵押，借款68万美元。由于差额超过10万美元，这构成了上海日夜银行及债权人的损失。上海日夜银行经理一案还押七天。

April 27, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local
newspapers publish the following report:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank will be heard in the French Mixed Court
this afternoon. Some of the important points of
the case are as follows:-
The personal enterprises of the late
Huang Cho Chiu such as the Huang Kiu Ta Dong Chinese
Drug Store, the Loo Tsung Koh Tea Shop, the old Kiu
Foh Dong, the new Kiu Foh Dong, the Huang Loong Tai
Tea Shop and the Dah Sung Miscellaneous Store are to
be sold. They are now under the control of the
Court auditors and Tan Nee Kung, the lawyer retained
by Huang's family.
The sale of the Great China Dispensary
was originally to be to Tseu Pong Tsing, the Manager
of the Dispensary, but owing to the injunction order
against the Dispensary, Tseu Pong Tsing is discouraged
and he wants to withdraw from buying it. The Court
auditors are now advising him to buy it for the sake
of the general welfare.

1931年4月27日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行案将于今日下午在法国会审公廨开庭审理。本案的一些要点如下：
已故黄楚九的个人产业，如黄九大东中药店、鲁宗合茶庄、老九福东、新九福东、黄龙泰茶庄和大盛杂货店等，均将出售。这些产业目前由法院审计员以及黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tan Nee Kung，音译）监管。
大中华大药房原拟出售给该药房经理周邦清（Tseu Pong Tsing，音译），但由于针对该药房发布了禁止令，周邦清感到气馁，希望退出购买。法院审计员目前正劝说他为了公众利益买下该药房。

pages.en:
April 28, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local
newspapers publish the following reports:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort was heard in
the French Mixed Court by Magistrate Chuin Siang yesterday.
The Court auditors reported that they were in a position
to report on the conditions of the advance distribution
of the creditors deposits, but owing to the prosecution
in the Shanghai Special District Court and the injunction
orders against the Great China Dispensary and the Wen Zien
Bath House, the prospective buyers of these premises are
conducting further negotiations and Court auditors could
report again when they have definite grounds. The Court
auditors requested the lawyers retained by the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai to hand over the list of creditors,
but there was no reply.
There are three prices in regard to the
sale of the Great World Amusement Resort as follows:
(1) $700,000 Cash down.
(2) $800,000 To be paid in 3 years.
(3) $1,000,000 To be paid in 4 years.
The sale of the above Resort is now
under negotiation.
The Court auditors asked whether the
directors of the Kung Fah Kung S are responsible for
the case or not and the Magistrate answered in the
affirmative.
The lawyers retained by the creditors
asked the Magistrate whether they could have part of
their clients' deposits refunded as soon as possible
but the Magistrate stated that the request could not
be granted as the Court auditors would have to examine
the amount of credits first. The creditors were ordered
to wait for legal decision.
The case of those owing money to the
Kung Fah Kung S was heard in the same Court yesterday.
There was no decision and the case will be heard again
in one month.
pages.zh:
1931年4月28日。下午译件。

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场案昨日由法官朱祥（Chuin Siang，音译）在法国会审公廨审理。法院审计员报告称，他们本可以就债权人存款的预先分配情况进行报告，但由于在上海特区法院进行的起诉以及针对大中华大药房和文仙浴室（Wen Zien Bath House，音译）发布的禁止令，这些处所的潜在买家正在进行进一步谈判，待有确切依据后，法院审计员可再次报告。法院审计员要求大上海市政府聘请的律师移交债权人名单，但未获回复。
关于大世界游乐场的出售，有三个报价如下：
(1) 700,000美元，现金付清。
(2) 800,000美元，三年内付清。
(3) 1,000,000美元，四年内付清。
上述游乐场的出售目前正在谈判中。
法院审计员询问公发公司董事是否对本案负责，法官给予了肯定答复。
债权人聘请的律师询问法官，能否尽快退还其客户部分存款，但法官表示，由于法院审计员必须首先审查债权金额，该请求无法批准。命令债权人等待法律裁决。
欠公发公司款项的案件昨日在同一法庭审理。未作出裁决，案件将在一个月后再次审理。

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local
newspapers publish the following reports-
The creditors of the Shanghai Day
and Night Bank held a meeting yesterday in the
residence of the late Huang Cho Chiu to discuss
the selling of the Great China Dispensary, Wen Zien
Bath House, Great World Amusement Resort and the
Chong Tobacco Company. Managers of the firms
mentioned were present. It was decided that the
Wen Zien Bath House follow the decision given at
the meeting of April 14, and Court proceedings of
April 16. At the request of various parties
Tseu Pong Tsing, the Manager of the Great China
Dispensary, will buy it .

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行的债权人昨日在已故黄楚九寓所举行会议，讨论出售大中华大药房、文仙浴室、大世界游乐场和崇烟草公司（Chong Tobacco Company，音译）的事宜。上述公司的经理出席了会议。会议决定，文仙浴室遵循4月14日会议的决定及4月16日的诉讼程序。应各方要求，大中华大药房经理周邦清（Tseu Pong Tsing，音译）将购买该药房。

May 8, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local
newspapers publish the following report:-
The case of the Shanghai Day and
Night Bank and the Great World Amusement Resort was
heard in the French Mixed Court by Magistrate Chuin
Siang yesterday. The Court auditors reported that
they have passed the following conditions at a meeting
held with the lawyers of the creditors and the lawyer
retained by Huang's family in the residence of the late
Huang Cho Chiu:-
(1) That the Great China Dispensary is to be
sold to Tseu Pang Tsing, the Manager of the
concern for a sum of $240,000
(2) That the Wen Zien Bath House will be sold
for $50,000
(3) That the Foh Chong Tobacco Company will be
sold for $520,000
(4) That the sale of the Great World Amusement
Resort will be announced later
Bien Kya Loh, the lawyer retained by
the plaintiff requested the Manager of the Great China
Dispensary to pay the money as soon as possible as the
creditors are badly in need of money.
Yien Loo Ching, the lawyer retained by
the creditors stated that the late Huang Cho Chiu was
in possession of many diamonds but there are only three
diamonds mentioned on the list of his movable property.
This has aroused the suspicion of the creditors. Moreover
the three diamonds are now mortgaged to others. The
lawyer called the special attention of the Magistrate
to this matter. One large emerald which weighs 327
catties and is worth more than $100,000 is deposited
at Liu Pao Ken's place. The liquidators ought to
pay special attention to this emerald.
The Magistrate ordered the liquidators
to carry on in accordance with their report. The
case will be heard again.
pages.zh:
1931年5月8日。下午译件。

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
上海日夜银行和大世界游乐场案昨日由法官朱祥（Chuin Siang，音译）在法国会审公廨审理。法院审计员报告称，他们在已故黄楚九寓所与债权人律师及黄家聘请的律师举行的会议上通过了以下条件：
(1) 大中华大药房将以240,000美元的价格出售给该机构经理周邦清（Tseu Pang Tsing，音译）
(2) 文仙浴室将以50,000美元的价格出售
(3) 佛崇烟草公司（Foh Chong Tobacco Company，音译）将以520,000美元的价格出售
(4) 大世界游乐场的出售将稍后公布
原告聘请的律师Bien Kya Loh（音译）要求大中华大药房经理尽快付款，因为债权人急需资金。
债权人聘请的律师严鹿卿（Yien Loo Ching，音译）指出，已故黄楚九拥有许多钻石，但其动产清单上仅列有三颗钻石。这引起了债权人的怀疑。此外，这三颗钻石目前已抵押给他人。该律师提请法官特别注意此事。一颗重达327斤、价值超过100,000美元的大祖母绿宝石存放在刘宝根（Liu Pao Ken，音译）处。清算人应特别注意这颗祖母绿宝石。
法官命令清算人按照其报告继续执行。案件将再次审理。

pages.en:
D. S. I. Montgomery

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report:-

The case of misappropriation by Chen
Ts Zien, the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank, was heard in the French Mixed Court yesterday.
Huang Shen Tsoong, son of the late Huang Cho Chiu
acknowledged the signatures which appeared on the 5
cheques . They were cashed from the above mentioned
Bank on the day of the Huang Cho Chiu's death.

Huang Shen Tsoong, son of the late Huang
Cho Chiu and Chen Ts Zien, the Manager of the Shanghai
Day and Night Bank were released on Bail. The case
has been suspended for 7 days later.
pages.zh:
D. S. I. Montgomery

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：

上海日夜银行经理陈子坚（Chen Ts Zien，音译）挪用公款案昨日在法国会审公廨审理。已故黄楚九之子黄慎宗（Huang Shen Tsoong，音译）承认出现在5张支票上的签名。这些支票是在黄楚九去世当天从上述银行兑现的。

已故黄楚九之子黄慎宗（Huang Shen Tsoong，音译）和上海日夜银行经理陈子坚（Chen Ts Zien，音译）获准保释。案件休庭7天。

pages.en:
D. S. I. Montgomery

May 18, 1931. Afternoon Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report on May 17:-

The case of misappropriation by Chen Ts Zien,
the Manager of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank was heard
in the French Mixed Court on May 16. Wang Ts Yuan,
representing the Van Tsung Financial Syndicate, reported
that the late Huang Cho Chiu borrowed more than $300,000
from the Syndicate against his title deeds. They are
not acquainted with the signing of cheques by Huang Shien
Tsoong, son of the late Huang Cho Chiu. Tang Nee Kung,
lawyer retained by Huang's family, stated that Wang Ts
Yuan, representative of the Syndicate, must have been
present at the time the cheques were signed, otherwise
Huang Shien Tsoong dared not sign the cheques.

The liquidators claimed that certain pages
of the account books of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank
are missing and the account books of the Kung Fah Kung S
are not the original.

The Magistrate ordered that Huang Shien Tsoong
be granted bail and the case was remanded for further
hearing.
pages.zh:
D. S. I. Montgomery

1931年5月18日。下午译件

杂项

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》及其他本地报纸于5月17日刊登如下报道：

上海日夜银行经理陈子坚（Chen Ts Zien，音译）挪用公款案于5月16日在法国会审公廨审理。代表万通金融辛迪加（Van Tsung Financial Syndicate，音译）的王子元（Wang Ts Yuan，音译）报告称，已故黄楚九以其地契为抵押，向该辛迪加借款超过300,000美元。他们对已故黄楚九之子黄慎宗（Huang Shien Tsoong，音译）签署支票一事并不知情。黄家聘请的律师谭尼公（Tang Nee Kung，音译）表示，辛迪加代表王子元在签署支票时一定在场，否则黄慎宗不敢签署支票。

清算人声称，上海日夜银行的账簿缺页，且公发公司的账簿并非原件。

法官命令准予黄慎宗保释，案件延期以待进一步审理。

D. S. I. Montgomery.

May 29, 1931.                                      Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

        THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.
                The Eastern Times publishes the following
report:-
                As the Great World Amusement Resort represents
the biggest asset of the Kung Fah Kung S, the Court auditors
are planning to sell it in order to repay creditors.
                It is reported that the Sun Li Company (勝利公司)

certain that they will make a contract with the liquidators
on obtaining the approval of the French Mixed Court.

June 5, 1931.
Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times publishes the following
correspondence written by Fu Zien Kee:-
Several months have elapsed since the
liquidation of the Kung Fah Kung S commenced but the
proceedings are being carried out exceedingly slowly.
The Great World Amusement Resort has been leased for
six months. However I, being a creditor, am very
anxious over the question of selling the said
amusement resort. I do not know whether the lease
will be extended or not.
It is earnestly hoped that the auditors,
who possess the power will sell the property, will
pay attention to the pitiful condition of the creditors
and will sell the property instead of leasing it.
Should there be any deficits, they should ask the
directors of the concern to make them good.
Another doubtful point is that the auditors
have, so far, failed to prosecute the directors of
the concern.

杂项：

已故黄楚九事宜。

《时报》刊登傅见基（Fu Zien Kee，音译）撰写的如下来信：
公发公司清算开始至今已数月，但进程极其缓慢。大世界游乐场已出租六个月。然而，作为债权人，我对出售该游乐场的问题感到非常焦虑。我不知道租约是否会延长。
恳请拥有出售财产权力的审计员关注债权人的悲惨处境，出售财产而非出租。如有任何亏空，应要求该公司董事予以弥补。
另一个疑点是，审计员至今未能起诉该公司董事。

3,386 Persons In
Great World Suit

Seek To Regain $1,000,-
000 From Closed
Savings Bank

Naming a number of well-known
local merchants as defendants, a
group of 3,386 persons, the creditors
of the Day and Night Bank and
the Savings Department of the
Great World amusement resort,
sought the return of more than
$1,000,000 in Special District Court
yesterday morning. The case was
adjourned.

shareholders of the Kung Fah
Company, which, the petition says,
controlled the bank and the savings
department, which was forced to
close after the death of Mr. Wang
Tao-chu recently

Also named as correspondents
were Wang Hsi-chun and Wang
Hsi-yao, the two sons of the late
Mr. Wang, said to have sponsored
the company.

The creditors were represented
by Mr. Chin Shi-jen, while Dr.
John C. H. Wu, Klang I-ping and
Chen Ting-sai, who have been
appointed by the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai to attend to
legal aspects in the rehabilitation
of the icons of the concerns were
requested to act as attorneys.

Judge Chow adjourned the case
because none of the defendants
was present at the court.

《大美晚报》（The China Press），1931年6月9日，星期二

大世界诉讼案涉及3,386人

寻求从关闭的储蓄银行追回100万美元

一群共3,386人，即日夜银行及大世界游乐场所储蓄部的债权人，于昨日上午在特区法院提起诉讼，要求归还超过100万美元的款项，并将多名本地知名商人列为被告。案件已延期审理。

诉状称，这些商人是公发公司（Kung Fah Company）的董事和股东，该公司控制着上述银行及储蓄部；该机构在王韬朱（Wang Tao-chu，音译）先生最近去世后被迫关闭。

已故王先生的两个儿子王希俊（Wang Hsi-chun，音译）和王希尧（Wang Hsi-yao，音译）也被列为相关方，据称他们是该公司的发起人。

债权人由金世仁（Chin Shi-jen，音译）先生代理，同时请求吴经熊（Dr. John C. H. Wu）、江一平（Klang I-ping，音译）和陈定谟（Chen Ting-sai，音译）担任律师，此三人已由大上海市政府任命，负责处理相关企业复兴过程中的法律事务。

周法官因被告无人出庭而宣布休庭。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, June 17, 1931

Night Bank Will
Pay Ten Percent

Depositors To Get Small
Percentage Of Money
Tomorrow Morning

Depositors of the Insolvent Day
and Night Bank may draw 10 per-
cent of their deposits beginning
tomorrow morning from the tem-
porary office of the Shanghai Com-
mercial and Savings Bank next to
the Great World Amusement Re-
sort, Avenue Edward VII, Messrs.
Wu Tseng and Pan Tsou-pong,
liquidators appointed by the French
Mixed Court, announced today.

With the Dragon Boat Festival
Saturday, the first settlement day
of the year according to lunar
calendar, approaching, Messrs. Wu
and Pan, in order to relieve the
anxiety of the depositors, borrowed
$150,000 from the Shanghai Com-
mercial and Savings Bank with
which to pay 10 percent of their
funds.

The office will remain open from
9 a.m. to 4 p.m., including the tif-
fin hours. The depositors, however,
must have their books countersign-
ed by the liquidators before pre-
senting the documents to the
cashier, Messrs. Wu and Pan an-
nounced.

The Day and Night Bank, the
sole financial organ under the Kung
Fah Company, of which Mr. Wang
Tso-chiu had controlling interest,
went into bankruptcy when Mr.
Wang died. The bank closed its
doors on January 20. The books
revealed shortage of more than
$3,500,000 and only a small sum
of cash was found in the bank's
safe.

The depositors, most of them be-
ing of laboring class, jointly filed
a suit against Mr. Wang's heirs and
the Kung Fah Company in the
French Mixed Court.

To meet the claims, Mr. Wang's
residence on Avenue Edward VII
and his valuable collection of old
Chinese art relics are being sold by
auction.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》（The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury），19316月17日，星期三

日夜银行将支付百分之十

储户明晨可领取小部分存款

法国会审公廨任命的清算人吴增（Wu Tseng，音译）和潘祖鹏（Pan Tsou-pong，音译）今日宣布，资不抵债的日夜银行储户可从明晨起，在爱多亚路大世界游乐场旁的上海商业储蓄银行临时办事处提取其存款的10%。

随着农历年度第一个结算日——本周六的端午节临近，吴、潘二人为缓解储户焦虑，向上海商业储蓄银行借款15万美元，用于支付其资金的10%。

办事处开放时间从上午9时至下午4时，包括午餐时间。然而，吴、潘二人宣布，储户在向出纳员出示单据前，必须由其存折经清算人会签。

日夜银行是王佐秋（Wang Tso-chiu，音译）先生拥有控股权的公发公司（Kung Fah Company）旗下的唯一金融机构，在王先生去世后破产。该银行于1月20日关门。账目显示短缺超过350万美元，银行保险柜内仅发现少量现金。

储户大多为劳工阶层，他们联合向法国会审公廨起诉王先生的继承人和公发公司。

为满足索赔要求，王先生位于爱多亚路的住宅及其珍贵的中国古艺术收藏品正在拍卖。

SALE OF THE LATE HUANG CHU CHUI PROPERTY BY TENDERS
CANCELLED.

The China Times and other local newspapers publish
the following reports:-
With reference to the liquidation of the King Fah
King Sz, the case was again heard yesterday by the French
Mixed Court.
Tung Yue, a lawyer, representing the creditors,
reported that he and another lawyer were present at the
opening of the tenders for the sale of the property.
However Luh Ki Jin an applicant illegally drove away Mo
Zau Kee, another applicant ,upon learning that this latter
had offered $50,000 more for the purchase of one of the
estates belonging to the late Huang Che Chui . The 2 Court
auditors failed to stop this illegal action.
Kiang Ih Ping, a lawyer, suggested that the sale
of the property by tender be cancelled in the interest of the
creditors.
Magistrate Kying granted the request and has
issued an order cancelling the sale of the property by
tender on both occasions.
pages.zh:
O.S.T. Montgomery
译文。

已故黄楚九财产招标出售取消。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
关于公发公司（King Fah King Sz，音译）的清算事宜，法国会审公廨昨日再次开庭审理。
代表债权人的律师董岳（Tung Yue，音译）报告称，他和另一位律师出席了财产出售招标的开标现场。然而，申请人陆其金（Luh Ki Jin，音译）在得知另一申请人莫祖祺（Mo Zau Kee，音译）为购买已故黄楚九（Huang Che Chui，音译）的一处产业多出价50,000美元后，非法驱赶了莫祖祺。两名法院审计员未能制止这一非法行为。
律师江一平（Kiang Ih Ping，音译）建议，为了债权人的利益，取消财产招标出售。

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

Mr. Tan Nee Kung, lawyer retained by
the Huang Cho Chiu family, has submitted a petition
to the French Mixed Court objecting to the disposal

tenders.
The petition refutes the report of
Messrs. Wu Tseng and Pan Zau Paung, auditors, who

The petition also states that corruption
is unavoidable in the process of sale, as for instance
in the case of the sale of the Great World Amusement

the Kung Fah Kung S. Creditor-lawyers and the
auditors are originally decided to dispose of this
resort by auction fixing the price at $1,250,000
but it was sold for $700,000 in some underhand manner.

July 31, 1931. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The China Times and other local newspapers published the following on July 30:-
Yesterday afternoon the case of the liquidation of the Day and Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department was again heard at the French Mixed Court.
Mr. Pan Zau Paung, court auditor, reported that the change in liquidating the estate by auction had been made and stated that the list showing the values of Huang Cho Chiu's movable and immoveable properties which was compiled by lawyer Tan Hee Kung, representing the Huang family, and showed the value as several million dollars, was discovered to have been grossly overestimated.
Lawyer Tan Hee Kung requested the Court to rescind the court's decision of July 18 regarding the sale of certain of Huang Cho Chiu's properties.
The creditor-lawyers informed the Court that they agreed to the disposal of Huang's properties by advertising in the newspapers.
Magistrate Chuan Shiang passed a decision rejecting lawyer Tan Hee Kung's request for the cancellation of the court decision of July 18, and also instructing auditors to advertise Huang Cho Chiu's properties for sale in the newspapers. They will be sold to the highest bidders. The auditors were also ordered to investigate if any of the property had been concealed by Huang's family.

---------

Messrs. Wu Tseng and Pan Zau Paung, Court auditors, recently submitted a report to the Bureau of Social Affairs of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai on their work of liquidating the Kung Fah Kung S, its subsidiary enterprises and the business shops which latter were solely conducted by the late Huang Cho Chiu. The Bureau has ordered these auditors to deal with this work in a just manner.
The sum of $700,000 for which the Great World Amusement Resort was sold will be paid off by the end of this month. The Bureau has directed the auditors to pay the money back to the creditors when collection has been made.
Shareholders and directors of the Kung Fah Kung S will be held responsible for deficits to cover the liabilities of the Day and Night Bank and the Great World Visitors Savings Department.

September 26, 1934.    .French Translation

HIGH COURT

APPEAL OF THE LIQUIDATION CASE.

The China Times publishes the following
report :-
    The civil case, brought by four independent
lawyers, appointed by the local Bureau of Social Affairs
and representing the creditors of the King & High Bank
and the Great World Visitors Savings Department, against
the preliminary decision passed by the District French
Mixed Court to the effect that Yih Sun Sun (    )
could not be held responsible, not being a shareholder
or director of the King Sun Kang Co., was heard yesterday
afternoon before Judge Sun Tsung Hsi of the Third Branch
Shanghai High Court.
    Kwong Hai Sung (    ) and other representatives
of the creditors having explained the reasons for opposing
the verdict of the French Mixed Court, thereupon the
lawyers represented that the credit of this liquidation
case is $150,000 plus some $6,135,000, exclusive of the
debt which has not yet been estimated.
    Lawyer Lee Sun Tseng (    ), representing
the defendant Yih Sun Sun, stated that inasmuch as no
adequate reasons for appeal have been received from the
complainants, no argument in the matter is possible.
Furthermore, the defendant had transferred his shares
to Kuh Chang Sung (    ). The lawyer then
presented the letter from the late Huang Cho Shin permitting
the transfer of the shares, which clearly proves that
Yih Sun Sun was not a shareholder of the King Sun Kang
Co.
    Lawyers Tang Tso and Tan Ioo Chang, representing
the creditors, then explained that they also appealed
the preliminary decision of the case and joined issue
with the four lawyers against the decision referred to.
    Lawyer Lee Sun Tseng replied that no copy
of appeal from lawyers Tang and Tan had been received
by him or his clients.
    Simultaneously lawyers, representing Gwo
Ching Po (    ), Kwan Jeong Chung (    ) and Gwan
Ming In (    ), who were ordered by the defendant French
Mixed Court to be held responsible as shareholders and
directors, requested the Court to be allowed to appeal
against the judgment.
    Judge Sun ordered the complainants to submit
their respective grounds for appeal, after which the
case will again be heard.

D. S. J. Montgomery
MR.
pages.zh:
1934年9月26日。    .法文译本

高等法院

清算案上诉。

《字林西报》刊登如下报道：-
    由当地社会局任命、代表金高银行（King & High Bank，音译）和大世界游客储蓄部债权人的四位独立律师提起的民事案件，针对法租界区会审公廨作出的初步判决（该判决认定益孙孙（Yih Sun Sun，音译）因非金孙康公司（King Sun Kang Co.，音译）的股东或董事而不承担责任），昨日下午在上海高等法院第三分院孙宗禧（Sun Tsung Hsi，音译）法官面前开庭审理。
    邝海松（Kwong Hai Sung，音译）及其他债权人代表解释了反对法租界会审公廨判决的理由后，律师们随即表示，本案债权金额为150,000美元加上约6,135,000美元，不包括尚未估算的债务。
    代表被告益孙孙的李森曾（Lee Sun Tseng，音译）律师陈述，鉴于上诉人未收到充分的上诉理由，因此无法就此进行辩论。此外，被告已将其股份转让给顾长松（Kuh Chang Sung，音译）。该律师随后出示了已故黄楚新（Huang Cho Shin，音译）允许转让股份的信件，这清楚地证明益孙孙并非金孙康公司的股东。
    代表债权人的唐佐（Tang Tso，音译）和谭一昌（Tan Ioo Chang，音译）律师随后解释称，他们也对该案的初步判决提出上诉，并与那四位律师一起对上述判决提出异议。
    李森曾律师回答说，他或其当事人均未收到唐律师和谭律师的上诉状副本。
    同时，代表郭清波（Gwo Ching Po，音译）、关正忠（Kwan Jeong Chung，音译）和关明仁（Gwan Ming In，音译）的律师（此三人被被告方法租界会审公廨判令作为股东和董事承担责任）请求法庭允许其对判决提出上诉。
    孙法官命令上诉人提交各自的上诉理由，此后将再次审理此案。

D. S. J. 蒙哥马利
先生
