October 21, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HWANG CHU CHIEU.

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers publish
the following report:-
In connection with the closure of the Shanghai
Day & Night Bank and the Savings Department of the Great
World Resort, the French Mixed Court passed a decision to
commission Fan Chao Ban ( ) to take charge of the
liquidation of the accounts and refuted the accusation
plaintiff's accusation against the directors and shareholders,
Messrs. Yeh San Bau ( ) and others. The lawyers,
Yien Lu Ching ( ), and colleagues representing the
creditors, declared their dissatisfaction with this verdict
and have appealed to the former French Mixed Court for re-
trial of the case.
As the ex-French Mixed Court was surrendered
to the National Government which established the 3rd Branch
High Court in its stead, the case was heard by Judge Tsao Chen
Hai ( ) of that court at 2.30 p.m. yesterday. The
lawyers representing the creditors were first questioned
regarding the total sum of the credits and the amount of
money to be accounted for, At the same time, they were
informed that, with regard to the question of responsibility
of the directors and shareholders, another group of lawyers
consisting of Dr. C.C.Wu and his colleagues, representing
some 3,386 creditors, had already lodged an appeal which was
tried once by this Court. They were therefore asked if
they propose to keep pace with this latter party of creditor
lawyers and lodge an appeal on the question. They replied
explaining that they were the party of creditor lawyers who
first took the initiative by demanding an appeal, consequently,
they are the responsible lawyers in the dispute. The
three major clauses of their appeal are, viz.,
1. The question of responsibility of the directors and
shareholders of the Bank and Resort's Savings Department,
Messrs. Yeh San Bau and others.
2. The verdict of the ex-French Mixed Court to appropriate
$20,000 from the amount of the credit as lawyers
expenses for the late Hwang Chu Chieu's family, which
claim was opposed in general by the creditors.
3. The verdict of the ex-French Mixed Court to draw
$40,000 from the amount of credits for living expenses
of the late Hwang Chu Chieu's family, which claim
was also disapproved of in general by the creditors.
After submitting a request to appeal for these
three general principles, the above-mentioned lawyers representing
the creditors, were asked by the Judge to furnish full details
of their appeal within twenty days when the case will be tried
again.
pages.zh:
1931年10月21日。下午译本。

杂项。

已故黄楚九事宜。

《申报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
关于上海日夜银行及大世界游乐场储蓄部停业一事，法租界会审公廨作出决定，委托范兆班（Fan Chao Ban，音译）负责账目清算，并驳回了原告对董事及股东叶三宝（Yeh San Bau，音译）等人提出的指控。代表债权人的律师颜鲁青（Yien Lu Ching，音译）及其同事声明对该判决不满，并向原法租界会审公廨上诉，要求重审此案。
由于原法租界会审公廨已移交给国民政府，并由其设立的高等法院第三分院取代，该案于昨日下午2时30分由该院曹震海（Tsao Chen Hai，音译）法官审理。法官首先询问代表债权人的律师关于债权总额及需核算的金额。同时，被告知关于董事和股东的责任问题，另一组由吴凯声博士（Dr. C.C.Wu）及其同事组成的律师团，代表约3,386名债权人，已经提出上诉，且本院已审理过一次。因此，法官询问他们是否打算跟随这批债权人律师的步伐，就此问题提出上诉。他们答复解释说，他们是首先主动要求上诉的债权人律师团体，因此，他们是本案争议中的负责律师。他们上诉的三个主要条款如下：
1. 银行及游乐场储蓄部董事和股东叶三宝等人的责任问题。
2. 原法租界会审公廨判决从债权金额中拨出20,000美元作为已故黄楚九家属的律师费用，该主张普遍遭到债权人反对。
3. 原法租界会审公廨判决从债权金额中拨出40,000美元作为已故黄楚九家属的生活费，该主张也普遍遭到债权人反对。
在就这三项一般原则提出上诉请求后，上述代表债权人的律师被法官要求在二十天内提供详细的上诉理由，届时将再次审理此案。

pages.en:
November 24, 1931.
2nd Morning Translation.

The Sin Kuo Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report :-
Following the bankruptcy of the Day & Night
Bank and the Great World Visitors Saving Department,
the property of the late Huang Cho Chiu was ordered by
the defunct French Mixed Court to be sold by tender.
So far, the affair has not yet been terminated.
The case came before Judge Tong Yi Tsung of the
2nd Shanghai Special District Court, who informed the
lawyers & the creditors that the hearing was based on
the judgment passed on July 29 by the defunct French
Mixed Court and had been specially opened with the object
of solving the question of selling by tender all the
immovable property of the late Huang Cho Chiu. This
sale would not affect the creditors. Judge Tong then
questioned Lawyer Tan Kee Sung, acting on behalf of Huang
Cho Chiu's family, whether or not all Huang's property
had been reported.
Lawyer Tan Kee Sung replied that Huang had a
piece of real estate at Hangchow but his creditors there
had filed an action. The balance of the proceeds from
the sale of the estate, after settling the creditors at
Hangchow, will be transferred to Shanghai.
Questioned whether the property of the Public
Cemetery was owned by the late Huang Cho Chiu, Lawyer Tan
replied that the deceased had a share in the property and
had acted as manager. This point could be definitely
settled after meetings had been held by Board of Directors
of this Cemetery. The houses of the San Ming Theatre,
the Tien Am Hotel, etc. etc., were built on leased land,
and the question of disposal should be solved without delay.
Lawyer Tan added that about $2,000,000 of private debts
had been incurred by the late Huang Cho Chiu and should be
immediately liquidated.
Lawyer Tang then made the following important
report :-
"It will be remembered that the late Huang Cho
Chiu leased a large number of houses along Nanking Road
from a certain unknown person, and for which Huang had
agreed to pay $78,000 yearly as land fees and rates.
The agreement stated that the sum was to be paid in two
instalments and that the land proprietor had the right
to recover the land unconditionally should an instalment
fall in arrears. The deceased later pledged the leased
property for $11,000 with the Tung Wei Company. It
should not be overlooked that a loss of $4,000 had been
sustained every month through these houses. The Tung
Wei Company has advanced $30,000 for the land fees, etc.
since Huang Cho Chiu's death. The payment of an
instalment had now arrived, and after negotiations with
the land owner payment of the fees has been suspended
for the time being. I request the Court to settle this
question as early as possible so as to save both sides
from further loss."
Lawyers Yen Lu Chang and Li Tien Kyi, representing
the creditors, stated that this matter must first be
investigated by the creditors.
Judge Tong ordered Messrs. Yen and Wu, the Court
Auditors, to devise measures for the quick sale of Huang's
property.
pages.zh:
1931年11月24日。
第二次晨间译件。

《新国报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
继日夜银行（Day & Night Bank）及大世界游客储蓄部破产后，已撤销的法国混合法庭下令以招标方式出售已故黄楚九（Huang Cho Chiu）的财产。迄今，此事尚未终结。
该案提交至上海第二特区地方法院童义宗（Tong Yi Tsung）法官审理，他告知律师及债权人，本次听证系依据已撤销的法国混合法庭于7月29日作出的判决而特别开启，旨在解决以招标方式出售已故黄楚九所有不动产的问题。此次出售不会影响债权人利益。随后，童法官询问代表黄楚九家属的谭其松（Tan Kee Sung）律师，是否已申报黄的所有财产。
谭其松律师回答说，黄在杭州有一处不动产，但那里的债权人已提起诉讼。在清偿杭州债权人后，该地产出售所得余款将汇至上海。
当被问及公墓产业是否归已故黄楚九所有时，谭律师回答说，死者在该产业中持有股份并担任管理人。待该公墓董事会召开会议后，此点可得到明确解决。三星大戏院（San Ming Theatre）、天庵旅馆（Tien Am Hotel）等房屋均建在租赁土地上，其处置问题应尽快解决。谭律师补充说，已故黄楚九欠下约200万美元私人债务，应立即清算。
唐律师随后作了如下重要报告：
“众所周知，已故黄楚九向某身份不明人士租赁了南京路沿线的大量房屋，黄同意每年支付78,000美元作为地税及捐税。协议规定，该款项分两期支付，若任何一期逾期，土地所有者有权无条件收回土地。死者后来将租赁物业抵押给通威公司（Tung Wei Company），借款11,000美元。不容忽视的是，这些房屋每月造成4,000美元的亏损。自黄楚九去世后，通威公司已垫付地税等费用30,000美元。目前一期付款期限已到，经与地主协商，暂时缓缴费用。我请求法庭尽早解决此问题，以免双方遭受进一步损失。”
代表债权人的严鹿章（Yen Lu Chang）和李天基（Li Tien Kyi）律师表示，此事必须先由债权人进行调查。
童法官命令法院审计员严先生和吴先生制定措施，以便迅速出售黄的财产。

pages.en:
D.S.I. Montgomery

December 3, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIR OF LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Min Kuo Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following report :-
Following the bankruptcy of the Day & Night
Bank, the former French Mixed Court ordered Fan and Wu,
the Court auditors, to liquidate the property of the
Bank, of the Sun Fah Jung S and of the late Huang Cho
Chiu. The Court accountants subsequently discovered
that several hundred catties of jade stone to the value
of over $1,000,000 belonging to Huang had been entrusted
to Liu Pao Kang, a gem merchant, to be cut up. Liu
was summoned and attended the hearing of the defunct
French Mixed Court on July 8, at which an order was made
for the jade stones to be handed over to the Court for
disposal.

The case came up for further hearing yesterday
in the 2nd Shanghai Special District Court. Li Dah
Wei, representative of Liu Pao Kang, handed to the Court
all the stones entrusted by the deceased to Liu, and stated
that Wong Soong Nyi was also in possession of a quantity
of jade stones belonging to Huang.

Wong Soong Nyi, a jeweller, stated that
sometime in February 1930, the late Huang Cho Chiu handed
him about sixty catties of stone to be cut up and that
the transaction had been settled.

Yen Lu Ching, a lawyer acting on behalf of
the creditors, stated that Wong Soong Nyi's statement
required an investigation.

Judge Wong Vi Tsung ordered that the jade
stones handed over by Liu Pao Kang be temporarily placed
under the care of the Court, and instructed Fan and Wu,
the auditors, to ascertain whether any more stones were
in the possession of the two jewellers.
pages.zh:
副督察长 蒙哥马利（Montgomery）

1931年12月3日。下午译件。

杂项

已故黄楚九（HUANG CHO CHIU）事件。

《民国日报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
继日夜银行破产后，前法国混合法庭命令法院审计员范某和吴某清算该银行、孙发荣（Sun Fah Jung S）以及已故黄楚九的财产。法院会计师随后发现，价值超过100万美元、重达数百斤的属于黄的玉石，已委托给珠宝商刘宝康（Liu Pao Kang）进行切割加工。刘被传唤，并于7月8日出席已撤销的法国混合法庭的听证会，会上命令将玉石移交法庭处置。

该案昨日在上海第二特区地方法院继续审理。刘宝康的代表李大伟（Li Dah Wei）向法庭递交了死者委托给刘的所有玉石，并声明王松尼（Wong Soong Nyi）也持有一部分属于黄的玉石。

珠宝商王松尼陈述称，1930年2月某时，已故黄楚九交给他约六十斤玉石进行切割加工，且该交易已结清。

代表债权人的律师严鹿清（Yen Lu Ching）表示，王松尼的陈述需要调查。

黄维宗（Wong Vi Tsung）法官命令将刘宝康移交的玉石暂由法庭保管，并指示审计员范某和吴某查明这两位珠宝商手中是否还藏有其他玉石。

pages.en:
SHANGHAI
C. & S.
January 28 No B. D. 1949
14 - 2 - 31

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE WONG CHO CHU.

Yu Yah Ching, Wong Siau Lan and Wong Yen Soong
publish a joint advertisement in the Sin 'an Pao and
other local newspapers to-day announcing that owing to
certain difficulties they have encountered, they have
resigned from the Ong Cho Chu Liquidation Committee.
As the Mixed Court of the French Concession has appointed
two auditors to deal with the case and as the Social
Bureau of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has sent
deputies to make an investigation, this matter will
hereafter be dealt with by the administrative and
judicial organs.

Liquidator also resigns.

Lau Yoong Cho, an auditor, publishes an
advertisement announcing that he had undertaken the
liquidation of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank and the
Great World Visitors Savings Department at the request
of the Wong Cho Chu Liquidation Committee, but as half
of the members of the Committee have resigned and as
the French Mixed Court has appointed two auditors to
undertake the liquidation, he has resigned and handed
over all documents, etc., to the auditors appointed
by the Mixed Court.

Mr. T. T. Yuan's Statement.

The Wong Cho Chu Liquidation Committee called
an urgent meeting at 6 p.m. January 27 but as only
Yuan Li Tang, Yieh San Tao and Zau Chun Pu were present,
the meeting was not held.
Mr. Yuan has informed a reporter of the
Hwa Tung News Agency that the resignation of Yu Yah Ching,
Wong Siau Lan and Wong Yen Soong was due to the formation
of six creditors groups and to the differences of views
amongst these creditors. It is hoped that their
resignation will bring unanimity amongst the creditors
and who will send representatives to confer with the
Committee. Mr. Yuan added that if the Committee were
dissolved, it would cause great suffering to the creditors.
Mr. Huang Cho Chu's family is persuading Yu Yah Ching,
Wong Siau Lan and Wong Yen Soong to withdraw their resignation.
pages.zh:
上海
C. & S.
1949年1月28日 无 B. D. 编号
1931年2月14日

已故黄楚九（WONG CHO CHU）*事件。

(*注：此处原文拼写为Wong Cho Chu，与前文Huang Cho Chiu指代同一人，依指令保留差异或视为异译，此处依上下文及后文统一性，结合当时习惯，黄楚九亦作Wong Cho Chu，故译为黄楚九，但保留原文拼写差异带来的困惑，按指令不确定保留原文加音译，但鉴于前文已确定Huang Cho Chiu为黄楚九，且此处明显为同一案件，故仍译黄楚九，但在机构名等处注意区分。根据指令4，残缺或错误照实，此处Wong Cho Chu应为Huang Cho Chiu之异拼或OCR/录入错误，但为严谨，若视为不同人则需音译。考虑到历史事实，此为同一人。为符合指令3“能确定的用当时通行中文”，此处确认为黄楚九。)

于亚卿（Yu Yah Ching）、黄小兰（Wong Siau Lan）和黄燕松（Wong Yen Soong）今日在《新安报》及其他本地报纸联合刊登广告，宣布由于遇到某些困难，他们已从黄楚九清算委员会辞职。鉴于法租界混合法庭已任命两名审计员处理此案，且大上海市政府社会局已派遣代表进行调查，此后此事将由行政和司法机关处理。

清算人也辞职。

审计员刘永潮（Lau Yoong Cho）刊登广告宣布，他曾应黄楚九清算委员会的请求，承担上海日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的清算工作，但由于委员会半数成员已辞职，且法国混合法庭已任命两名审计员负责清算，他已辞职并将所有文件等移交给混合法庭任命的审计员。

袁履登（T. T. Yuan / Yuan Li Tang）先生的声明。

黄楚九清算委员会于1月27日下午6时召开紧急会议，但因只有袁履登、叶三多（Yieh San Tao）和邹春圃（Zau Chun Pu）出席，会议未能举行。
袁先生告诉华东通讯社记者，于亚卿、黄小兰和黄燕松的辞职是由于形成了六个债权人团体，且这些债权人之间意见分歧。希望他们的辞职能使债权人达成一致，并派代表与委员会磋商。袁先生补充说，如果委员会解散，将给债权人带来巨大痛苦。黄楚九家属正在劝请于亚卿、黄小兰和黄燕松撤回辞呈。

pages.en:
February 16, 1931.    Morning Translation.    S. B. D. 1949.
                                            19 - 2 - 31

MISCELLANEOUS

THE AFFAIRS OF THE LATE HUNG CHO CHIH

The Eastern Ti mes and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
Ching Shih Sung, Tsao Sung Sing, Loh Ping Yen, Tsui Veng Ping, Yuen Lee Lai and Su Yuien Song, representatives of the Creditors Committee, yesterday visited the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and later called on Yu Yan Ching and Tsun Lee Tung.
Yu Yah Ching stated that he would continue the discussions with the municipality and Sang Shao Lai. General Chang Chun, the Mayor of the municipality, has engaged Mr. John Wu, Song Ping Hsu and Shen Lien Kuei as lawyers (without fee) to handle the cases in the reman Mixed Court. They will save creditors from loss.
Mr. Yu Yah Ching added that the following liquidations will take place:-
1) The liquidation of the five subsidiaries of the Hung Fah Sung &/
2) The liquidation of the property of the late Hung Cho Chih's property.
The directors of the Hung Fah Sung & are to be made responsible for the liabilities and it is hoped that the municipality would render assistance.
Funds are expected from the following sources:-
1) The Great China Dispensary whose value is estimated at $800,000.
2) The Sun Tien Bath House; value $80,000.
3) The Fuh Chang Tobacco Co., ; value $2,500,000 but only $800,000 may be advanced.
4) Wang's property; about $600,000.
Yu Yah Ching further stated that he would hold himself responsible and requested creditors not to worry.
The representatives then called at the municipality and were received by an official who accepted their petition. The result will be announced later.
Tsun Li Fung was next interviewed and he declared that he could follow Yu Yah Ching's views.
The registration of creditors at Pei Kya Lo's place has been transferred to the office of Peh Ken Fung, the Court auditor. There are in all 5000 creditors with a total deposit of $18,318.80 and $678,488.11&.
The creditors registered with Peh Lee Ching were transferred to Pei Kya Lo's office. In all there are 570 creditors with deposits amounting to $77,508.70 and HK$1.87.
The advertisement for the sale of the Sun Tien Bath House is published from today by Su Tsung and Fan Zau Fung, the Court auditors.
Su Tsung and Fan Zau Fung, the Court auditors, have decided to call a meeting with the shareholders of the Hung Fah Sung & on February 16.
A letter was sent by Su Tsung and Fan Zau Fung to the Tsung Fah Dispensary demanding payment of $80,000 and $4,000.81 due to the Shanghai Day and Night Bank branches. It was found from the account books of the head office of the Shanghai Day and Night Bank that they had been advanced $100,000.00 from the Tsung Fah Dispensary of which $96,000.00 had been repaid. The procedure of receiving and paying will be decided.
pages.zh:
1931年2月16日。 晨间译件。 S. B. D. 1949.
1931年2月19日

杂项

已故洪楚直（HUNG CHO CHIH）*事件。

(*注：Hung Cho Chih 疑为 Huang Cho Chiu 之误植或另一相关人物，但根据上下文提及的“洪发盛”（Hung Fah Sung）及“中华大药房”等，此处的 Hung Cho Chih 极可能指与洪发盛号相关的负责人，或为黄楚九之别名/误写。鉴于前文均为黄楚九，此处人名拼写变化较大。若指黄楚九，通常不会突然改为Hung。经查证，洪楚直（Hung Cho Chih）可能为另一商人或关联人，或者为OCR错误。但文中提到“Hung Fah Sung &”（洪发盛号），故此处暂按字面译为洪楚直，若确认为黄楚九之误，则上下文逻辑更通顺。但依据指令5不脑补，指令3不确定保留原文加音译。然而，“Hung”对应“洪”，“Chih”对应“直/志”。此处暂译为洪楚直（音译），但若参照历史档案，黄楚九旗下有洪发盛号。为稳妥，遵循指令3，若不能百分之百确定是黄楚九，则保留音译。但考虑到“Hung Fah Sung”是黄楚九的产业，此处极大可能是指黄楚九。不过，既然名字拼写完全不同，且指令要求不确定加音译，此处译为：洪楚直（音译）。)

《字林西报》（Eastern Times）及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
债权人委员会代表郑世松（Ching Shih Sung）、曹松兴（Tsao Sung Sing）、罗炳炎（Loh Ping Yen）、崔凤平（Tsui Veng Ping）、阮李来（Yuen Lee Lai）和苏元松（Su Yuien Song）昨日拜访了大上海市政府，随后拜会了于亚卿（Yu Yan Ching）和秦丽堂（Tsun Lee Tung）。
于亚卿表示，他将继续与市政府及桑少来（Sang Shao Lai）进行商讨。市长张群将军（General Chang Chun）已聘请吴凯声（John Wu）、宋秉煦（Song Ping Hsu）和沈联奎（Shen Lien Kuei）三位律师（无偿）在残留的混合法庭处理案件。他们将使债权人免受损失。
于亚卿先生补充说，将进行以下清算：
1) 洪发盛号（Hung Fah Sung &）五家子号的清算；
2) 已故洪楚直（Hung Cho Chih）财产的清算。
洪发盛号的董事将对债务承担责任，希望市政府能提供援助。
预计资金来自以下来源：
1) 中华大药房（Great China Dispensary），估值800,000美元。
2) 孙天浴室（Sun Tien Bath House），估值80,000美元。
3) 福昌烟草公司（Fuh Chang Tobacco Co.），估值2,500,000美元，但仅可预支800,000美元。
4) 王某的财产，约600,000美元。
于亚卿进一步表示，他将自行承担责任，并请债权人不要担忧。
随后，代表们拜访了市政府，一位官员接待了他们并接受了他们的请愿书。结果将稍后公布。
接着采访了秦丽峰（Tsun Li Fung），他表示赞同于亚卿的观点。
在北嘉乐（Pei Kya Lo）处的债权人登记已转移至法院审计员白根丰（Peh Ken Fung）的办公室。共有5,000名债权人，存款总额为18,318.80美元和678,488.11&（原文符号不清，可能为银两或其他货币单位）。
在白丽清（Peh Lee Ching）处登记的债权人已转移至北嘉乐的办公室。共有570名债权人，存款金额为77,508.70美元和1.87港元。

A reporter of the Wo Kung Koen News Agency
yesterday called on Pan Kun, Tsia, Chief of the Social

February 19, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS:

THE AFFAIRS OF LATE HUANG CHO CHIU.

The Eastern Times published the following
report:-
The following letter has been sent to Fu Tsung
and Pan Zan Bang, the Court auditors, by Tang Hee Heng the
lawyer retained by the Huang's family:-
I have transmitted your letter to the Huang's
family. In reply, Huang's family states that the late
Huang Cho Chiu owes the Shanghai Day and Night Bank only
$1,050,000 and not $1,350,000 as you have stated in your
letter. The misunderstanding arose through an omission
on your part to enter into the account an extra deposit
of $11,500.
I have stated in the French Mixed Court that
the late Huang Cho Chiu's property is sufficient to cover
his personal liabilities to the Shanghai Day and Night
Bank. It is not known how much he owes to other people;
therefore it is an open question whether his property will
be sufficient to cover his debts. The late Huang Cho Chiu's
movable and immovable property is based on an estimate made
by a firm of auctioneers but it is to be feared that the
proceeds for the property will be reduced at the main time
of sale.
Most of the late Huang Cho Chiu's property is
immovable. The following two points should be given
consideration:-
(1) The late Huang Cho Chiu's immovable
property and jewelery had been mortgaged. It is not
easy to secure the huge sum necessary to redeem his
property.
(2) That late Huang Cho Chiu's property has
been placed under seal by the French Mixed Court and
cannot be handed over immediately.

Reg. Please attach White.
Wky.

February 14, 1931. Afternoon Translation.

The China Times and other local newspapers publish the following report:-
At 3 p.m. yesterday the case of the liquidation of the Day and Night Bank and the Great China Visitors' Savings Department was tried by Magistrate Kwan Ming of the French Mixed Court.
Su Tseng and Sun Su Sung, Court auditors, first stated, "Since the undertaking of the liquidation of the Day and Night Bank and the Great China Visitors' Savings Department, the registration of creditors and the checking of accounts are under progress and we have so far demanded the repayment of debts amounting to $2,000 due to these concerns. We have also discovered that properties of the Great China Dispensary, the Foh Chang Tobacco Company, the Great World Amusement Resort and the Pen Nam Bath House are insufficient to meet liabilities." According to Chow Kwang Tsong, manager of the Great China Dispensary, this pharmacy can be sold for $240,000. Soo Sing Kuen, manager of the Pen Nam Bath House, states that this house can be sold for $80,000, but the employees deposit of $9,186 must be refunded. Yon Sai Man, manager of the Foh Chang Tobacco Company, states that this company can be reorganized. As these enterprises are subsidiaries of the Hung Fah Kung Co, the shareholders of the Hung Fah Kung Co should be responsible for their debts in case assets cannot meet liabilities. On February 14 we advertised to hold a meeting of shareholders of the Hung Fah Kung Co on February 16, but nobody attended, and so a liquidation of the Hung Fah Kung Co is deemed necessary".
Lawyer Au To King, representing the Great China Dispensary and the Foh Chang Tobacco Company, states that there were three steps for the Foh Chang Tobacco Company, (1) to sell the property of the company which was being undertaken, (2) to let the property or to manufacture cigarettes for others, in this way a monthly net profit from $8,000 to $9,000 could be made, which profit would relinquish the obligations in a few years, and (3) to sell the company by auction, the proceeds to repay the debts due to the Day and Night Bank. As regards the proceeds from the sale of the Jiu Sing and Foh Sing Cinemas, he money would be paid to the Sei Chun Financial Syndicate. In consequence of a liquidation of the Great China Dispensary, its assets were $470,000 and its liabilities $480,000. About $240,000 could be secured from the sale of the pharmacy by auction, and out of this amount, $100,000 would be used to repay debts due to the Day and Night Bank and the remaining $140,000 would be returned to the Hung Fah Kung Co.
Koo Yee Hien, lawyer retained by creditors, then requested the Court (1) that the Hung Fah Kung Co be ordered to liquidate, (2) that the Kwong family be ordered to submit a list of their property and (3) that the shareholders of the Hung Fah Kung Co be ordered to be responsible for their obligations and that a list of their names be immediately submitted to the Court.
Chen Sien An, lawyer retained by creditors, further requested the Court to order Han Yeong Che, auditor, of the Kwong Sio Chai Liquidation Committee to produce the list of shareholders of the Hung Fah Kung Co within three days.

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：-
昨日下午3时，法公堂关明（Kwan Ming，音译）法官审理了日夜银行及大中华游客储蓄部的清算案件。
法院审计员苏增（Su Tseng，音译）和孙素松（Sun Su Sung，音译）首先陈述：“自从着手清算日夜银行及大中华游客储蓄部以来，债权人登记和账目核对工作正在进行中，截至目前，我们已要求偿还欠这些机构的2,000元债务。我们还发现，大中华药房、福昌烟草公司、大世界游乐场和盆汤浴室的财产不足以抵偿债务。”据大中华药房经理周光宗（Chow Kwang Tsong，音译）称，该药房可售价240,000元。盆汤浴室经理苏星权（Soo Sing Kuen，音译）称，该浴室可售价80,000元，但必须退还员工存款9,186元。福昌烟草公司经理尹赛文（Yon Sai Man，音译）称，该公司可以重组。由于这些企业是鸿发公公司的子公司，若资产不足以抵偿债务，鸿发公公司的股东应对其债务负责。2月14日我们登报通知于2月16日召开鸿发公公司股东会议，但无人出席，因此认为有必要对鸿发公公司进行清算”。
代表大中华药房和福昌烟草公司的律师欧托京（Au To King，音译）陈述，福昌烟草公司有三步走方案，(1) 出售正在处置的公司财产，(2) 出租财产或为他人代工卷烟，以此方式每月可获得8,000至9,000元的净利润，该利润将在几年内免除债务义务，(3) 拍卖公司，所得款项用于偿还欠日夜银行的债务。关于久兴和福兴电影院出售所得款项，他将把钱支付给四春金融辛迪加。由于大中华药房清算，其资产为470,000元，负债为480,000元。通过拍卖药房可获得约240,000元，其中100,000元将用于偿还欠日夜银行的债务，剩余140,000元将归还给鸿发公公司。
债权人聘请的律师顾义贤（Koo Yee Hien，音译）随后请求法院 (1) 命令鸿发公公司清算，(2) 命令邝氏家族提交其财产清单，以及 (3) 命令鸿发公公司股东对其债务负责，并立即向法院提交股东名单。
债权人聘请的律师陈先安（Chen Sien An，音译）进一步请求法院命令邝小斋清算委员会审计员韩永哲（Han Yeong Che，音译）在三天内提交鸿发公公司股东名单。

Arrested On French

the defunct Day and Night Bank
in the Great World, Avenue
Edward VII, was recalled yester-
day with the arrest of Mr. Chen
Tze-chien, manager of the Bank,
and his son, on warrants issued by
the French Mixed Court. The
case against Mr. Chen was ad-
journed in chambers yesterday in
the French tribunal without a
date being set for the next hear-
ing.

It was reported that the war-
rants were issued at the instance
of two chartered accountants ap-
pointed by the Court to be liquida-
tors of the Bank.

In their complaint, the account-
ants declared that several pages
of account books of the Bank had
been destroyed and replaced by
leaflets bearing false entries.

It was further stated in the
complaint that the suspicions of
the accountants were aroused on
January 19, on the death of Wong
Tso-chui, former managing
director of the Bank, whose death
precipitated the closing of the in-
stitution.

Among other things, it was
claimed that the deceased had
mortgaged $910,000 worth of pro-
perty to the Bank, which
mortgage was shown to have been
wiped out on the day of his death.

The complaint further states
that Mr. Chen, as manager of the
Bank, should have been in posses-
sion of all information regarding
the Bank's business—and was
neglectful of his duties if he were
not aware of the state of affairs.

日夜银行
余波
经理及其子因
法国法院签发的
逮捕令被捕

位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大世界内的已倒闭日夜银行的百万美元亏空案，昨日随着该银行经理陈子坚（Chen Tze-chien，音译）先生及其儿子被法国混合法庭签发的逮捕令逮捕而再次引起关注。陈先生的案件昨日在法国法庭的内室开庭审理后延期，未设定下次听证日期。

据报道，逮捕令是应法院任命的两名担任银行清算人的特许会计师的要求签发的。

在他们的申诉中，会计师声明银行的几页账簿已被销毁，并被替换为载有虚假条目的活页。

申诉中还进一步指出，会计师的怀疑始于 1 月 19 日，即该行前总经理黄佐粹（Wong Tso-chui，音译）去世之日，他的死亡导致了该机构的关闭。

除其他事项外，申诉声称死者曾向银行抵押价值 910,000 美元的财产，而该抵押记录显示在其去世当天被抹去。

申诉还指出，陈先生作为银行经理，本应掌握有关银行业务的所有信息——如果他对事态不知情，则是疏忽职守。

The total amount of deposits is about $2,200,000 or

As the members of the Liquidation Committee
could not guarantee the safe custody of the deposits,
about 300 creditors at 2 p.m. yesterday held a meeting at
the Dong Yui Tsung teashop, Fokien Road, to discuss the
matter. They elected one Mr. Dien of the Law College as
Chairman of the meeting. As the number of persons in
the teashop was too large, it was feared that their presence
might lead to accidents. Those present then elected five
representatives to ask the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce for
the use of its premises as a meeting place. The
representatives approached Zung Chun Ching, an officer
in the Chamber of Commerce. Zung replied that he could not
grant permission because all the members of the standing
committee of the Chamber has already left. As the five
representatives were about to leave the Chamber Building,
the majority of the creditors reached the Chamber. This
caused Zung to grant the use of the hall.
A meeting was then convened. Tsu Tse Ping, who
was elected chairman, said:-
"The liquidation of the Day and Night Bank will
seriously affect the livelihood of the common people. It
is not known whether the liquidation is lawful or not
and whether or not it will impair the interests of the
depositors. I hope that all the creditors will unite to
bring about good results."
About 300 persons were then registered with a total
claim of about $100,000.
A provisional committee was formed to look after
the interests of the depositors. Representatives were
elected to ask the standing committee of the Chamber of
Commerce to lease a room to be used as an office of the
provisional committee. The meeting terminated at 6 p.m.
A reply relating to the lease of a room will be
given on January 22 by the standing committee of the Chamber
of Commerce.
A number of creditors have entrusted lawyer Pie
Chia Loh to register themselves and to deal with their
deposits by means of law. Up to yesterday about 300 persons
were registered in the lawyer's office with claims totalling
$200,000. It is reported that a meeting will be held at
9 a.m. January 25 (Sunday) in the Central Restaurant,
Foochow Road, to discuss the matter.
It is reported that certain persons pretending
to be lawyers are collecting sum of $1 and 50 cents from
each depositor as registration fee.
It is reported that at 9 p.m. yesterday Yu Yah Ching,
Wong Siao Lai and other members of the Liquidation Committee
held another meeting with Mr. Huang's sons and sons-in-law
and Auditor Hsu Yeeng Che but no definite result was reached.

随后召开会议。当选为主席的朱子平（Tsu Tse Ping，音译）说：-
“日夜银行的清算将严重影响普通百姓的生计。尚不清楚清算是否合法，以及是否会损害储户的利益。我希望所有债权人团结一致，以取得良好的结果。”
随后约有 300 人进行了登记，索赔总额约为 100,000 美元。
成立了一个临时委员会以维护储户的利益。选举了代表请求商会常务委员会租赁一个房间作为临时委员会的办公室。会议于下午 6 时结束。

据报道，某些冒充律师的人正在向每位储户收取 1 美元和 50 美分作为登记费。
据报道，昨晚 9 时，清算委员会成员余亚青（Yu Yah Ching，音译）、黄少莱（Wong Siao Lai，音译）等人与黄先生的儿子、女婿及审计师徐永哲（Hsu Yeeng Che，音译）举行了另一次会议，但未达成明确结果。

The China Times and other local newspapers published
the following report on January 22, 1931.

At 4 p.m. yesterday the remains of Huang Cho Chiu
were encoffined at his residence on Avenue Edward VII.
The clothes worn by Mr. Huang cost about $1,000 and the
coffin is of the genuine "Ying Tung" wood produced in
Szechuen Province and had cost $7,000. The coffin is now
lying in the hall of his residence.
Mr. Huang started many enterprises of which the
largest is the Kung Fah Kung Ss which owns the Great World
Amusement Resort, the Day and Night Bank, the Wen Zien Bath
House, the Foh Chang Cigarette Company and the Great China
Dispensary. The Huang Chiu Ts Tang medicine shop, the
Huang Loong Tai, etc., were also established by Mr. Huang
alone. He also started the Chiu Foh Medicine Company,
several land investment companies, cinema theatres, etc.
He was the chairman of the Great Eastern Dispensary.
The total number of shops with which he was connected
cannot be ascertained at present.
After the death of Mr. Huang, the most important
matter for attention is the Day and Night Bank which was
used as the treasury of Mr. Huang.
Yu Yah Ching, Wang Siao Lai, Yuan Lee Tung and other
members of the Huang Cho Chiu Liquidation Committee held a
meeting from 10 p.m. on January 20 to 3 a.m. January 21
but no decision was reached. As Mr. Huang had too many
business connections, a thorough investigation cannot be
made within a short time. This is the most difficult task
for the Liquidation Committee. A rumour was once in
circulation that Tung Tse Zien, Manager of the Day and Night
Bank, is missing. However Tung Tse Zien has now been located.
Hsu Yoong Cho, the auditor, has consequently begun the
liquidation work in co-operation with the Liquidation Committee.
At present the Bank has in its treasury a sum of Tls. 390
and $230 in silver, most of which is of brass or zinc and are
worthless. For this reason the auditor has not yet taken
possession of these dollars. The Great World Amusement
Resort Visitors Savings Department has in its custody a sum
of $297.75. The auditor has deposited this $297.75 and the
Tls. 390 of the Day and Night Bank with the National
Industrial Bank. The safety deposit of the Day and Night
Bank has been placed under the supervision of the □□□□
auditor and the boxes have been opened by the staff of the
Bank in co-operation with the Liquidation Committee. Over
ten articles were taken away yesterday by their □□□□ owners.
The registration of depositors was commenced by the
auditor yesterday in the bank. The place was exceedingly
crowded with depositors. Pickpockets made use of the opportunity
and several persons were relieved of purses. Women and aged
persons were unable to effect registration. As the number
of depositors were too large in number, the policemen on duty
guarded the iron gates in the afternoon. They would not
admit a person until one had left the premises.
On January 20, 230 persons were registered in the bank;
the amount of their deposits is $88,000. 170 persons
registered at the Great World Savings Department, their
deposits amounting to $69,000. 40 persons registered at
the Chekiang Road Branch of the bank, their deposits amounting
to $19,000. About 40 persons claiming $10,000 registered
at the Hongkew Branch of the bank. The total amount of claims
registered on that day was $180,000.
The number of creditors registered at these places on
January 21 is 1,250 with claims amounting to $385,000.
During the past two days 1,340 persons have been
registered with claims amounting to $573,000. The largest

《时报》及其他本地报纸于 1931 年 1 月 22 日发布了以下报道。

昨日下午 4 时，黄楚九（Huang Cho Chiu）的遗体在其爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的寓所入殓。黄先生所穿衣物价值约 1,000 美元，棺材为产自四川省的正宗“阴沉”木，价值 7,000 美元。棺材现停放在其寓所大厅。
黄先生创办了许多企业，其中最大的是共华公司（Kung Fah Kung Ss），拥有大世界游乐场、日夜银行、文仙浴室（Wen Zien Bath House，音译）、福昌烟草公司（Foh Chang Cigarette Company，音译）和大中华药房（Great China Dispensary）。黄九记（Huang Chiu Ts Tang，音译）药店、黄龙泰（Huang Loong Tai，音译）等也由黄先生独自创立。他还创办了九福制药公司（Chiu Foh Medicine Company，音译）、多家土地投资公司、电影院等。他是大东方药房（Great Eastern Dispensary）的主席。
目前无法确定与他有关的商店总数。
黄先生去世后，最受关注的重要事项是作为黄先生金库使用的日夜银行。
余亚青（Yu Yah Ching，音译）、王少莱（Wang Siao Lai，音译）、袁李通（Yuan Lee Tung，音译）及其他黄楚九清算委员会成员从 1 月 20 日晚上 10 时至 1 月 21 日凌晨 3 时举行会议，但未作出决定。由于黄先生的商业联系太多，无法在短时间内进行彻底调查。这是清算委员会最艰巨的任务。曾有谣言流传称日夜银行经理董子坚（Tung Tse Zien，音译）失踪。然而董子坚现已找到。因此，审计师徐永卓（Hsu Yoong Cho，音译）已开始与清算委员会合作进行清算工作。
目前，银行金库内有银两 390 两和银币 230 元，其中大部分为黄铜或锌制，毫无价值。因此，审计师尚未接管这些银元。大世界游乐场游客储蓄部保管有 297.75 美元。审计师已将这 297.75 美元和日夜银行的 390 两银两存入国家工业银行（National Industrial Bank）。日夜银行的保险箱已置于 □□□□ 审计师的监管之下，箱子由银行职员与清算委员会合作打开。昨天，他们的 □□□□ 所有者取走了十多件物品。
审计师昨天开始在银行进行储户登记。现场挤满了储户。扒手利用这一机会，数人被窃去钱包。妇女和老年人无法完成登记。由于储户人数过多，执勤警察在下午守卫铁门。只有在一人离开场所后，才允许另一人进入。
1 月 20 日，银行登记了 230 人；他们的存款金额为 88,000 美元。170 人在大世界储蓄部登记，存款金额为 69,000 美元。40 人在银行浙江路分行登记，存款金额为 19,000 美元。约 40 名索赔 10,000 美元的人在银行虹口分行登记。当天登记的索赔总额为 180,000 美元。

pages.en:
THE DEATH OF HUANG CHO CHIU

The Shun Pao and other local newspapers
publish the following article on January 21, 1931:-
Following the death of Mr. Huang Cho Chiu,
the liquidation of the Day & Night Bank and the Great
World Amusement Resort Visitors' Savings Department,
which were established by him, was begun yesterday.
The deposits are mostly of small sums and consequently
the community is paying much attention to this matter.
Liquidation:- The Day and Night Bank and
the Great World Visitors' Savings Department suspended
business yesterday. The staff are now looking into
the accounts. A notice of liquidation issued by
Mr. Hsu Yoong Cho, chartered accountant, is exhibited
at the gates of these two places where crowds of people
are gathering from morning to night and many persons
shed tears after reading the notice.
Registration of Depositors:- Yesterday
crowds of depositors hurried to No. 36 Av. Edward VII, the
office of Mr. Hsu Yoong Cho, chartered accountant, for
registration. One of the creditors has informed
somebody that the chartered accountant has not said
anything definite regarding the liquidation and therefore
the creditors will form an association to look after
their interests.
Discussions:- Yesterday afternoon Mr.
Yu Yah Ching, Mr. Wong Shao Lai, Mr. Yuan Lee Tung, and
Mr. Wong Yiem Soong went to the home of the deceased on
Av. Edward VII and discussed with the chartered accountant
and the relatives of the deceased ways and means to
deal with the situation. The discussion lasted from
4 p.m. to 7 p.m. but no decision was reached. The discussion
was continued at 9 p.m. A meeting of the Directors
of the Koong Fah Company will be held at 3 p.m. to-day.
Wong Shao Lai's Conversation:- Interviewed
by a reporter last night, Mr. Wong Shao Lai, Chairman of
the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, made the following statement:-
"Mr. Huang Cho Chiu during his life was engaged in many
business enterprises and thousands and thousands of
persons depended on him for their daily bread. His
unfortunate death will certainly create a great panic
among the people, and for this reason I and others
will maintain the various business enterprises of Mr.
Huang so that his death may not affect the livelihood
of a large number of persons. The liquidation
of the Day and Night Bank and the Great World Visitors'
Savings Department has commenced and definite measures
will be reached before long."
When questioned whether the depositors will be
affected, Mr. Wang said that he could not give a reply
to this question as the liquidation was still in progress.
Particulars of Conferences The Huang Cho Chiu
Liquidation Committee yesterday made public the following
particulars of a meeting held on January 19, 1931:-
Attendance: Yu Yah Ching, Yuan Lee Tung, Wong
Shao Lai, Wong Yiem Soong, Yih Shan Dau, Zau Jing Pee,
and relatives of the deceased.
The relatives of the deceased made a report to
the attendance that Mr. Huang Cho Chiu when dying stated
that Mr. Yu Yah Ching, Mr. Yuan Lee Tung, Mr. Wong Shao
Lai, Mr. Wong Yiem Soong, Mr. Yih Shan Dau, Mr. Zau Jing
Pee, Mr. Wang Ching Yoeng, Mr. Chang Siao Ling, and Mr.
Tu Yueh Sung should be requested to deal with various
matters after his death.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That Mr. Yu Yah Ching and Mr. Yuan Lee Tung be requested

黄楚九之死

《申报》及其他本地报纸于1931年1月21日刊登如下文章：-
继黄楚九先生去世后，由其创办的日夜银行和大世界游乐场游客储蓄部的清算工作于昨日开始。存款多为小额款项，因此社会各界对此事极为关注。
清算：- 日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部于昨日停业。职员目前正在查账。由特许会计师徐永祚先生发布的清算公告张贴在这两处场所的大门口，从早到晚人群聚集，许多人读罢公告后潸然泪下。
储户登记：- 昨日，大批储户涌至爱多亚路36号特许会计师徐永祚先生的办事处进行登记。一位债权人告知他人称，该特许会计师尚未就清算事宜给出明确说法，因此债权人将组建协会以维护自身利益。
商讨：- 昨日下午，余雅清先生、王晓籁先生、袁履登先生和王延松先生前往爱多亚路的死者寓所，与特许会计师及死者亲属商讨应对局势的办法。讨论从下午4点持续至7点，但未达成任何决定。讨论于晚上9点继续进行。共发公司董事会议将于今日下午3点召开。
王晓籁的谈话：- 昨晚在接受记者采访时，上海总商会主席王晓籁先生发表如下声明：- “黄楚九先生生前从事多项商业活动，成千上万的人依靠他维持生计。他的不幸去世必然会在民众中引起巨大恐慌，为此，我和其他人将维持黄先生的各项商业企业，使其去世不影响大量人员的生计。日夜银行和大世界游客储蓄部的清算已经开始，不久将制定出具体措施。”
当被问及储户是否会受到影响时，王先生表示，由于清算仍在进行中，他无法就此问题作出答复。

出席人员：余雅清、袁履登、王晓籁、王延松、叶山涛、赵景沛以及死者亲属。
死者亲属向与会者报告称，黄楚九先生在临终时表示，应请余雅清先生、袁履登先生、王晓籁先生、王延松先生、叶山涛先生、赵景沛先生、王敬庸先生、张孝玲先生和杜月笙先生处理其身后的各项事务。
通过以下决议：-

Made by D.S.I.Montgomery Forwarded by [Signature]

Enquiries into the above subject show that the "Day and
Night Bank" (日夜銀行), situated at 445 Avenue Edward VII was
established about August 1921 by the late Huang Choh-chiu (黃楚九),
general manager of the "Great World" for the purpose of serving
the operators of the "Great World Day and Night Stock Exchange".
The latter venture proved a failure and the bank was subsequently
re-organized into a concern catering specially for the poorer
classes by offering a high rate of interest and remaining open
daily until 8 p.m. Its capital is said to be $500,000.00 but
the actual amount paid up is not known.

The sole administration of the Bank was in the hands of
Huang Choh-chiu who employed one Chen Tsz-chien (陳子堅) as
manager. There are two branches, one at 276 Chekiang Road
and one at 586 North Szechuen Road. Both of these branches
have been closed since the death of Huang Choh-chiu on January 19,
1931.

In addition to the closing of the "Day and Night Bank",
the "Great World Players' Savings Department" (大世界遊藝儲蓄部)
situated in the Great World building, which was also under the
management of Huang Choh-chiu, has now ceased to function.
It is reported that the majority of the depositors are of the
working class. The Savings Department offered as an inducement
complimentary tickets to the Great World. The business manager
has not yet been located, therefore no further particulars can
be ascertained at present regarding this institution.

In connection with the foregoing, an auditor named Hsu
Yung Choh (徐永祚), a member of the Shanghai Auditors'
Association, has been appointed by the "Huang Choh-chiu Relief
Support Committee" to take charge of the accounts of the two

1931年1月26日。
1931年1月25日《新闸日报》摘录

袭击警察

1931年1月24日下午2点30分，接到来自爱多亚路250号的电话消息，称最近去世的银行家黄楚九（原文误作 Wong Tsu Jeu，根据上下文应为黄楚九或相关债权人针对黄案，但此处原文如此，依要求保留或修正？注：前文均为Huang Choh-chiu，此处Wong Tsu Jeu可能是OCR错误或指代另一人，但结合语境“forcing entry... getting deposits refunded”及前文黄案，极大概率为指代黄楚九相关事件，但既然要求不脑补，若Wong Tsu Jeu确认为不同人则保留。然而，考虑到这是同一档案序列，且前文一直在讲黄楚九，这里Wong Tsu Jeu很可能是Huang Choh-chiu的误植或另一位涉案银行家。但在1931年1月24日这个时间点，正是黄楚九死后混乱期。经查证历史，黄楚九字楚九，非Wong。但此处原文写的是Wong Tsu Jeu。为了严谨，我将按原文音译，但需注意这可能指代黄楚九的别名或误写，或者确实有另一位银行家。不过看后文“Lieu Soong Yuen”被捕，这通常是黄楚九案中的骚乱。鉴于指令要求“不确定的保留原文并加括号注明(音译)”，我将处理为：）
*更正思考*：指令要求“人名...能确定的用当时通行的中文...不确定的保留原文并加括号注明(音译)”。Wong Tsu Jeu 看起来像 黄楚九 (Huang Chujiu) 的错误拼写或方言发音转录错误 (Wong vs Huang, Tsu Jeu vs Chujiu)。但在没有绝对把握且原文差异较大时，遵循指令保留原文或音译。然而，结合上下文“banker, who died recently”以及日期，这几乎肯定是指黄楚九。但是，Wong和Huang姓氏不同。如果这是另一份报告提到的另一个人，那就麻烦了。但在同一档案号 S.B.D. 1949 下，主题紧密相关。让我们再看一眼原文："creditors of one Wong Tsu Jeu, banker, who died recently"。黄楚九死于1月19日。如果是黄楚九，英文通常拼写为 Huang Choh-chiu 或 Huang Chujiu。Wong Tsu Jeu 可能是 **黄楚九** 的粤语或某种方言拼写变体，或者是OCR严重错误。考虑到前文一直用 Huang Choh-chiu，这里突然变成 Wong Tsu Jeu 非常奇怪。
*再仔细看*：有没有可能是 **王** 姓银行家？近期去世的？1931年1月附近去世的著名银行家？似乎没有比黄楚九更轰动的。这极有可能是档案记录员的笔误，将 Huang 写成了 Wong，Choh-chiu 写成了 Tsu Jeu。
*决策*：为了安全起见，且不违背“不要脑补”的原则，但如果我翻译成“黄楚九”，可能违背了原文的字面意思；如果翻译成“翁祖爵(音译)”，可能误导读者。
*重新阅读指令*：“原文中残缺、拼写错误或明显是 OCR 遗留的乱码，照实译出或标「（原文不清）」，不要脑补。”
Wong Tsu Jeu 与 Huang Choh-chiu 差异较大，不能简单视为OCR乱码（如 Hnag -> Huang）。它看起来像一个完整的名字。因此，我将将其视为一个不确定的人名，进行音译，并可能在心中备注这可能是黄楚九的误写，但在译文中严格遵循指令。
*等等*，如果是“Wong Tsu Jeu”，音译大概是“翁祖爵”或“黄祖爵”（Wong也可以是黄）。在上海话或普通话中，Wong通常对应黄（粤语）或王（国语/吴语拼音有时混用）。鉴于前文都是Huang，这里用Wong，可能是指同一个人但拼写不一致。
*最稳妥的处理*：由于前文明确指出是 Huang Choh-chiu 的案子，且日期吻合，这极大概率是同一人。但是，作为译者，面对明显的名字不一致，如果直接统一为黄楚九，属于“修正”而非“翻译”。如果音译，又显得突兀。
*查看上下文*：这是一份关于“袭击警察”的报告。地点是爱多亚路250号。黄楚九的日夜银行在445号。250号是谁？可能是另一个相关地点。
*决定*：我将保留原文名字的音译，因为指令说“不确定的保留原文并加括号注明(音译)”。虽然我很想把它改成黄楚九，但Wong和Huang的区别让我犹豫。不过，考虑到这是同一份档案（S.B.D. 1949），且前一份报告（p148）明确说调查对象是日夜银行和黄楚九，这份报告（p151）标题虽未显示完整，但归档在同一号下，内容也是债权人挤兑。极有可能就是黄楚九。
*但是*，指令第4条说“拼写错误...照实译出”。如果我认为它是拼写错误，我应该照实译出（即音译Wong Tsu Jeu）还是纠正？通常“照实译出”意味着保留错误的面貌。
*最终决定*：音译为“翁祖爵(音译)”或“黄祖爵(音译)”。鉴于Wong在旧上海拼音中常指黄（如Wong Chung-kuo），但也可能指王。为了不与前文的Huang Choh-chiu混淆，我将使用“翁祖爵(音译)”，并在心里知道这可能是指黄楚九。或者，更仔细地看，Tsu Jeu 很像 Chujiu。Wong 很像 Huang 的误听/误写。
*实际上*，很多老档案里 Huang 和 Wong 混用。我将译作“黄祖爵(音译)”，因为Wong对应黄的可能性在旧式拼音中存在，且Tsu Jeu对应楚九。这样既保留了原文的语音特征，又暗示了与黄楚九的联系，同时符合“音译”的要求。

*修正*：再看一遍，原文是 `Wong Tsu Jeu`。如果我不确定，我就写 `(音译)`。
译文如下：

1931年1月24日下午2点30分，接到爱多亚路250号打来的电话，称最近去世的银行家翁祖爵(音译)（Wong Tsu Jeu）的债权人扬言要强行闯入上述地址，要求退还存款，人群变得骚动不安。警方被召往现场，响应呼叫的印籍巡长 Ware 和华籍巡捕 275 号受轻伤，并逮捕了一名看似是导致人群聚集原因的华籍男子廖松元（Lieu Soong Yuen，音译），他被控袭击警察，将于1931年1月26日在上海特区法院出庭。

to do with gambling and opium although he himself given for

市内的小世界游乐场（该产业后来卖给了罗士尔）。作为大世界游乐场的总经理，他在未征求股东意见的情况下，将该游乐场的收益用于其他计划，例如在北浙江路创办福昌烟草公司，以及在武定路110号创办久成烟草公司。由于当时抵制英美烟草公司生产的“红双喜”（Ruby Queen）香烟，这些公司的业务十分繁荣。随后他又创办了“日夜银行”和大世界储蓄会。利用从这些来源获得的资金，他后来成为包括福州路350号的中西大药房、北京路与西藏路路口的大东药房、浙江路285号的黄球记药店、浙江路282号的黄龙泰茶庄、海格路111号的久胜电影院、西藏路61号的福声电影院、伯基尔路14号的久福制药公司、爱多亚路的文泉浴室，以及拥有在福州路、伯基尔路、浙江路和芝罘路租赁土地上所建房屋的公发地产投资公司等约九十家机构的经理和主要股东。

Huang Cho-chiu (黄楚九) who died at 4 p.m. January 19
is a native of Yu Yao Hsien, Chekiang. He came to Shanghai
about 40 years ago. His father was an eye specialist in
Shanghai and Huang took over his practice on his death. Not
finding it a success he started a dispensary called the Chung
Fah "Sino-French" (later its name was changed into the Great
Eastern Dispensary) on Rue du Consulat where he sold aphrodisiac
medicines. This came to the notice of the French Police with
the result that Huang was prosecuted and sentenced to be ban-
booed together with a term of imprisonment. Upon his release
from gaol, he removed the dispensary to Hankow Road. He then
organized a Savings Society called "The Life Protection Society"
in which each subscriber was called on to pay 30 cents annually
to insure payment of $100. to his family upon his death. He
made money from this society and also from the sale of certain
"doubtful" medicines of his own manufacture which he advertised
extensively. He bought the papers of a deceased citizen of
Macao and secured Portuguese registration which, at that
particular time, was recognized as an insurance against pro-
secution. About 1911 with the assistance of a wealthy man
named Ching Ying-san he established two amusement resorts one
called "Ler Nga Ler" (Nanking and Chekiang Road corner now
closed) and the other called the New World. Upon the death
of Ching the principal shareholder, Huang declared himself
sole manager of these establishments himself. This, however,
was strongly opposed by Ching's widow and Huang was eventually
induced to withdraw upon payment of a sum of $100,000. With
this and money raised from shares he started the Great World
Amusement Resort on Avenue Edward VII, French Concession and

Mixed Court at the request of the two Court auditors, of Chen
Tsz-zien (陳芝泉) Manager and Chief Accountant of the Day
and Night Bank and his son Chen Yue-ching (陳雨青), an
accountant of the same concern. It is alleged that a false
set of books was produced and that on the day of his death
a forged cheque purporting to have emanated from Huang was
cashed. It would appear that the cheque was signed by Huang's
eldest son, Huang Shen-tsoong (黃憲中) on behalf of his
father who was too ill to sign it. Huang Shen-tsoong was also
charged and all the parties are now released on security. It
is expected that if the money is recovered, the criminal case
will be dropped.

A good example of the complex dealing of the deceased
can be denoted by the formation of the Foh Chong Tobacco
Company. In order to obtain the funds necessary to purchase
the plant for this undertaking, Huang borrowed the money from
the "Day and Night Bank". The plant (machinery) when pur-
chased was mortgaged to the China Finance Corporation for
$100,000. This business is heavily in debt, apart from owing
money for tobacco leaf, the mortgage is still unpaid and no
one knows what happened to the $100,000.

The Foh Chong Tobacco Company's factory has been
under seal since February 16, 1931 as a result of an action
taken by the China Finance Company.

Developments are being closely watched. Attached

应两位法院审计员的要求，混合法院传讯了日夜银行经理兼总会计师陈芝泉及其子、该机构会计师陈雨青。据称，他们制作了一套假账，并在黄楚九去世当天兑现了一张声称由黄发出的伪造支票。看来这张支票是由黄的长子黄宪中代表其父签署的，因其父病重无法签字。黄宪中也被指控，所有当事人目前均已保释。预计如果追回款项，刑事案件将撤销。

死者复杂的交易手段可以从福昌烟草公司的成立中得到很好的例证。为了获得购买该企业厂房所需的资金，黄楚九从“日夜银行”借款。厂房（机器）在购买时被抵押给中国金融公司，金额为10万美元。该企业负债累累，除了欠付烟叶款项外，抵押贷款尚未偿还，且无人知晓那10万美元的下落。

由于中国金融公司采取的行动，福昌烟草公司的工厂自1931年2月16日起已被查封。

事态发展正受到密切监视。随函附上有关此事的报纸剪报

Subject (in full) The Liquidation of the Day and Night Bank and the Great

Made by D.S.I. Montgomery Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.O.I.

In connection with the above matter, a section of
the creditors, composed of depositors in the above mentioned
banking undertakings, took action at the French Mixed Court,
who appointed two auditors, named Pan Shao-pang (潘肇邦) and
Wu Tseng (吳徵) to undertake the liquidation of the estate
of the late Huang Cho-chui, the death of whom resulted in
the failure of the two banks. Up to the present a sum
equal to ten per cent of the liabilities of the Great World
Visitors' Savings' Department has been repaid, which sum was
raised by a mortgage on the Great World Amusement Resort.

Originally much confusion was caused by a divergence
of opinion among the creditors. Immediately following the
death of Huang and the attempted private liquidation of the
two banks, no less than six creditor groups were formed.
Some took action at the Shanghai Special District Court on
the grounds that the deceased had extensive interests in the
International Settlement whilst others took their case to the
French Mixed Court on the grounds that the two banking under-
takings were located in Frenchtown. This action caused the
Liquidation Committee, composed of associates of the deceased,
to resign. The creditors are now working in unison.

The Municipality of Greater Shanghai, through its
Bureau of Social Affairs, took an interest in the matter, but
except for requesting the Courts to keep them notified,
appointing counsel for the creditors, and issuing statements
from time to time, no interference of any magnitude has been
observed .

It has been established that the Great World Amuse-
ment Resort and the Day and Night Bank are subsidiaries of the

事由（详述）日夜银行及大世界游客储蓄部的清算

制作人 副警务总监助理 Montgomery 转呈人 Henry Robertson C.O.I.

关于上述事项，由上述银行业务的储户组成的一部分债权人在法国混合法院采取了行动，该院任命了两名审计员，即潘肇邦和吴徵，负责对已故黄楚九的遗产进行清算，他的去世导致了两家银行的倒闭。截至目前，已偿还相当于大世界游客储蓄部负债百分之十的款项，该笔资金是通过抵押大世界游乐场筹集的。

最初，债权人之间的意见分歧造成了很大的混乱。在黄楚九去世以及试图对两家银行进行私人清算后，立即形成了不少于六个债权人团体。一些人以死者在公共租界拥有广泛利益为由，在上海特区法院提起诉讼；而另一些人则以两家银行业机构位于法租界为由，向法国混合法院提起诉讼。这一行动导致由死者亲友组成的清算委员会辞职。目前债权人正在统一行动。

上海特别市政府通过其社会局对此事表示了关注，但除了要求法院随时通知情况、为债权人聘请律师并不时发表声明外，未观察到任何重大干预。
